papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We show”“formulating the dynamics”等理论推导表述，并涉及量子热力学循环的动力学分析，未提及实验数据或数值计算细节。；研究对象：非准静态（有限时间）驱动下的含时谐振子量子热力学循环，具体为一种类奥托（Otto-like）绝热量子热力学循环，以及其在离子阱（Paul trap）中的实验实现方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象中，可以在非准静态（有限速率）驱动下保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构，从而避免传统能量表象中有限速率驱动导致的非绝热布居重排和残余激发，无需引入辅助反绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）修改物理哈密顿量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象中，可以在非准静态（有限速率）驱动下保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构，从而避免传统能量表象中有限速率驱动导致的非绝热布居重排和残余激发，无需引入辅助反绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）修改物理哈密顿量。；创新点：建立了绝热运行（adiabatic operation）与准静态驱动（quasi-static driving）之间的明确区分，提出了一种在有限时间内实现量子热循环且保持绝热能量结构的新途径，无需准静态极限或辅助反绝热驱动。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象下的量子动力学分析；采用参数化Mathieu协议描述驱动过程；实验方案基于囚禁离子Paul阱中的受激拉曼相互作用，通过独立控制激光失谐和光束交角实现。

papers.title: Approximating the peculiar velocity distribution of dark matter halos with Tsallis statistics
papers.abstract: Dark matter halos, which host galaxies and galaxy clusters, have peculiar velocities far from thermal equilibrium. Characterizing the nonlinear and non-Gaussian features of this velocity distribution improves our understanding of the gravitational evolution of the cosmic web and supports related cosmological applications. We endeavor to establish a connection between the peculiar velocity distribution of halos and nonequilibrium statistical mechanics, with the objective of obtaining a model that is both concise and accurate for practical applications. We extracted halo samples from large N-body simulations and performed maximum-likelihood fits to the peculiar velocity distributions using a two-parameter Tsallis model, derived from non-extensive statistical mechanics. On the theoretical side, we reformulated the halo distribution in the superstatistics framework by means of a generalized Gram-Charlier expansion based on the gamma distribution. For halo peculiar velocities below 1000 km/s, the Tsallis model achieves 5 percent accuracy over z=0-2, with performance improving toward lower redshifts. Our results show that the halo velocity distribution becomes increasingly non-Gaussian and departs further from equilibrium over time. The best-fit parameters depend only weakly on mass, though low-mass halos exhibit slightly stronger non-Gaussianity. The two parameters, especially the velocity dispersion, offer promising probes of cosmological parameters. Theoretically, we find that in general the halo peculiar velocity distribution function is expressible as a superposition of a series of Tsallis distribution functions, while simulation results demonstrate that the zeroth-order approximation, namely a single Tsallis function, already achieves sufficient accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合型文章。判断依据：使用了“N-body simulations”（N体模拟）进行数据提取，并结合“maximum-likelihood fits”（最大似然拟合）和“non-extensive statistical mechanics”（非广延统计力学）、“superstatistics framework”（超统计框架）等理论模型进行分析。；研究对象：暗物质晕（dark matter halos）的 peculiar velocity（本动速度/特征速度）分布。具体研究的是该速度分布的非线性、非高斯特征及其随宇宙时间（红移 z=0-2）的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 暗物质晕的本动速度分布可以用一个简洁的两参数 Tsallis 模型（源自非广延统计力学）在 5% 精度内进行描述（速度低于 1000 km/s，红移 z=0-2）。该分布随时间演化变得越来越非高斯，偏离热平衡态更远。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：暗物质晕的本动速度分布可以用一个简洁的两参数 Tsallis 模型（源自非广延统计力学）在 5% 精度内进行描述（速度低于 1000 km/s，红移 z=0-2）。该分布随时间演化变得越来越非高斯，偏离热平衡态更远。；创新点：1. 首次将暗物质晕的本动速度分布与非广延统计力学（Tsallis 统计）建立直接联系，提供了一个既简洁又精确的实用模型。
papers.method_zh: 1. 从大型 N体模拟中提取暗物质晕样本。

papers.title: Beyond geometric symmetry: Broadband linear relations in wave scattering
papers.abstract: The design and control of wave scattering, that is, of the reflection and transmission parameters of a device, is of ubiquitous importance. These parameters generally change with varying frequency, though certain \emph{frequency-independent} linear relations may exist between them. Reciprocity and geometric symmetry (reflections, rotations, etc.) are classic and well-known examples that are present in many devices and significantly ease their design. In this work, we go beyond these and introduce a new class of relations that cannot be induced by reciprocity or geometric symmetry. Choosing networks of waveguides as our workhorse, we discuss the conditions and consequences of such novel behaviour and showcase suitable example setups. We further experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables and find excellent agreement in the broad frequency range between 0 and 1 GHz. Our work not only deepens the theoretical understanding of waveguide network dynamics, but also opens new avenues for applications in broadband signal processing, quantum information, and integrated photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时出现“discuss the conditions and consequences”（理论）、“showcase suitable example setups”（设计）以及“experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables”（实验）。；研究对象：波导网络（waveguide networks）中的波散射现象，具体关注反射与透射参数之间存在的**与频率无关的线性关系**，并探索超越互易性与几何对称性的新型关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作发现并验证了一类**无法由互易性或几何对称性诱导**的、频率无关的线性散射关系，在0–1 GHz宽带范围内与同轴电缆实验高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作发现并验证了一类**无法由互易性或几何对称性诱导**的、频率无关的线性散射关系，在0–1 GHz宽带范围内与同轴电缆实验高度吻合。；创新点：突破了传统仅依赖互易性和几何对称性（反射、旋转等）来构造频率无关线性关系的局限，首次引入并实验验证了**非对称性起源的宽带线性散射关系**，为宽带信号处理与量子信息器件提供了新设计自由度。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为波导网络的散射矩阵分析；实验手段为同轴电缆（coaxial cables）搭建的波导网络，在0–1 GHz频段进行散射参数测量。

papers.title: Random Recursive Simplicial Complexes
papers.abstract: We investigate random recursive simplicial complexes growing by adding, at each step, a vertex together with a simplex formed by joining the new vertex with a randomly chosen existing simplex. We also add all faces of the new simplex to ensure that the resulting object remains a simplicial complex. If the choice of an existing simplex is uniform among simplices of dimension $<m$, the number $S_d$ of simplices of any admissible dimension $d\leq m$ is an asymptotically self-averaging random variable. This feature allows us to determine the asymptotic growth law of the average of $S_d$ when the number of vertices diverges. We also probe the degree distribution, examine the probabilities of various extreme outcomes, and analyze the characteristics of the first vertex.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、random recursive simplicial complexes、asymptotically self-averaging、probability。；研究对象：随机递归单纯复形（random recursive simplicial complexes），一种在每一步添加新顶点并与随机选择的已有单纯形相连而增长的随机几何/拓扑结构，属于随机图与复杂网络的拓扑推广。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当已有单纯形的选择在维度小于 m 的单纯形中均匀进行时，任意允许维度 d≤m 的单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均的随机变量；据此可确定当顶点数发散时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。此外还分析了度分布、极端结果的概率以及第一个顶点的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当已有单纯形的选择在维度小于 m 的单纯形中均匀进行时，任意允许维度 d≤m 的单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均的随机变量；据此可确定当顶点数发散时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。此外还分析了度分布、极端结果的概率以及第一个顶点的特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于将随机递归图（如随机递归树）的经典模型推广到单纯复形（高维拓扑结构），并系统研究了其组合统计量的渐近行为。
papers.method_zh: 概率论与随机组合学分析，包括对随机增长过程的渐近自平均性证明、平均值的渐近增长律推导、度分布与极端事件概率的解析计算。

papers.title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
papers.abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces $X$ with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over $X\times \mathbb{Z}$. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an $Ω$-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the $c=\frac{1}{2}$ chiral Majorana fermion net and the $(E_{8})_{1}$ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on $\mathbb{Z}^{2}$. In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“引入并研究”“提出定义”“证明同构”等数学物理理论推导关键词，无实验或数值计算内容。；研究对象：研究对象为定义在一致局部有限度量空间上的（费米子与玻色子）可逆准局域代数，以及与之相关的可逆物相、量子元胞自动机、手性马约拉纳费米子网、$(E_8)_1$ 共形网，以及有理对角共形场论的时间片网。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 $X\times \mathbb{Z}$ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并构造了 $c=\frac{1}{2}$ 手性马约拉纳费米子网和 $(E_8)_1$ 共形网作为 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 上 Brauer 非平凡的可逆准局域代数，从而给出非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的显式构造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 $X\times \mathbb{Z}$ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并构造了 $c=\frac{1}{2}$ 手性马约拉纳费米子网和 $(E_8)_1$ 共形网作为 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 上 Brauer 非平凡的可逆准局域代数，从而给出非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的显式构造。；创新点：首次将可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类、可逆物相与量子元胞自动机三者统一到同一同构框架下，并利用 K-理论为 Kitaev 提出的 $\Omega$-谱给出具体定义；同时首次给出手性马约拉纳费米子网和 $(E_8)_1$ 共形网作为 Brauer 非平凡可逆准局域代数的显式实例，并证明有理对角共形场论的时间片网具有格点自由度，从而推出全纯共形网的离散化是可逆的。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子代数与张量范畴的数学框架，具体包括：可逆准局域 von Neumann 代数的 Brauer 等价类分类、对称幺半范畴的 K-理论、Kitaev 猜想的 $\Omega$-谱定义、以及共形网与时间片网的构造与分析。

papers.title: Optically Induced Thermal Runaway in Phase-Change VO2 Nanostructures
papers.abstract: While thermal runaway occurs across diverse physical disciplines, its presence in subwavelength phase-change photonics remains unexplored because existing thermo-optical models break down near sharp optical transitions. Here, we introduce an iterative multiphysics framework coupling full-wave electrodynamics with heat transfer, and we discover optically induced thermal runaway in vanadium dioxide (VO2) nanostructures. The runaway switching threshold depends on the illumination wavelength, ambient temperature, and underlying substrate, with external thermal biasing significantly reducing the optical intensity required for runaway ignition. Our results push forward the modeling of sharp photothermal transitions and provide essential design principles for active metasurfaces, neuromorphic photonic devices, and nanoscale thermal management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“引入迭代多物理场框架”“耦合全波电动力学与热传递”，属于建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：二氧化钒（VO2）纳米结构中的光致热失控现象，属于亚波长相变光子学与热管理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。；创新点：首次在亚波长相变光子学中揭示光致热失控的存在，并建立了能够处理尖锐光热相变过程的迭代多物理场建模方法，为有源超表面和神经形态光子器件提供设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 迭代多物理场仿真框架，将全波电动力学（麦克斯韦方程求解）与热传导方程耦合，用于处理尖锐光学跃迁附近传统热-光模型失效的问题。

papers.title: Large Deviations for the Bose--Einstein Condensate of the Ideal Gas in the Canonical Ensemble
papers.abstract: We consider a non-interacting Bose gas governed by a general one-particle Hamiltonian in the canonical ensemble. Our main results are large-deviation estimates for the number of particles in the Bose--Einstein condensate. We show that the left- and right-tail probabilities decay at different exponential rates as the number of particles tends to infinity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“large-deviation estimates”（大偏差估计）等数学物理理论术语，并讨论“as the number of particles tends to infinity”（粒子数趋于无穷的极限行为），属于严格的理论分析。；研究对象：理想（无相互作用）玻色气体的玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）现象，具体研究在正则系综（canonical ensemble）下、由一般单粒子哈密顿量描述的玻色气体中凝聚体粒子数的统计涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在粒子数趋于无穷时，凝聚体粒子数分布的左尾（低于均值）和右尾（高于均值）概率以不同的指数速率衰减，即大偏差函数在左右两侧不对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在粒子数趋于无穷时，凝聚体粒子数分布的左尾（低于均值）和右尾（高于均值）概率以不同的指数速率衰减，即大偏差函数在左右两侧不对称。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确指出研究对象为“一般单粒子哈密顿量”（general one-particle Hamiltonian），且揭示了左右尾指数衰减速率不同这一非对称性，这相对于通常仅关注均值或方差的结果更为精细。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论（large deviation theory）作为数学框架，对正则系综下非相互作用玻色气体的凝聚体粒子数进行严格的渐近分析，推导其指数衰减速率（率函数）。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints for Quantum Channels: A Spacetime-Duality View
papers.abstract: Quantum anomalies strongly constrain the possible behavior of many-body systems. A prime example is the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem, which relates UV symmetry and filling constraints to IR features of the energy spectrum and ground-state structure. Here, we ask how LSM constraints shape dynamical signatures and temporal correlations in open quantum systems. Using a spacetime duality, we show that the Liouvillian of a $d$-dimensional repeated quantum channel with a mixed anomaly between strong $S$ and weak $G$ symmetry can be mapped to a $(d{+}1)$-dimensional mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (mSPT) phase. Under this correspondence, the initial and steady states of the channel are identified with boundary states of the higher-dimensional mSPT in the presence of bulk projection. We further introduce the twisted Renyi-$N$ correlator (TRNC) as a probe of temporal correlations in the channel and demonstrate that it is dual to the mSPT strange correlator, providing a direct bulk-boundary route to diagnose long-range temporal order implied by the LSM anomaly. Finally, we identify the \textit{Liouvillian singular spectrum}, rather than the Liouvillian spectrum itself, as a more fundamental diagnostic of quantum anomalies, and show that it is dual to the operator entanglement spectrum of the mSPT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spacetime duality、mapped to、theoretical framework。；研究对象：开放量子系统中重复量子通道的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）约束，以及由混合对称反常导致的动力学特征和时间关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过时空对偶，将d维重复量子通道的Liouvillian映射到(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相，并证明LSM反常导致的时间长程有序可由扭曲Renyi-N关联子（TRNC）诊断，且Liouvillian奇异谱（而非Liouvillian谱本身）是对偶mSPT的算子纠缠谱，是更基本的反常诊断量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过时空对偶，将d维重复量子通道的Liouvillian映射到(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相，并证明LSM反常导致的时间长程有序可由扭曲Renyi-N关联子（TRNC）诊断，且Liouvillian奇异谱（而非Liouvillian谱本身）是对偶mSPT的算子纠缠谱，是更基本的反常诊断量。；创新点：首次将LSM定理的约束从平衡态能谱推广到开放量子通道的动力学和时间关联；提出Liouvillian奇异谱作为量子反常的新诊断量，并建立其与mSPT算子纠缠谱的对偶关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：时空对偶（spacetime duality）映射；引入扭曲Renyi-N关联子（TRNC）作为时间关联探针；利用mSPT的strange correlator和算子纠缠谱（operator entanglement spectrum）进行体-边界对应分析。

papers.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
papers.abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“large-N bilocal effective action”“kernel eigenvalue”“Klein–Gordon action”等解析理论推导，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：Yukawa–SYK（Yukawa–Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev）模型中的Cooper配对问题，具体关注配对涨落在dS₂/AdS₂几何中的谱分解与体态场涌现机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cooper配对的不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于dS₂拉普拉斯算符的连续散射谱中，离散模不临界；将双局域Cooper对场投影到连续谱子空间后，可无额外谱限制地映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场，从而为早期全息表述中的投影步骤提供了微观证明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cooper配对的不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于dS₂拉普拉斯算符的连续散射谱中，离散模不临界；将双局域Cooper对场投影到连续谱子空间后，可无额外谱限制地映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场，从而为早期全息表述中的投影步骤提供了微观证明。；创新点：首次从谱分析角度严格证明：早期全息Cooper配对公式中隐含的“仅保留连续谱”投影是微观自洽的，无需对体理论施加额外谱截断；阐明了双局域配对理论如何自然涌现出局域AdS₂体场。
papers.method_zh: 从大N双局域有效作用量出发，推导偶数频自旋单态Cooper道的高斯涨落核；沿用Maldacena–Stanford方法，解析求解任意共形权重h下的核本征值k(h)；将配对涨落分解为dS₂拉普拉斯算符的连续谱与离散谱；在最低连续模附近展开核，得到限制在连续谱子空间上的dS₂上的Klein–Gordon作用，并利用逆Radon变换映射至AdS₂。

papers.title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
papers.abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical $d$-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：general framework、derive a rigorous bound、numerical optimization、analytical bound。；研究对象：有限维经典与量子计数过程（counting processes），即描述随机事件（如光子探测、时钟滴答）发生时间序列的随机过程，重点研究有限记忆资源下的计时精度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典d态计数过程存在一个紧致的有限记忆方差下界（由离散Erlang型阶梯过程饱和），而量子计数过程可以突破该经典界，在相同记忆大小和平均滴答时间下实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典d态计数过程存在一个紧致的有限记忆方差下界（由离散Erlang型阶梯过程饱和），而量子计数过程可以突破该经典界，在相同记忆大小和平均滴答时间下实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。；创新点：首次在有限记忆（有限维）计数过程中严格证明并量化了量子优势：量子过程可违反经典有限记忆方差下界，且该优势在大平均时间极限下仍保持（至少在单Kraus无滴答族内），并将离散时间计数过程与连续时间量子守时（quantum timekeeping）联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（严格证明经典d态计数过程的方差下界）、数值优化（搜索量子计数过程以最小化首次滴答方差）、解析分析（对qubit情形在单Kraus无滴答族内推导大平均时间下的方差界）。

papers.title: Intrinsic temporal and spectral mixing in time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In an ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe measurement, the photoinduced material response can be modulated on a timescale shorter than the extent of the THz pulse. In this situation, the measured time-frequency response deviates from a simple time-dependent linear response. When full two-dimensional time-frequency maps are measured, this yields complex features that can be incorrectly assigned to a photoexcited coherent response. We investigate this experimentally via the measured response of photoexcited SnSe, whereby photoinduced phase change dynamics lead to ultrafast changes of the charge carrier and lattice optical conductivity response. Two-dimensional time-frequency THz transmission maps subsequently show unexpected time-frequency features at early pump-probe delay times. These features are reproduced in both finite-difference time-domain simulations of the THz experiment and in an extension of non-equilibrium response function theory, demonstrating their systematic origin. This work improves the understanding of systematic effects in high time resolution optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy, and explores the conditions in which they are likely to appear.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 模拟 + 理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally via the measured response”、“finite-difference time-domain simulations”以及“extension of non-equilibrium response function theory”。；研究对象：光激发SnSe（硒化锡）材料在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测实验中的光致相变动力学，以及由此产生的电荷载流子与晶格光导响应的超快变化。核心物理现象是时间分辨太赫兹光谱中出现的“时间-频率混合”伪影。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲持续时间更短的时间尺度上被调制时，测得的时频响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂时频特征。这些特征在SnSe的早期泵浦-探测延迟时间上被观察到，并通过模拟和理论扩展证明其具有系统性起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲持续时间更短的时间尺度上被调制时，测得的时频响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂时频特征。这些特征在SnSe的早期泵浦-探测延迟时间上被观察到，并通过模拟和理论扩展证明其具有系统性起源。；创新点：揭示了高时间分辨光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱中一种此前未被充分认识的系统性伪影来源——即光致响应调制时间短于太赫兹脉冲宽度时产生的固有时间-频率混合效应，并给出了其出现的条件。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱，测量光激发SnSe的二维时频太赫兹透射图；数值上使用时域有限差分（FDTD）方法模拟太赫兹实验；理论上扩展了非平衡响应函数理论以复现实验特征。

papers.title: Front-induced transitions control THz waves
papers.abstract: Relativistically moving dielectric perturbations can be used to manipulate light in new and exciting ways beyond the capabilities of traditional nonlinear optics. Adiabatic interaction with the moving front modulates the wave simultaneously in both space and time, and manifests a front-induced transition in both wave vector and frequency yielding exotic effects including non-reciprocity and time-reversal. Here, we introduce a technique called SLIPSTREAM, Spacetime Light-Induced Photonic STRucturEs for Advanced Manipulation. The technique is based on the creation of relativistic fronts in a semiconductor-filled planar waveguide by photoexcitation of mobile charge carriers. Here we demonstrate the capabilities of SLIPSTREAM for novel manipulation of THz light pulses through relativistic front-induced transitions. In the sub-luminal front velocity regime, we generate temporally stretched THz waveforms, with a quasi-static field lasting for several picoseconds tunable with the front interaction distance. In the super-luminal regime, the carrier front outpaces the THz pulse and a time-reversal operation is performed via a front-induced intra-band transition. We anticipate our platform will be a versatile tool for future applications in the THz spectral band requiring direct and advanced control of light at the sub-cycle level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、technique、photoexcitation、experimental平台描述。；研究对象：半导体填充平面波导中的THz光脉冲，以及由移动光生载流子前沿（相对论移动介电扰动）诱导的前沿诱导跃迁现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过SLIPSTREAM技术，在亚光速前沿速度下可产生准静态、持续数皮秒的可调谐拉伸THz波形；在超光速前沿速度下，载流子前沿超过THz脉冲，通过前沿诱导带内跃迁实现时间反演操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过SLIPSTREAM技术，在亚光速前沿速度下可产生准静态、持续数皮秒的可调谐拉伸THz波形；在超光速前沿速度下，载流子前沿超过THz脉冲，通过前沿诱导带内跃迁实现时间反演操作。；创新点：首次提出并实验展示SLIPSTREAM技术，利用相对论移动前沿在THz波段实现亚周期尺度的直接光场操控，包括时间拉伸和超光速时间反演，超越了传统非线性光学的调控能力。摘要未突出说明与已有移动前沿实验的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光激发移动载流子在半导体填充平面波导中产生相对论移动介电前沿（SLIPSTREAM技术），通过控制前沿与THz脉冲的相互作用距离和速度（亚光速/超光速）来调控THz波。摘要未明确说明具体半导体材料、激发波长或探测手段。

papers.title: Multicomponent Magnetic Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: Spatial textures of magnetic order, such as domain walls and skyrmions, are fundamental objects in magnetism. In rhombohedral multilayer graphene, magnetic order involves spin and valley degrees of freedom, opening the possibility of qualitatively new spatial textures. Here, we explore this possibility through a microscopic study of a one-dimensional domain wall in the valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase of rhombohedral graphene. We uncover two different classes of domain walls. One resembles a conventional magnetic domain wall, locally rotating between the two bulk states, whereas the other is intrinsically multicomponent and explores states that are not occupied in either bulk domain. Which texture is realized is controlled by the competition between intervalley Hund's coupling and spin-orbit coupling, and we identify experimental signatures to distinguish them. We further show that, in a superconducting junction formed across the wall, the superconducting phase difference couples directly to the intervalley-coherent phase of the texture. Precession of this internal phase can therefore generate a voltage across the junction. Our theory shows that rhombohedral graphene indeed has magnetic textures beyond conventional magnet and that their dynamics can couple to superconducting transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“microscopic study”“our theory shows”等理论表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：菱方多层石墨烯（rhombohedral multilayer graphene）中谷极化四分之一金属相（valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase）内的一维磁畴壁，以及畴壁上的超导结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方石墨烯的谷极化四分之一金属相中，存在两类磁畴壁：一类类似传统磁畴壁，在两种体态间局域旋转；另一类本质上是多组分的，会探索两个体畴均未占据的态。两类畴壁的实现由谷间Hund耦合与自旋-轨道耦合的竞争决定，且畴壁内部相位可耦合至超导相位差，其进动可在结上产生电压。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方石墨烯的谷极化四分之一金属相中，存在两类磁畴壁：一类类似传统磁畴壁，在两种体态间局域旋转；另一类本质上是多组分的，会探索两个体畴均未占据的态。两类畴壁的实现由谷间Hund耦合与自旋-轨道耦合的竞争决定，且畴壁内部相位可耦合至超导相位差，其进动可在结上产生电压。；创新点：首次在菱方石墨烯中揭示超出传统磁体的多组分磁畴壁，并发现其内部相位与超导输运的直接耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观模型对一维畴壁进行理论分析，研究谷间Hund耦合与自旋-轨道耦合的竞争对畴壁结构的影响，并分析超导结中相位耦合与动力学响应。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如平均场、紧束缚模型等）。

papers.title: Viscochiral Transport: Chiral Selection of Hydrodynamic Vortices by Berry Curvature
papers.abstract: We predict a new viscochiral regime of electronic transport in which spatially varying Hall viscosity selects vortical flow patterns. Although uniform Hall viscosity cannot alter incompressible bulk flow, its spatial gradient redistributes vorticity, amplifying vortices in one chamber while suppressing the vortex in the other. We further determine the underlying mechanism to be generic to recirculating flows and insensitive to the details of the device geometry. The paper maps the resulting phase diagram and shows that the regime is experimentally accessible in valley-polarized bilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：predict（预测）、maps the phase diagram（绘制相图）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：电子输运中的粘性霍尔效应（Hall viscosity）及其空间梯度导致的涡旋流动（vortical flow）现象，具体体系为谷极化的双层石墨烯（valley-polarized bilayer graphene）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间变化的霍尔粘度（即霍尔粘度的梯度）可以重新分布涡量，从而在流体腔室中选择性地放大或抑制涡旋，形成一种新的“粘手性”（viscochiral）输运 regime。该机制对再循环流动具有普适性，不依赖具体器件几何结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间变化的霍尔粘度（即霍尔粘度的梯度）可以重新分布涡量，从而在流体腔室中选择性地放大或抑制涡旋，形成一种新的“粘手性”（viscochiral）输运 regime。该机制对再循环流动具有普适性，不依赖具体器件几何结构。；创新点：首次提出均匀霍尔粘度无法改变不可压缩体流，但其空间梯度可导致涡旋的手性选择——这一机制此前未被识别，且被证明对器件几何不敏感，并预言在谷极化双层石墨烯中可实验实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导，结合相图映射（phase diagram mapping）。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如玻尔兹曼方程、流体力学模拟等），仅提及“maps the resulting phase diagram”。

papers.title: Exact analytical spectrum, eigenstates, and quantum geometry of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a guiding principle across atomic and condensed-matter physics, shaping the topological responses of Bloch bands and the stability of the correlated phases they host. Beyond two-band models, however, closed-form expressions for both the spectrum and the quantum geometry are rare. Here we provide such expressions for a paradigmatic four-band model that has recently been realized experimentally with ultracold atoms, photons and in superconducting circuits: the Harper-Hofstadter model at quarter flux, describing charged particles on a two-dimensional square lattice subjected to a uniform magnetic field. We achieve this by first showing that the model possesses a sublattice symmetry, which renders its Bloch Hamiltonian anti-block-diagonal allowing us to derive the spectrum and the eigenstates analytically. From that we also obtain closed-form expressions for the full quantum geometric tensor (QGT), including both the Berry curvature and the quantum metric, for all the bands of the model. For this purpose we first derive a general expression for the QGT for sublattice-symmetric systems in terms of contributions from the individual sublattice sectors. Finally, we evaluate fractional-Chern-insulator stability criteria analytically and quantify the lowest band of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model to be a nearly ideal Chern band.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“analytically”（解析地）、“closed-form expressions”（闭式表达式）、“derive”（推导）等关键词，核心工作是数学推导而非实验测量或数值模拟。；研究对象：四分之一磁通（quarter-flux）Harper-Hofstadter 模型。该模型描述二维正方晶格上的带电粒子在均匀磁场中的运动，是一个四能带模型，近期已在超冷原子、光子及超导电路系统中被实验实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型具有子晶格对称性，使得 Bloch 哈密顿量呈反对角块结构，从而可以解析地获得全部能带的本征谱和本征态，并进一步推导出完整的量子几何张量（包括 Berry 曲率和量子度规）的闭式表达式。基于此，作者解析地评估了分数量子霍尔（分数陈绝缘体）稳定性判据，表明该模型最低能带是近乎理想的 Chern 带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型具有子晶格对称性，使得 Bloch 哈密顿量呈反对角块结构，从而可以解析地获得全部能带的本征谱和本征态，并进一步推导出完整的量子几何张量（包括 Berry 曲率和量子度规）的闭式表达式。基于此，作者解析地评估了分数量子霍尔（分数陈绝缘体）稳定性判据，表明该模型最低能带是近乎理想的 Chern 带。；创新点：为四能带模型提供了能谱和量子几何（含 Berry 曲率与量子度规）的完整闭式解析表达式。此前闭式解多局限于两能带模型，该工作突破了这一限制，并首次将量子几何张量的解析计算推广到子晶格对称的多带系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导。具体包括：利用子晶格对称性将 Bloch 哈密顿量化为反对角块形式；推导适用于子晶格对称系统的一般量子几何张量表达式（按子晶格扇区分解）；基于解析结果计算分数陈绝缘体稳定性判据。

papers.title: Parity Anomaly as Modular Commutator with Massless Dirac Fermion
papers.abstract: The modular commutator $J(A,B,C) = i\langle[K_{AB},K_{BC}]\rangle$ extracts the chiral central charge $c_-$ from a single bulk wavefunction of a \emph{gapped} 2d state, where $3J/π=c_-$. Inspired by the recent developments in the field of gapless symmetry-protected topological phases, we ask: what does the modular commutator measure, if it is well-defined at all, when the 2d bulk becomes \textit{gapless}? Several interesting new insights can already be obtained using the simple Haldane honeycomb model. For the critical point hosting an isolated Dirac node we find that $J$ remains sharp: it converges to a \textit{half-quantized} value, with corrections that decay as a power law in the subsystem size rather than exponentially, mirroring the power-law correlations in gapless systems. We prove the half-quantization using an emergent reflection symmetry of the massless Dirac cone, and show that the half-quantized contribution comes from the other gapped cone (the massive partner of the massless one). This massive partner can be interpreted as the physical incarnation of the Pauli-Villars regulator, which is the origin of the parity-breaking level-$\frac{1}{2}$ Chern-Simons term (with half-quantized Hall conductance) and the parity anomaly. When protected chiral edge modes coexist with a bulk Dirac node we obtain $3J/π= c_-+\frac{1}{2}$. The half-quantization is also shown to be robust against tripartition deformation, tuning Dirac velocity and Dirac cone anisotropy. We further investigate other types of gaplessness---quadratic nodes (in contrast to linear Dirac) and the case with Fermi surface---and show that the robust half-quantization of $J$ is lost in such non-Dirac cases. These results generalize the modular commutator beyond gapped phases, and at the same time provide an information-theoretic measurement of the parity anomaly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（“we prove”）、模型分析（Haldane honeycomb model）以及概念性论证（modular commutator、parity anomaly），未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：二维无带隙（gapless）系统中的模交换子（modular commutator）行为，具体以Haldane蜂窝模型中的狄拉克锥（Dirac node）为研究对象，并延伸至二次节点（quadratic nodes）和费米面（Fermi surface）情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当二维体态变为无带隙且存在孤立狄拉克节点时，模交换子J仍保持尖锐（sharp），并收敛到半量子化值（half-quantized value），即3J/π = c_- + 1/2（当手性边缘模与体狄拉克节点共存时）；该半量子化来源于质量狄拉克锥（massive partner），可视为Pauli-Villars正则化的物理体现，从而为宇称反常提供了信息论度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当二维体态变为无带隙且存在孤立狄拉克节点时，模交换子J仍保持尖锐（sharp），并收敛到半量子化值（half-quantized value），即3J/π = c_- + 1/2（当手性边缘模与体狄拉克节点共存时）；该半量子化来源于质量狄拉克锥（massive partner），可视为Pauli-Villars正则化的物理体现，从而为宇称反常提供了信息论度量。；创新点：将模交换子从有能隙（gapped）相推广到无带隙（gapless）相，首次揭示其在狄拉克临界点处的半量子化行为，并将其与宇称反常（parity anomaly）和level-1/2 Chern-Simons项建立信息论联系；同时证明该半量子化对线性狄拉克节点具有鲁棒性，但对非狄拉克型无带隙（二次节点、费米面）不成立。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析证明：利用Haldane蜂窝模型，通过模交换子定义J(A,B,C) = i⟨[K_AB,K_BC]⟩，结合无质量狄拉克锥的涌现反射对称性（emergent reflection symmetry）进行半量子化的严格证明；同时考察子系统尺寸的有限尺寸标度（幂律衰减 vs 指数衰减）、三部分变形（tripartition deformation）、狄拉克速度及锥各向异性的鲁棒性，并对比二次节点和费米面情形。

papers.title: Incommensurate spin fluctuations in one-dimensional Kondo metal CeCo2Ga8
papers.abstract: We present an experimental and numerical study of the spin fluctuations in 1D Kondo metal CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$. Using inelastic neutron spectroscopy, we measure highly one-dimensional magnetism with low-energy incommensurate short-ranged magnetic fluctuations. ARPES similarly shows a highly one-dimensional electronic band structure, confirming the one-dimensional nature of the system. We use density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations of the 1D Kondo lattice model to interpret the measured spectrum, which successfully reproduce the neutron scattering features. We are thus able to place CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$ within the emergent incommensurate phase of the 1D Kondo lattice phase diagram, and demonstrate that the Kondo lattice simulated non-perturbatively is an accurate microscopic model for heavy fermion physics. This shows CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$ to be one-dimensional despite its complexities, and reveals a coexistence of low-energy Kondo and magnetic features in its inelastic spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。关键词：inelastic neutron spectroscopy（非弹性中子散射）、ARPES、DMRG simulations。；研究对象：一维近藤金属 CeCo₂Ga₈ 中的自旋涨落，特别是低能非公度短程磁涨落及其与一维电子结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeCo₂Ga₈ 尽管结构复杂，但本质上是一维体系，其低能非公度磁涨落可由一维近藤晶格模型非微扰地精确描述，且非弹性谱中同时存在低能近藤与磁性特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeCo₂Ga₈ 尽管结构复杂，但本质上是一维体系，其低能非公度磁涨落可由一维近藤晶格模型非微扰地精确描述，且非弹性谱中同时存在低能近藤与磁性特征。；创新点：首次将 CeCo₂Ga₈ 定位于一维近藤晶格相图中的非公度相，并通过非微扰DMRG模拟证明一维近藤晶格模型是重费米子物理的准确微观模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用非弹性中子散射测量磁激发谱，ARPES测量电子能带结构；数值上采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）对一维近藤晶格模型进行模拟，并与中子散射谱对比。

papers.title: Depth Control of Room-Temperature Quantum Emitters in Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: Bright quantum emitters are key components for quantum communication systems. Radiative point defects in gallium nitride (GaN) are promising candidates for room-temperature single-photon emission, operating from the visible to the telecom O-band. Despite their potential, their integration into photonic structures has remained limited in the literature, with experimental photon extraction efficiencies far below simulated predictions. To identify the origin of this limitation, we investigate visible and near-infrared quantum emitters in GaN epilayers grown on $c$-plane sapphire substrates exhibiting narrow linewidths ($\sim$4 nm), high photon count rates ($ > $2 MHz), and strong antibunching, reaching $g^{(2)}(0)$ values as low as 0.06 at room temperature. We find that these emitters are located near the GaN/substrate interface, explaining their limited coupling to optical modes. Building on this observation, we show that the insertion of a thin low-temperature GaN interlayer enables the formation of quantum emitters at arbitrary depths with sub-60 nm accuracy, independent of the substrate. The intentionally introduced emitters retain optical properties comparable to naturally occurring ones, including narrow linewidths ($\sim$6 nm), saturation count rates exceeding 1.5 MHz, high Debye-Waller factors (0.69-0.98), and strong antibunching. The resulting epilayer fully coalesces within less than 250 nm ensuring compatibility with GaN-based cavity fabrication and enabling emitter placement within intrinsic regions of p-i-n diode architectures. These results mark a decisive step toward efficient emitter-cavity coupling, enabling the realization of cavity-enhanced quantum emission in GaN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了量子发射体的制备（GaN外延层生长、低温GaN插入层）、光学表征（线宽、计数率、反聚束g²(0)测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）外延层中的室温量子发射体（可见光与近红外波段的辐射性点缺陷），及其与GaN/蓝宝石衬底界面的空间位置关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GaN中天然存在的室温量子发射体位于GaN/衬底界面附近，这限制了其与光学模式的耦合；通过插入薄低温GaN层，可在任意深度（精度优于60 nm）可控地形成光学性质与天然发射体相当的量子发射体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GaN中天然存在的室温量子发射体位于GaN/衬底界面附近，这限制了其与光学模式的耦合；通过插入薄低温GaN层，可在任意深度（精度优于60 nm）可控地形成光学性质与天然发射体相当的量子发射体。；创新点：首次揭示了GaN中天然量子发射体位于衬底界面附近这一限制耦合效率的关键原因，并提出利用低温GaN插入层实现发射体深度可控定位的方法，且发射体可置于p-i-n二极管本征区，兼容GaN基腔体制备。
papers.method_zh: 在c面蓝宝石衬底上生长GaN外延层；利用低温GaN插入层控制发射体深度；通过光致发光光谱测量线宽、饱和计数率、Debye-Waller因子，以及二阶关联函数g²(0)（反聚束测量）表征单光子发射性质。

papers.title: Topology of Fluctuation Bands in Chiral Active Matter
papers.abstract: While band topology is usually associated with the deterministic dynamics of a system, we show that it can instead reside in its fluctuations. Using a reciprocal lattice driven by nonequilibrium chiral active noise, we find that the displacement spectrum---which quantifies displacement fluctuations---admits bands with nonzero Chern numbers despite a Chern-trivial deterministic mechanics. A Haldane-like effective coupling in the correlation spectrum explains this topology and produces topological transitions controlled by both the stochastic driving and the observation frequency. Through the bulk--boundary correspondence, we find boundary-localized fluctuation modes that are distinct from the usual propagating mechanical edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：band topology、Chern numbers、bulk–boundary correspondence、理论模型分析。；研究对象：手性活性物质（chiral active matter）中的涨落带（fluctuation bands）拓扑性质，具体为受非平衡手性活性噪声驱动的倒格子（reciprocal lattice）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在确定性力学为Chern平庸的体系中，位移涨落谱（displacement spectrum）可以具有非零Chern数的拓扑带；该拓扑由关联谱中的Haldane类有效耦合产生，并可通过随机驱动强度和观测频率调控拓扑相变。体–边界对应导致边界局域的涨落模式，不同于通常的传播型力学边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在确定性力学为Chern平庸的体系中，位移涨落谱（displacement spectrum）可以具有非零Chern数的拓扑带；该拓扑由关联谱中的Haldane类有效耦合产生，并可通过随机驱动强度和观测频率调控拓扑相变。体–边界对应导致边界局域的涨落模式，不同于通常的传播型力学边缘态。；创新点：首次将带拓扑的概念从确定性动力学推广到系统的涨落（涨落谱）中，表明即使确定性力学是Chern平庸的，涨落本身也可承载非平庸拓扑，并产生与常规力学边缘态不同的边界局域涨落模式。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构建受非平衡手性活性噪声驱动的倒格子模型，计算位移涨落谱及其Chern数，引入Haldane类有效耦合解释拓扑起源，并利用体–边界对应原理分析边界涨落模式。

papers.title: Electrical manipulation of oxygen stoichiometry in multiterminal YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ junctions
papers.abstract: Local manipulation of oxygen stoichiometry offers a route to control the electronic properties of complex oxides, yet the selective modification of individual current-carrying branches through oxygen redistribution remains unexplored in multiterminal high-temperature superconducting junctions. In a YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ Y-shaped three-terminal device, we demonstrate the possibility to electrically control oxygen vacancy migration on a hand-picked terminal while largely preserving the other two. Oxygen-depleted propagating fronts are directly visualized by the resulting change in optical reflectivity and they are linked to the evolution of the electrical response. The process is highly directional and determined by the polarity of the applied current, allowing for the creation of either a converging or a diverging propagating front from the central node of the Y-shaped device. The associated changes in resistance exhibit relaxation on a timescale of minutes, driven by the vacancy concentration gradient. Effects of oxygen migration are also mapped by Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy and Scanning Laser Microscopy, which probe work-function changes and spatially resolved variations in the superconducting transition, respectively. Notably, the Tc contrast revealed by the latter provides a quantitative handle on the underlying oxygen content, enabling direct visualization of oxygen redistribution. Finite-element modeling and nanoprobe X-ray diffraction qualitatively reproduce the observed vacancy redistribution. These results establish a post-fabrication route to locally tune properties of superconducting multiterminal devices such as nanocryotrons, yTron, and tunable weak links.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了器件制备、电学测量、光学反射成像、开尔文探针力显微镜、扫描激光显微镜、纳米探针X射线衍射等实验手段，并辅以有限元建模。；研究对象：YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）Y形三端高温超导结中氧空位迁移的电控调控，以及氧化学计量比分布对超导转变温度（Tc）和电输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YBCO Y形三端器件中，通过施加极性可控的电流，能够选择性地在指定支路中驱动氧空位迁移，形成方向可控（汇聚或发散）的氧耗尽传播前沿，从而局部调控超导性质，且电阻变化在分钟量级内弛豫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YBCO Y形三端器件中，通过施加极性可控的电流，能够选择性地在指定支路中驱动氧空位迁移，形成方向可控（汇聚或发散）的氧耗尽传播前沿，从而局部调控超导性质，且电阻变化在分钟量级内弛豫。；创新点：首次在多端高温超导结中实现针对单一电流支路的氧化学计量比选择性电控修改，而其余支路基本不受影响，为超导多端器件（如纳米低温管、yTron、可调弱连接）提供了一种制备后的局域物性调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 多端电输运测量、光学反射率成像（直接可视化氧耗尽前沿）、开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM，探测功函数变化）、扫描激光显微镜（空间分辨超导转变）、纳米探针X射线衍射（验证氧空位再分布）、有限元建模（定性复现空位迁移）。

papers.title: Electron spin resonance driven photogalvanic effect in graphene-based structures
papers.abstract: We report an electron-spin-resonance-driven linear photogalvanic effect (LPGE) in unbiased monolayer graphene and WSe_2/graphene heterostructures. Under linearly polarized 45--75 GHz radiation, the photovoltage exhibits pronounced resonant features in both Faraday and Voigt geometries. Multiple resonances associated with the electron spin resonance in graphene are observed for both out-of-plane and in-plane magnetic-field orientations. Their magnetic-field positions vary linearly with frequency, their amplitudes reverse sign across the charge-neutrality point, and the resonant contribution has the opposite sign to the nonresonant Drude photogalvanic background. We develop a microscopic theory in which radiation-induced momentum alignment followed by skew scattering generates both contributions. Their opposite signs originate from the orthogonal momentum alignments produced by indirect Drude absorption and direct spin-resonant transitions. The theory describes well the main features of the observed resonant photocurrent and provides a microscopic description of ESR-induced LPGE in two-dimensional systems. These results establish the photogalvanic response as a probe of ESR in unbiased micron-scale graphene-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：摘要中既有“photovoltage exhibits pronounced resonant features”等实验观测描述，也有“We develop a microscopic theory”的理论建模内容。；研究对象：无偏置的单层石墨烯及WSe₂/石墨烯异质结构中的电子自旋共振驱动的线性光生伏特效应（LPGE），具体物理现象为在45–75 GHz线性偏振微波辐射下、Faraday和Voigt两种几何构型中由电子自旋共振（ESR）诱导的光电压响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无偏置石墨烯基器件中观测到由电子自旋共振驱动的线性光生伏特效应：光电压在磁场中呈现多重共振峰，其位置随频率线性变化、幅度在电荷中性点处反号，且共振贡献与非共振Drude光生伏特背景符号相反；理论表明该现象源于辐射诱导的动量排列与斜散射的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无偏置石墨烯基器件中观测到由电子自旋共振驱动的线性光生伏特效应：光电压在磁场中呈现多重共振峰，其位置随频率线性变化、幅度在电荷中性点处反号，且共振贡献与非共振Drude光生伏特背景符号相反；理论表明该现象源于辐射诱导的动量排列与斜散射的共同作用。；创新点：首次将光生伏特响应确立为无偏置微米尺度石墨烯器件中电子自旋共振的探测手段，并给出了ESR诱导LPGE的微观理论描述，揭示了共振与非共振贡献符号相反的物理起源。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用45–75 GHz线性偏振微波辐射，在Faraday和Voigt两种磁场几何下测量光电压随磁场的变化；理论上构建了微观模型，将辐射诱导的动量排列（momentum alignment）与斜散射（skew scattering）机制相结合，分别解释间接Drude吸收和直接自旋共振跃迁产生的正交动量排列及其符号差异。

papers.title: Oxidation-resilient structural modifications in Nickel-functionalized 3D-graphene for hydrogen storage applications
papers.abstract: Porous materials represent a versatile solution for several applications. Indeed, the recent development of a new material, named 3D-Graphene, which combines the exceptional characteristics of graphene with a three-dimensional structure, opens perspectives for applications where a high surface-to-volume ratio is beneficial. In this study, we explore the functionalization of 3D-Graphene with nickel (Ni)-nanoparticles as a strategy to enhance hydrogen storage capabilities, and we assess the influence of the NPs on hydrogen uptake and oxidation resilience. The morphology and structural properties of pristine and Ni-functionalized samples were characterized using Scanning Electron Microscopy. Additionally, X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy was employed to analyze the surface chemical composition of the functionalized samples. Samples have been hydrogenated supplying molecular or atomic hydrogen, and hydrogen storage performance was assessed through Thermal Desorption Spectroscopy. Afterwards, oxidation effects were systematically studied by exposing the samples to atmospheric oxygen, followed by further hydrogenation experiments. Our results indicate that Ni functionalization influences both hydrogen adsorption and oxidation behavior, with potential implications for improving the stability of the material, especially for hydrogen storage applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）、热脱附谱（TDS）等实验表征手段，并进行了氢化与氧化实验。；研究对象：镍（Ni）纳米颗粒功能化的三维石墨烯（3D-Graphene）材料，及其在储氢应用中的氢吸附与抗氧化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ni功能化同时影响3D-Graphene的氢吸附行为和氧化行为，有望改善材料在储氢应用中的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ni功能化同时影响3D-Graphene的氢吸附行为和氧化行为，有望改善材料在储氢应用中的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将Ni纳米颗粒功能化策略应用于新型3D-Graphene材料，并同时考察了储氢性能与抗氧化稳定性之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电子显微镜（SEM）表征形貌与结构；X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析表面化学组成；分别采用分子氢和原子氢对样品进行氢化处理；热脱附谱（TDS）评估储氢性能；将样品暴露于大气氧中系统研究氧化效应，随后再次进行氢化实验以评估抗氧化能力。

papers.title: Rare-earth oxysulfides RE$_2$O$_2$S as model mixed-anion frustrated magnets
papers.abstract: The study of low-dimensional and anisotropic magnetism is a promising avenue for the discovery of novel quantum phenomena. Mixed-anion materials, defined by the coordination of metal cations by two or more distinct anionic species, provide an intrinsically anisotropic platform for the tuning of structural, magnetic, and electronic properties. In this work, we report the synthesis and characterization of a family of rare-earth oxysulfide (RE$_2$O$_2$S) antiferromagnets (AFM) possessing a triangular-bilayer slab lattice geometry. Long-range AFM order is observed for the majority of compositions, with several (RE = Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm) having been previously unreported. Although assumed to form stoichiometrically, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis provides evidence for significant, synthesis-dependent interslab structural disorder as RE$_2$O$_{2+x}$S$_{1-x}$, resulting in significant variability in the bulk magnetic response of the Nd member. This work highlights the tunability of frustrated magnetic ground states in rare-earth-based mixed-anion materials, and the importance of thorough structural characterization in the discovery of new mixed-anion magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“synthesis and characterization”（合成与表征），并使用了“pair distribution function (PDF) analysis”（对分布函数分析）等实验手段。；研究对象：稀土氧硫化物 RE₂O₂S（RE = Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm 等）家族，一种具有三角双层（triangular-bilayer）晶格几何的混合阴离子（mixed-anion）反铁磁材料，属于低维、各向异性阻挫磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多数 RE₂O₂S 组分表现出长程反铁磁有序，其中 Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm 组分的反铁磁序此前未见报道；PDF 分析揭示该材料实际存在显著的、依赖合成条件的层间结构无序（RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ），这种无序导致 Nd 组分的宏观磁响应出现明显可变性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多数 RE₂O₂S 组分表现出长程反铁磁有序，其中 Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm 组分的反铁磁序此前未见报道；PDF 分析揭示该材料实际存在显著的、依赖合成条件的层间结构无序（RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ），这种无序导致 Nd 组分的宏观磁响应出现明显可变性。；创新点：首次系统报道了多个稀土氧硫化物（Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm）的反铁磁有序，并将该材料家族确立为混合阴离子阻挫磁体的模型体系；同时强调 PDF 结构表征在发现新混合阴离子磁体中的关键作用——揭示了看似化学计量比样品中隐藏的层间无序及其对磁性的显著影响。
papers.method_zh: 多晶样品的合成与表征；磁性质测量（用于确定反铁磁有序）；对分布函数（PDF）分析（用于探测局域结构无序，揭示非化学计量比 RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ 的存在）。

papers.title: Symmetry Origins of the Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect in the Kagome Superconductor CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: Field-free superconducting diode effects require both inversion-symmetry breaking and an internal time-reversal-symmetry (TRS) breaking field, making them sensitive probes of hidden order in superconductors. In centrosymmetric kagome AV$_3$Sb$_5$, the inversion symmetry generally should generally preclude the observation of the superconducting diode effect. Furthermore, though TRS breaking has been reported in the superconducting regime of CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, whether it is generated by superconductivity or inherited from charge-density-wave (CDW) order remains unresolved. Here we show that pristine CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ devices exhibit no intrinsic field-free superconducting diode effect, whereas surface oxidation or asymmetric etching activates a large nonreciprocal supercurrent. Moreover, the response is stochastic, with sweep-dependent polarity and magnitude, indicating metastable TRS-breaking domain configurations. Small out-of-plane magnetic fields stabilize the superconducting diode response, consistent with field selection of such domains. Finally, when long-range CDW order is suppressed by Ti doping, the SDE disappears. Our results establish the symmetry requirements for the field-free SDE in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, reveal its stochastic domain-controlled character, and link superconducting-state TRS breaking to CDW-related order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了器件制备（表面氧化、非对称刻蚀）、输运测量（超导二极管效应、磁场依赖）等实验内容。；研究对象：笼目超导体 CsV₃Sb₅ 中的无外场超导二极管效应（SDE），及其与电荷密度波（CDW）序、时间反演对称性破缺（TRS）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始 CsV₃Sb₅ 器件不显示本征无外场 SDE，但表面氧化或非对称刻蚀可激活大的非互易超流；该响应具有随机性（极性和大小随扫描历史变化），表明存在亚稳态 TRS 破缺畴构型。Ti 掺杂抑制长程 CDW 序后 SDE 消失，说明超导态 TRS 破缺与 CDW 相关序有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始 CsV₃Sb₅ 器件不显示本征无外场 SDE，但表面氧化或非对称刻蚀可激活大的非互易超流；该响应具有随机性（极性和大小随扫描历史变化），表明存在亚稳态 TRS 破缺畴构型。Ti 掺杂抑制长程 CDW 序后 SDE 消失，说明超导态 TRS 破缺与 CDW 相关序有关。；创新点：首次系统阐明 CsV₃Sb₅ 中无外场 SDE 的对称性要求，揭示其随机畴控制特性，并将超导态 TRS 破缺与 CDW 相关序直接关联。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（超导二极管效应检测）、器件表面处理（氧化、非对称刻蚀）、小面外磁场调控、Ti 掺杂对比实验。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization for Self-Driving Materials Laboratories: From Algorithms to Physics-Informed Workflows
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming materials research by closing the loop among synthesis, characterization, data analysis and experimental decision making. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a decision engine for these loops because it can select experiments from scarce and noisy data while balancing exploitation and exploration. Yet real materials campaigns often depart from the standard black-box setting, involving failed or missing experiments, noise and drift, mixed variables, constraints, multiple objectives, variable cost and fidelity, transfer from historical data, batch or asynchronous operation, and prior physics knowledge. This review presents BO for materials SDLs through the lens of these practical challenges. We summarize Gaussian-process-based BO and the formulation of materials goals as quantitative objectives, then discuss major choices in surrogate modelling and acquisition. Particular emphasis is placed on physics-informed Bayesian optimization (PIBO), in which domain knowledge enters through representations, priors, kernels, acquisition functions, and constraints. We survey achievements enabled by BO and related active-learning approaches across semiconductors, catalysis, chemical reactions, batteries, alloys, functional materials and quantum materials, highlighting advances beyond parameter optimization, including new materials and synthesis routes, improved functional performance, and reusable scientific knowledge. We conclude by outlining open problems for BO-driven materials SDLs, including nonstationarity, multimodal observations, adaptive problem formulation, and scientific reasoning by humans, large language models and research agents. Addressing these challenges may advance SDLs beyond efficient optimization toward interpretable and knowledge-generating experimentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述文章）。判断依据：摘要明确为“This review presents...”，属于文献综述，涵盖算法、实验工作流及物理知识融合，非单一实验或计算研究。；研究对象：材料科学中的“自驱动实验室”（SDLs）体系，具体涉及半导体、催化、化学反应、电池、合金、功能材料及量子材料等材料体系，以及贝叶斯优化（BO）作为决策引擎的闭环实验流程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是自驱动实验室中处理稀疏、含噪数据并平衡探索与利用的关键决策引擎；物理信息贝叶斯优化（PIBO）通过将领域知识嵌入表示、先验、核函数、采集函数和约束中，可显著提升材料发现效率，并已实现超越参数优化的成果（如新材料、新合成路线、功能性能提升及可复用科学知识）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：贝叶斯优化（BO）是自驱动实验室中处理稀疏、含噪数据并平衡探索与利用的关键决策引擎；物理信息贝叶斯优化（PIBO）通过将领域知识嵌入表示、先验、核函数、采集函数和约束中，可显著提升材料发现效率，并已实现超越参数优化的成果（如新材料、新合成路线、功能性能提升及可复用科学知识）。；创新点：以“实际材料实验偏离标准黑箱设置”为视角（如失败/缺失实验、噪声漂移、混合变量、约束、多目标、变成本/保真度、历史数据迁移、批/异步操作、先验物理知识），系统梳理BO在材料SDLs中的挑战与解决方案；特别强调PIBO作为融合物理知识的工作流范式，并指出未来开放问题（非平稳性、多模态观测、自适应问题表述、人类/大语言模型/研究代理的科学推理）。
papers.method_zh: 高斯过程（Gaussian process）为基础的贝叶斯优化框架；系统讨论了替代模型（surrogate modelling）与采集函数（acquisition）的主要选择；重点综述了物理信息贝叶斯优化（PIBO）中领域知识的嵌入方式（表示、先验、核、采集函数、约束）；并涵盖主动学习（active learning）相关方法。

papers.title: Watching a GaN Transistor Switch: Real-Time Nanoscale Strain and Heat Dynamics
papers.abstract: Digital and energy technologies depend on microelectromechanical and power electronic components whose performance is critically impacted by rapid, cyclic deformations. Real-time information on their operation has remained inaccessible due to the need for nanosecond and nanometer resolution in fully integrated devices. We break this limitation by imaging the complete switching cycle of an industrial GaN high electron mobility transistor through stroboscopic dark field X ray microscopy at a fourth-generation synchrotron, resolving electromechanical and thermal micro strain fields across the entire device and correlating them with time dependent voltage characteristics. Coupled simulations benchmarked against the measurements reproduce electric field evolution and transient thermal hotspots. This combined approach provides direct insight into device physics and informs design strategies for next generation energy and information processing technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合仿真模拟的混合类型）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“imaging……through stroboscopic dark field X ray microscopy at a fourth-generation synchrotron”（实验手段），以及“Coupled simulations benchmarked against the measurements”（实验与仿真结合）。；研究对象：工业级氮化镓（GaN）高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）在完整开关循环中的电-机械与热微应变场动态，以及瞬态热点的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过第四代同步辐射源的频闪暗场X射线显微镜，首次实现了对工业GaN晶体管完整开关周期中纳米级应变与热动力学的实时成像，并将测得的微应变场与时间相关电压特性直接关联，揭示了电场演化与瞬态热点的对应关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过第四代同步辐射源的频闪暗场X射线显微镜，首次实现了对工业GaN晶体管完整开关周期中纳米级应变与热动力学的实时成像，并将测得的微应变场与时间相关电压特性直接关联，揭示了电场演化与瞬态热点的对应关系。；创新点：突破了在完全集成器件中同时需要纳秒时间分辨率和纳米空间分辨率的限制，首次实现对工业级功率器件完整开关循环中电-机械与热微应变场的实时全域成像，并将实验测量与仿真直接对标以指导器件设计。（摘要中未突出其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用频闪暗场X射线显微镜（stroboscopic dark field X-ray microscopy）在第四代同步辐射源上成像；理论上采用与实验基准对照的耦合仿真（coupled simulations），用于重现电场演化与瞬态热斑。

papers.title: Landau Theory for Commensurate Charge-Density Waves Coupled to Uniform Lattice Deformation
papers.abstract: We formulate a minimal Landau theory for a charge-density wave (CDW) whose commensurability is defined with respect to a deformed lattice. The motivation is provided by recent observations on an isolated single NbS$_3$ chain, which exhibits a commensurate CDW state accompanied by a $6\%$ shrinkage of the lattice constant. A uniform stretch $a_0\to a_0(1+\varepsilon)$ changes the reciprocal lattice wave number to $G(\varepsilon)=G_0/(1+\varepsilon)$, so that an $N$-fold commensurate CDW has the wave number $Q_\mathrm{C}(\varepsilon)=G(\varepsilon)/N$, whereas the wave number $Q_\mathrm{IC}$ favored by the incommensurate instability remains fixed. We propose an amplitude-strain free energy for both $N=3$ and $N=4$, in which the CDW induces a finite uniform strain by relieving the mismatch between $Q_\mathrm{C}(\varepsilon)$ and $Q_\mathrm{IC}$. The mismatch is shared between the CDW and the lattice in a proportion set by their stiffness ratio; since the CDW stiffness grows with the CDW amplitude, the lattice takes up an increasing share of the mismatch as the CDW develops. Our results suggest a reexamination of lock-in theories and of strain-tuning experiments on density-wave systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We formulate a minimal Landau theory”（构建最小朗道理论），属于理论建模与自由能分析。；研究对象：准一维电荷密度波（CDW）体系，具体以孤立单链NbS₃为动机，研究公度CDW与均匀晶格形变（晶格常数收缩6%）之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CDW与晶格之间的失配（公度波矢与不稳定波矢之差）由两者共同分担，分担比例取决于刚度比；由于CDW刚度随其振幅增大而增大，晶格在CDW发展过程中承担越来越多的失配份额，从而诱导出有限均匀应变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CDW与晶格之间的失配（公度波矢与不稳定波矢之差）由两者共同分担，分担比例取决于刚度比；由于CDW刚度随其振幅增大而增大，晶格在CDW发展过程中承担越来越多的失配份额，从而诱导出有限均匀应变。；创新点：将公度性定义在形变后的晶格上（而非固定晶格），从而在朗道理论框架内自然引入CDW诱导的均匀晶格应变，并揭示失配分担机制；摘要指出该结果对传统锁相（lock-in）理论和应变调控实验提出重新审视。
papers.method_zh: 构建包含CDW振幅与均匀应变自由能的最小朗道理论，分别针对N=3和N=4两种公度阶数进行分析，通过比较公度波矢Q_C(ε)与非公度不稳定波矢Q_IC的失配来推导应变响应。

papers.title: Fluxtube Bouquets and Type-1.5 Clustering in Superfluid Neutron Star Cores
papers.abstract: We study mesoscopic configurations of a neutron superfluid coupled to a proton superconductor in the outer core of a neutron star. The condensates are described by a two-component Ginzburg-Landau free energy with local couplings, neglecting genuine phase-gradient entrainment. In two spatial dimensions, we minimize the free energy using quasi-periodic boundary conditions and constrained phase-imprinting calculations to study vortex-fluxtube and fluxtube-fluxtube interactions. We find that, for locally attractive couplings in the free energy, vortex-fluxtube overlap is energetically favoured and several pre-existing proton fluxtubes can bind around a neutron vortex, forming finite vortex-centred aggregates that we call fluxtube bouquets. These bouquet configurations may become so dense that a vortex can effectively accommodate several quanta of magnetic flux. We also confirm the possible presence of a type-1.5-like regime and find that it survives in the zero-entrainment regime considered here. In this type-1.5 regime, the fluxtube-fluxtube interaction is repulsive at short distances and attractive at intermediate distances, leading to self-assembled clusters while the individual fluxtubes remain topologically distinct. Possible implications for dissipative coupling and transport in neutron stars are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“用Ginzburg-Landau自由能描述”“最小化自由能”“准周期边界条件和约束相位印记计算”，属于凝聚态理论建模与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：中子星外核中的中子超流体与质子超导体耦合体系，具体研究其中的涡旋-磁通管（vortex-fluxtube）及磁通管-磁通管相互作用，以及由此形成的介观磁通结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域吸引耦合下，涡旋-磁通管重叠在能量上有利，多个质子磁通管可围绕一个中子涡旋结合形成“磁通管花束”（fluxtube bouquets）；该体系存在type-1.5超导态，磁通管间短程排斥、中程吸引，导致自组装团簇而单个磁通管保持拓扑独立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域吸引耦合下，涡旋-磁通管重叠在能量上有利，多个质子磁通管可围绕一个中子涡旋结合形成“磁通管花束”（fluxtube bouquets）；该体系存在type-1.5超导态，磁通管间短程排斥、中程吸引，导致自组装团簇而单个磁通管保持拓扑独立。；创新点：首次提出“磁通管花束”这一涡旋-磁通管聚集构型，并证明在零纠缠（zero-entrainment）极限下type-1.5类超导态仍然存在，扩展了该机制在中子星物质中的适用性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用两分量Ginzburg-Landau自由能（含局域耦合，忽略相位梯度纠缠效应），在二维空间中利用准周期边界条件和约束相位印记（constrained phase-imprinting）计算，通过自由能最小化研究涡旋与磁通管的相互作用构型。

papers.title: Size and Impurity Effects on Scattering of Valley Hall Modes in Gate-Defined Bilayer Graphene Superlattices
papers.abstract: In the present paper we perform a tight-binding simulation of gate-defined islands in Bernal bilayer graphene (BLG). The inversion of the gap sign on the boundaries of the islands creates topologically-protected valley Hall modes. We focus on the specific questions of whether the valley Hall modes around such islands could serve as a host for quantum walks or simulate weakly coupled systems, and how their tunneling is affected by in-gap impurities. In addition, we discuss the effect of misalignment of top and bottom gate patterns on the tunneling properties between islands. Our main results show that resonant tunneling via an impurity enhances overlap between superlattice islands, while misalignment does not break topological protection over a wide parameter regime. In addition, we study the two-island geometry and show that it is possible to leverage suppressed scattering to place islands more densely on a single sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“tight-binding simulation”（紧束缚模拟）。；研究对象：栅极定义的双层石墨烯（Bernal bilayer graphene, BLG）超晶格中的谷霍尔（valley Hall）模式，具体研究岛状结构边界上的拓扑保护边界态及其散射行为，以及杂质和栅极错位对隧穿的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过杂质态的共振隧穿可以增强超晶格岛之间的耦合（重叠），而上下栅极图案的错位在较宽参数范围内不会破坏拓扑保护；此外，在双岛几何中可利用抑制的散射将岛更密集地排布在同一块样品上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过杂质态的共振隧穿可以增强超晶格岛之间的耦合（重叠），而上下栅极图案的错位在较宽参数范围内不会破坏拓扑保护；此外，在双岛几何中可利用抑制的散射将岛更密集地排布在同一块样品上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于系统研究了谷霍尔模式作为量子行走或弱耦合系统载体的可行性，并首次探讨了栅极错位和带隙内杂质对岛间隧穿的具体影响。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚（tight-binding）模拟方法，对Bernal双层石墨烯中栅极定义的岛状结构进行数值计算，研究谷霍尔模式的隧穿性质。

papers.title: Current fluctuations in a gas of active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles
papers.abstract: We investigate the statistics of the time-integrated current in an infinite one-dimensional gas of independent active Ornstein--Uhlenbeck particles, as a model system for studying an active generalisation of the corresponding passive (diffusive) phenomenology. Unlike the latter, where current fluctuations exhibit universal sub-diffusive scaling, active systems display diffusive, super-diffusive, and sub-diffusive regimes over different time scales. We fully characterise the distribution of current in terms of large-deviation asymptotics, showing that all of these scaling regimes are described by a single scaled cumulant generating function. Moreover, the statistics retain a dependence on the initial condition even at large times, revealing a persistent memory of the initial state. We further obtain the joint large-deviation statistics of currents measured at two distinct times, characterising temporal correlations. Our analytical predictions are verified using rare-event importance sampling, which resolves probabilities as small as $10^{-1000}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate the statistics、large-deviation asymptotics、analytical predictions。；研究对象：一维无限长气体中相互独立的活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子（active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles）体系中的时间积分电流涨落统计，作为活性物质中对应被动（扩散）现象学的推广模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子系统中的电流涨落不再像被动扩散系统那样具有普适的次扩散标度，而是在不同时间尺度上分别表现出扩散、超扩散和次扩散三种标度行为；且电流统计在大时间极限下仍依赖初始条件，表现出对初始态的持续记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子系统中的电流涨落不再像被动扩散系统那样具有普适的次扩散标度，而是在不同时间尺度上分别表现出扩散、超扩散和次扩散三种标度行为；且电流统计在大时间极限下仍依赖初始条件，表现出对初始态的持续记忆。；创新点：首次在活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子气体中完整刻画了电流涨落的多时间尺度标度行为，并证明所有标度区由单一标度累积生成函数统一描述；同时揭示了活性系统中电流统计对初始条件的持久记忆效应，以及两个时刻电流的联合大偏差统计。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：大偏差（large-deviation）渐近分析，推导统一的标度累积生成函数（scaled cumulant generating function）；同时推导两个不同时刻电流的联合大偏差统计以刻画时间关联。数值验证采用稀有事件重要性采样（rare-event importance sampling），可解析概率小至 \(10^{-1000}\) 的事件。

papers.title: Switchable heavy-hole/light-hole spin qubit
papers.abstract: Compressively strained Ge quantum wells in planar SiGe/Ge heterostructures are the state-of-the-art platform for hole spin qubits. While they exhibit robust coherence times, they possess weak intrinsic spin-orbit interaction (SOI) due to the heavy-hole (HH) character of the wavefunction. Recently, light-hole (LH) qubits were proposed in GeSn/Ge heterostructures, offering strong, intrinsic, linear-in-momentum SOI. In this work, we propose a switchable HH-LH spin qubit in a bilayer Ge heterostructure with SiGeSn barriers, combining the advantages of HH and LH devices. The character of the qubit can be changed by shuttling from an LH well to an HH well, which also enables fast, hopping-based single-qubit rotations. Additionally, we observe an HH-LH resonance introduced by the in-plane confinement, resulting in $g$-factor peaks and first-order charge noise sweet spots. Our calculations reveal a sweet spot with Rabi frequencies on the order of 100 MHz, comparable to the LH regime, but with a more than tenfold increase in coherence time, on the order of 100 $μ$s.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we propose”“Our calculations reveal”等表述，且未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：双层Ge异质结构中的空穴自旋量子比特，具体为具有SiGeSn势垒的Ge双层结构，研究重空穴（HH）与轻空穴（LH）可切换的自旋量子比特及其自旋轨道耦合、g因子和电荷噪声特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可在重空穴与轻空穴之间切换的自旋量子比特，通过在不同量子阱之间穿梭实现快速单比特旋转，并发现面内限制引入的HH-LH共振可产生g因子峰和一阶电荷噪声甜点，在该甜点处Rabi频率约100 MHz，相干时间约100 μs，比纯LH方案提高十倍以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可在重空穴与轻空穴之间切换的自旋量子比特，通过在不同量子阱之间穿梭实现快速单比特旋转，并发现面内限制引入的HH-LH共振可产生g因子峰和一阶电荷噪声甜点，在该甜点处Rabi频率约100 MHz，相干时间约100 μs，比纯LH方案提高十倍以上。；创新点：首次提出在双层Ge/SiGeSn异质结构中实现可切换的HH-LH自旋量子比特，通过穿梭操作同时获得LH的强线性自旋轨道耦合（用于快速操控）和HH的长相干时间，并利用面内限制产生的HH-LH共振实现电荷噪声甜点。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与建模。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如k·p微扰、紧束缚或DFT等），但涉及量子阱能带结构、自旋轨道耦合、g因子张量、Rabi频率和电荷噪声的理论计算。

papers.title: Residual semi-crystalline particles released during enzymatic degradation of plastics
papers.abstract: Enzymatic recycling of plastics is limited by the presence of semi-crystalline spherulites that are recalcitrant to enzymatic depolymerization. Depending on the quality of the waste stream and its treatment history, a large volume fraction of the material actually remains in form of connected clusters of such spherulites. We build on a recently published numeric method to predict the number, the connectivity, and the morphology of these clusters as an outcome of enzymatic degradation. When applied to PET waste, our method predicts that the resulting aggregates are loosely connected, "fluffy" structures with a high surface-to-volume ratio, accompanied by smaller clusters following a continuous size distribution. By providing a quantitative framework for understanding the microparticle production during the depolymerization, these findings should assist choosing a suitable downstream treatment, such as filtering or flocculation. This work could thus help to advance the enzymatic depolymerization technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“build on a recently published numeric method to predict...”，即基于数值方法进行预测。；研究对象：塑料（特别是PET废料）在酶促降解过程中释放出的残余半结晶球晶颗粒及其聚集体的结构特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 酶促降解PET废料后，残余的半结晶球晶聚集体呈松散连接的“蓬松”结构，具有高表面积-体积比，并伴随尺寸连续分布的小团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：酶促降解PET废料后，残余的半结晶球晶聚集体呈松散连接的“蓬松”结构，具有高表面积-体积比，并伴随尺寸连续分布的小团簇。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法（基于已发表的数值方法），用于预测酶促降解过程中球晶聚集体的数量、连通性和形貌。

papers.title: Topological phases of a generalised tripartite Haldane model
papers.abstract: We present a generalised tripartite Haldane model with a complex nearest neighbour hopping parameter. The total magnetic flux through the primitive unit cell, which consists of three hexagonal unit cells is zero, and thus the model has the structure of a loop-current model. We calculate topological phase diagrams of the Chern numbers as a function of the phases of the nearest and next-nearest neighbour hopping parameters for a fixed ratio of the magnitude of the hopping parameters. We show that, unlike the Haldane model, the topological phase diagram of this model is very complex, but some aspects can still be dealt with analytically. Furthermore, the Chern numbers of the topological phases are as large as $7$ in absolute value. The analysis is supported by explicit expressions for energy bands crossing at high symmetry points in the Brillouin zone, which show as linear phase boundaries in the phase diagram. We show that such lines explain many features in the topological phase diagrams. Finally, we analyse a few representative examples of the nature of level crossings away from high symmetry and their evolution with model parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：present a model、calculate topological phase diagrams、analytically、explicit expressions。；研究对象：广义三方Haldane模型（generalised tripartite Haldane model），即由三个六角原胞组成复合原胞、具有复数最近邻跃迁参数的晶格模型，属于拓扑能带体系中的Chern绝缘体/loop-current模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型的拓扑相图远比原始Haldane模型复杂，Chern数绝对值最大可达7；相图中许多线性相边界可由高对称点处能带交叉的解析表达式解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型的拓扑相图远比原始Haldane模型复杂，Chern数绝对值最大可达7；相图中许多线性相边界可由高对称点处能带交叉的解析表达式解释。；创新点：将Haldane模型推广到三组分复合原胞结构，在总磁通为零的loop-current框架下揭示了远比原始模型复杂的拓扑相图，并发现高达|C|=7的大Chern数拓扑相；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：通过Chern数计算拓扑相图（作为最近邻和次近邻跃迁相位函数，固定跃迁幅度比值）；利用布里渊区高对称点处能带交叉的显式表达式进行解析分析；并对高对称点以外的能级交叉性质及其随参数演化进行了代表性案例分析。

papers.title: Light-Hole Spin Qubits in Strained SiGe Lattice-Matched to Ge
papers.abstract: Strained germanium ($\varepsilon$-Ge) quantum wells on metamorphic SiGe buffers have enabled advanced hole-based spin qubit devices. Alternatively, unstrained Ge with lattice-matched strained silicon-germanium ($\varepsilon$-SiGe) barriers eliminates the need for metamorphic buffers altogether. The ground state character of both these platforms is predominantly heavy-hole (HH) with a largely anisotropic spin response. We propose and study an alternative heterostructure, lattice-matched to Ge, in which both the SiGe quantum well and barriers are tensile strained, with their composition contrast providing the band offset for confinement and the tensile strain stabilizing a light-hole (LH) ground state. We show large spin-orbit coupling (SOC), both linear and cubic, along with a significantly more isotropic spin response compared to strained HH qubits. We also study the decoherence properties of the proposed device, showing an appreciable gain in the quality factor compared to their HH counterparts. Finally, we propose a bilayer heterostructure that allows for electrical switching between HH and LH ground state character.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“We propose and study”“We show”“We also study”等表述，属于理论设计与数值计算研究，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：晶格匹配于Ge的应变SiGe异质结构中的**轻空穴（LH）自旋量子比特**。具体为：在Ge衬底上，SiGe量子阱与势垒均受张应变，通过组分差异提供限制势，张应变稳定LH基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该LH自旋量子比特体系具有**大且各向同性显著改善的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC，含线性和立方项）**，其自旋响应比传统应变重空穴（HH）量子比特更各向同性；同时其退相干性质优于HH对应体系，**品质因子有明显提升**。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该LH自旋量子比特体系具有**大且各向同性显著改善的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC，含线性和立方项）**，其自旋响应比传统应变重空穴（HH）量子比特更各向同性；同时其退相干性质优于HH对应体系，**品质因子有明显提升**。；创新点：首次提出并系统研究**以张应变稳定LH基态、晶格匹配于Ge的SiGe异质结构**作为自旋量子比特平台，克服了传统应变Ge平台需metamorphic缓冲层且自旋响应高度各向异性的缺点；同时提出**电场可切换HH/LH基态的双层结构**，为自旋量子比特的灵活操控提供了新方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：基于能带工程设计异质结构，计算自旋-轨道耦合系数（线性和立方项）、自旋响应各向异性、退相干性质（品质因子），并设计双层异质结构实现电场调控HH/LH基态切换。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如k·p、DFT等）。

papers.title: Mass-anisotropy driven stripe pattern formation and directional modulational instability in polariton condensate
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experimental advances toward electrical control of the effective mass and the realization of anisotropic mass distributions, we investigate the impact of mass anisotropy on driven-dissipative polariton condensates, focusing on modulational instability, pattern formation, and the collective dynamics of the emergent patterns. We show that unequal effective masses along the two orthogonal directions induce stripe pattern formation in an exciton-polariton condensate pumped by a non-resonant Gaussian laser beam above a critical mass ratio. A Bogoliubov analysis of the homogeneously pumped system reveals that mass anisotropy leaves the modulational-instability criteria unchanged but reshapes the unstable-mode dispersion by reducing the most unstable wave- length along the direction of larger effective mass with increasing mass ratio. This introduces an anisotropy-controlled length scale for pattern selection. When the pump width becomes comparable to the most unstable wavelength, the condensate becomes modulationally unstable and develops stripe patterns along the direction of larger effective mass, accompanied by particle-number fluctua- tions and center-of-mass oscillations along the same direction. As the pump width increases further, the stripes become distorted and develop spatial irregularities during the time evolution, indicative of modulational instability. Nevertheless, the anisotropic mass distribution preserves a pronounced directional preference, in contrast to the fully disordered patterns observed in the isotropic-mass case. Our results identify mass anisotropy as a key control parameter for directional modulational instability and pattern formation in nonequilibrium polariton condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Bogoliubov analysis”（Bogoliubov分析）、“investigate the impact”（理论探究）等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：非共振高斯激光泵浦下的激子-极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate），重点研究有效质量各向异性（mass anisotropy）对调制不稳定性、条纹图案形成及集体动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个正交方向的有效质量不等且超过临界质量比时，极化激元凝聚体会形成条纹图案；质量各向异性不改变调制不稳定性的判据，但会重塑不稳定模的色散关系——沿较大有效质量方向的最不稳定波长随质量比增大而减小，从而引入各向异性控制的图案选择长度尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个正交方向的有效质量不等且超过临界质量比时，极化激元凝聚体会形成条纹图案；质量各向异性不改变调制不稳定性的判据，但会重塑不稳定模的色散关系——沿较大有效质量方向的最不稳定波长随质量比增大而减小，从而引入各向异性控制的图案选择长度尺度。；创新点：首次提出将质量各向异性作为非平衡极化激元凝聚体中方向性调制不稳定性和图案形成的关键控制参数，揭示了与各向同性质量情形下完全无序图案不同的、具有显著方向偏好的条纹结构。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方案的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov线性稳定性分析（对均匀泵浦系统），结合非共振高斯激光泵浦下的驱动-耗散极化激元凝聚体理论模型，通过数值模拟研究泵浦宽度与最不稳定波长可比时的图案形成与时间演化。

papers.title: Fate of the non-Abelian Moore-Read manifold under the non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: We study a non-Abelian Moore-Read fractional Chern insulator under a translation-preserving, nonreciprocal deformation that generates the non-Hermitian skin effect under open boundaries. The model combines the imaginary-gauge Hatano-Nelson deformation with a kagome-lattice three-body interaction designed to stabilize Moore-Read order at $ν=1/2$. Our primary diagnostic is the biorthogonal $(2,4)$-admissible particle-entanglement counting of the sixfold Moore-Read manifold, the standard Moore-Read fingerprint. Across three sizes ($N=16,20,24$), the counting locks to the clean references 1308, 3965, and 9282 over finite nonreciprocity windows through $γ\le0.55$, $0.65$, and $0.74$, respectively, with positive reference-rank entanglement gaps. Within every reported window the count is unchanged by the spectral readings tested; at $N=16$ it is also unchanged across three reduced density operators, with all 15 combinations returning 1308. The sixfold pattern for even $N_f$ and the adiabatically tracked Ising-odd doublet remain separated over the tested range $γ\le0.6$. Beyond a geometry-dependent threshold the instantaneous-lowest-six reference-rank gap drops sharply and its counting destabilizes. At $N=24$ a sector-0 branch pair becomes complex conjugate over a narrow interval inside the delocking bracket; both continuations through the interval are delocked at the tested PES points $γ=0.76$, $0.77$, and $0.80$. A same-lattice Abelian $ν=1/3$ Laughlin realization retains its counting to $γ=1.0$, so its counting is the more robust. On the torus the eigenstates remain extended; under open boundaries the right and left states skin-localize at opposite edges while the biorthogonal particle-entanglement spectrum is invariant under the imaginary-gauge similarity, so the torus and the open cylinder probe the same deformation under periodic and open boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及模型构建、数值计算（粒子纠缠谱计数）、非厄米哈密顿量分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米趋肤效应下的非阿贝尔Moore-Read分数量子霍尔态（分数陈绝缘体），具体为kagome晶格上ν=1/2的Moore-Read序，以及同晶格上ν=1/3的Laughlin态作为对照。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限非互易强度窗口内（γ≤0.55、0.65、0.74，分别对应N=16、20、24），Moore-Read六重简并流形的双正交粒子纠缠计数锁定到干净参考值（1308、3965、9282），表明非厄米趋肤效应下Moore-Read拓扑序仍可存活；但超过几何依赖的阈值后计数失稳。相比之下，Abelian Laughlin态的计数在γ=1.0仍保持，更为鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限非互易强度窗口内（γ≤0.55、0.65、0.74，分别对应N=16、20、24），Moore-Read六重简并流形的双正交粒子纠缠计数锁定到干净参考值（1308、3965、9282），表明非厄米趋肤效应下Moore-Read拓扑序仍可存活；但超过几何依赖的阈值后计数失稳。相比之下，Abelian Laughlin态的计数在γ=1.0仍保持，更为鲁棒。；创新点：首次系统研究了非阿贝尔Moore-Read态在非厄米趋肤效应下的命运，揭示了拓扑序在有限非互易窗口内的存活及其几何依赖的失稳阈值，并对比了Abelian与non-Abelian态对非厄米形变的鲁棒性差异。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型结合了虚规范Hatano-Nelson非互易形变与kagome晶格三体相互作用；主要诊断工具为双正交(2,4)-可容许粒子纠缠计数（Moore-Read指纹）；计算了三种尺寸（N=16,20,24）的纠缠谱、参考秩纠缠隙、谱读数与约化密度算子依赖性；在环面与开边界圆柱两种几何下对比了本征态扩展性与趋肤局域化，并利用虚规范相似变换分析纠缠谱不变性。

papers.title: Semi-localized ground state in a 1D system with long-range hopping
papers.abstract: We study the localization of a quantum particle in a one-dimensional disordered system with long-range hopping amplitudes $t(r)\propto r^{-a}$. In contrast to the standard one-dimensional Anderson model ($a\to\infty$), in which all states are localized and the localization length is minimal at the band edge, the long-range model with $1<a<3/2$ exhibits a disorder-driven transition at the band edge, while high-energy states remain localized at arbitrary disorder strength. We investigate this transition for the ground state in momentum space. In the weak-disorder regime, we derive perturbative expressions for the characteristic functions and moments of the momentum-space wave function, as well as for its fractal dimensions. Our results demonstrate that the ground state exhibits $\it semilocalization$ rather than conventional localization, thereby extending the class of models displaying the unusual $\it semifractality$ of wave functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We investigate”“we derive perturbative expressions”等理论推导表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维具有长程跳跃（跳跃振幅 \(t(r)\propto r^{-a}\)）的无序量子系统中的单粒子局域化问题，特别关注基态在动量空间中的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当长程跳跃指数满足 \(1<a<3/2\) 时，系统在带边出现由无序驱动的转变，而高能态在任意无序强度下仍保持局域化；基态表现出“半局域化”（semilocalization）而非传统局域化，属于“半分形”（semifractality）波函数这一非寻常类别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当长程跳跃指数满足 \(1<a<3/2\) 时，系统在带边出现由无序驱动的转变，而高能态在任意无序强度下仍保持局域化；基态表现出“半局域化”（semilocalization）而非传统局域化，属于“半分形”（semifractality）波函数这一非寻常类别。；创新点：将“半局域化/半分形”这一非传统波函数行为推广到具有长程跳跃的一维无序系统，扩展了展示半分形波函数的模型类别。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：针对弱无序区域，对动量空间波函数的特征函数、矩以及分形维度进行了微扰展开推导；并与标准一维安德森模型（\(a\to\infty\)）进行对比。

papers.title: Quasi two dimensional magnetic structure of the triclinic double perovskite Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$
papers.abstract: We present the antiferromagnetic ground state of the triclinic double perovskite Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$solved by neutron powder diffraction, and analyze it in direct comparison with tetragonal Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$. Below $T_\mathrm{N} \simeq 32$ K, the magnetic Bragg reflections of Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$ are indexed by the commensurate propagation vector $\mathbf{k}=(\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{1}{2},0)$ in its native $P\bar{1}$ cell. Rietveld refinement yields a collinear structure with equal-magnitude, antiparallel moments on the crystallographically inequivalent Cu1 and Cu2 sites and an ordered moment of $0.66(3)~μ_{\mathrm B}$ per Cu at 1.5 K. A direct comparison with Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$ is obscured by different crystallographic settings and orientations of the cooperative Jahn-Teller elongation axes. Hence, we introduce a common crystallographic supercell through which effects of symmetry lowering from tetragonal to triclinic in the double perovskite are explored: Apparently different magnetic propagation vectors map onto the same supercell wave vector, revealing a common magnetic structure stabilized by tungsten-mediated, second-neighbor interactions. Mean field calculations further show that tetragonal symmetry preserves the degeneracy of four magnetic $\mathbf{k}$-domains in Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$, whereas the triclinic splitting of symmetry-related exchange pathways in Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$, most strongly within the Cu2 network, selects a single $\mathbf{k}$-domain. These results establish the magnetic ground state of Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$ and show how symmetry breaking selects a given ordered state without changing the underlying magnetic motif of the Sr analogue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论结合型。判断依据：中子粉末衍射实验（neutron powder diffraction）、Rietveld精修，以及平均场计算（mean field calculations）。；研究对象：三斜双钙钛矿氧化物 Ca₂CuWO₆ 的准二维反铁磁基态，并与四方相 Sr₂CuWO₆ 进行对比分析。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ca₂CuWO₆ 在 T_N ≈ 32 K 以下形成共线反铁磁序，传播矢量为 k=(1/2,1/2,0)，Cu 有序磁矩为 0.66(3) μ_B（1.5 K）。通过构建共同超胞，发现四方到三斜的对称性降低并未改变磁结构的基本构型，而是通过劈裂交换路径（尤其 Cu2 网络）选择单一 k 域，从而打破 Sr₂CuWO₆ 中四重 k 域简并。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ca₂CuWO₆ 在 T_N ≈ 32 K 以下形成共线反铁磁序，传播矢量为 k=(1/2,1/2,0)，Cu 有序磁矩为 0.66(3) μ_B（1.5 K）。通过构建共同超胞，发现四方到三斜的对称性降低并未改变磁结构的基本构型，而是通过劈裂交换路径（尤其 Cu2 网络）选择单一 k 域，从而打破 Sr₂CuWO₆ 中四重 k 域简并。；创新点：引入共同超胞框架，将四方与三斜双钙钛矿中表观不同的磁传播矢量统一映射到同一超胞波矢，揭示二者共享由 W 介导的次近邻相互作用稳定的共同磁结构，并阐明对称性破缺如何在不改变磁基元的前提下选择特定有序态。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射确定磁结构；Rietveld 精修提取磁矩大小与排列；构建共同晶体学超胞进行结构对比；平均场计算分析磁 k 域简并与对称性破缺效应。

papers.title: Lipid Hydrocarbon Tail Structure Governs Interfacial Anchoring and Stripe Morphology in Cholesteric Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: Liquid crystal-based biosensors exploit the sensitivity of interfacial anchoring to molecular adsorption. Cholesteric liquid crystals are especially useful because their helical structure supports multiple optically distinct textures that evolve with anchoring strength. Here, we compare saturated 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (DLPC) and unsaturated 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (DOPC) monolayers to determine how lipid acyl chain structure governs interfacial organization and director alignment. Mapping stripe spacing across lipid concentration, mixing ratio, cholesteric pitch, and confinement shows that the transition from fingerprint textures toward homeotropic alignment depends on both lipid structure and collective interfacial organization. DLPC produces comparatively regular textures and more readily promotes helix unwinding at high coverage, consistent with more spatially uniform collective anchoring. DOPC-containing interfaces show greater morphological heterogeneity, consistent with strong local anchoring from longer tails together with less uniform organization arising from cis-unsaturation. FRAP measurements provide complementary information on fluorescent-probe mobility, which becomes strongly restricted at high lipid concentration for both systems. Variations in pitch and film thickness further modulate the response, producing coexisting regular, distorted, and lipid-enriched textures. Together, these results show that lipid acyl chain structure regulates cholesteric anchoring through its effects on local interactions, collective interfacial organization, and mobility, providing design principles for responsive liquid-crystal interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“FRAP measurements”（荧光恢复后漂白实验）等实验手段，并系统比较了不同脂质单分子层的实验现象。；研究对象：胆甾相液晶（cholesteric liquid crystals）与两种磷脂单分子层——饱和的DLPC（1,2-二月桂酰-sn-甘油-3-磷酸胆碱）和不饱和的DOPC（1,2-二油酰-sn-甘油-3-磷酸胆碱）——之间的界面锚定行为，以及由此产生的条纹织构（stripe morphology）和指向矢排列。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脂质酰基链结构（饱和vs不饱和）通过影响局部相互作用、集体界面组织和分子迁移率，调控胆甾相液晶的界面锚定强度与织构形态：DLPC产生更均匀的锚定并促进螺旋解旋，而DOPC因顺式不饱和导致界面组织不均匀，产生更强的局部锚定和更丰富的形态异质性。
