papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脂质酰基链结构（饱和vs不饱和）通过影响局部相互作用、集体界面组织和分子迁移率，调控胆甾相液晶的界面锚定强度与织构形态：DLPC产生更均匀的锚定并促进螺旋解旋，而DOPC因顺式不饱和导致界面组织不均匀，产生更强的局部锚定和更丰富的形态异质性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于将脂质酰基链的分子结构（饱和/不饱和、链长）与胆甾相液晶的集体界面锚定行为及织构形态直接关联，并提出了基于脂质结构调控响应性液晶界面的设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：偏振光显微镜观察织构（指纹织构向垂直排列的转变）、系统改变脂质浓度/混合比例/胆甾相螺距/限制厚度来测绘条纹间距、FRAP（荧光恢复后漂白）测量荧光探针迁移率。

papers.title: PCB-Integrated CoPt Micromagnets for Magnetophoresis
papers.abstract: Integration of magnetic material with scalable microfluidic platforms can significantly improve the throughput and precision in biotechnology processes. In this work we have developed a new magnetic platform based on printed circuit board (PCB) technology. Cobalt-Platinum (CoPt) micromagnets are electroplated on copper pads with an arbitrary footprint on a Kapton substrate to enable generation of different magnetic field gradients. The magnets are characterized by XRD and VSM, before and after thermal annealing. The ordered L10 phase appear in XRD results after annealing at 600 °C, and VSM results show around six times increase for in-plane magnetic remanence from 0.24T to 1.4T. The near equiatomic ratios of Co:Pt is confirmed by EDX observations. The performance of these magnets is experimentally validated by trapping magnetic nanoparticles in microfluidic channels. These results are in excellent agreement with FEA models presented in COMSOL Multiphysics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验制备（electroplated）、表征（XRD、VSM、EDX）和性能验证（trapping magnetic nanoparticles）等实验环节，同时包含FEA模拟（COMSOL）作为辅助验证，但主体为实验工作。；研究对象：基于印刷电路板（PCB）技术集成的钴铂（CoPt）微磁体，用于磁泳（magnetophoresis）应用，即在微流控通道中捕获磁性纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Kapton基底的铜焊盘上电镀制备的CoPt微磁体，经600°C热退火后出现有序L10相，面内磁剩磁从0.24 T提升至约1.4 T（约6倍增强），且其捕获磁性纳米颗粒的实验结果与COMSOL有限元模拟高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Kapton基底的铜焊盘上电镀制备的CoPt微磁体，经600°C热退火后出现有序L10相，面内磁剩磁从0.24 T提升至约1.4 T（约6倍增强），且其捕获磁性纳米颗粒的实验结果与COMSOL有限元模拟高度吻合。；创新点：将CoPt微磁体与PCB技术集成，在Kapton柔性基底上实现任意形状（arbitrary footprint）的微磁体图案化，从而可灵活设计不同的磁场梯度分布，用于可扩展的微流控磁泳平台。摘要未突出说明与传统微磁体制备方法（如光刻、电子束蒸发）相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：电镀（electroplating）制备CoPt微磁体、X射线衍射（XRD）表征晶体结构、振动样品磁强计（VSM）测量磁性能、能量色散X射线谱（EDX）确认元素比例；数值方法为COMSOL Multiphysics中的有限元分析（FEA）模型。

papers.title: Observation of thermal Hall effect in diamond
papers.abstract: Numerous insulators, including non-magnetic ones, have been unexpectedly found to display a finite thermal Hall signal, which has stimulated debate about its origin. Here, we report on a study of the thermal Hall effect in two diamond single crystals. The transverse thermal conductivity (kappa_xy) was found to peak at a temperature close to that at which the longitudinal thermal conductivity (kappa_xx) reaches its maximum. The measured kappa_xy, with an amplitude of 340 W/(m K) at B = 10 T, is the largest ever observed, while the kappa_xy/kappa_xx ratio follows the phenomenological trend identified in other insulators. Our observation implies the existence of an intrinsic thermal Hall effect in a generic phonon gas. We argue that the rough amplitude of both the thermal Hall angle and the thermal Hall resistivity can be accounted for by simple arguments invoking fundamental constants and quantum-mechanical constraints on solid state cohesion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确报告了“对两个金刚石单晶中热霍尔效应的研究”，并给出了实测数据（如κ_xy在B=10 T时振幅为340 W/(m K)）。；研究对象：非磁性绝缘体金刚石（diamond）单晶中的热霍尔效应（thermal Hall effect），即声子气体在磁场下产生的横向热输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金刚石单晶中观测到迄今最大的热霍尔信号（κ_xy = 340 W/(m K) @ 10 T），其峰值温度接近纵向热导率κ_xx的峰值温度，表明普通声子气体中存在本征热霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金刚石单晶中观测到迄今最大的热霍尔信号（κ_xy = 340 W/(m K) @ 10 T），其峰值温度接近纵向热导率κ_xx的峰值温度，表明普通声子气体中存在本征热霍尔效应。；创新点：首次在金刚石（一种非磁性、简单元素绝缘体）中观测到热霍尔效应，且其信号强度为迄今所有材料中最大；作者提出热霍尔角和热霍尔电阻率的粗略幅度可由基本常数和固态内聚的量子力学约束来解释，暗示该效应具有普适性。摘要未突出说明与具体理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了金刚石单晶的横向热导率（κ_xy）和纵向热导率（κ_xx）随温度的变化，并在外加磁场B = 10 T下提取热霍尔信号。摘要未提及具体测量装置细节（如磁场方向、温度范围等）。

papers.title: Muonium dynamics as a probe for depth-resolved properties of 4H-SiC
papers.abstract: This study establishes a baseline for muonium (Mu) charge-exchange dynamics in n-type 4H-SiC through a detailed low-energy muon spin rotation (LE-uSR) investigation. Epitaxially grown and ion-implanted samples with nitrogen and phosphorus donors were characterized to assess the effect of carrier concentration and doping method on defect formation. LE-uSR enabled nanometer scale depth profiling of near-surface and implanted regions, revealing variations in charge carrier concentration due to fixed surface charges. The temperature dependence of the diamagnetic fraction and phase provided direct evidence of the Mu0 to Mu- transition, with extracted activation energies consistent with known donor ionization energies. Additionally, high-field uSR was used to analyze the Mu dynamics, and Monte-Carlo simulations to model the Mu0 electron capture process. The simulation results offer a quantitative method to extract free electron concentrations from LE-uSR data, enhancing its capability to characterize the activation of dopants and carrier depth profiles. We demonstrate that LE-uSR is a powerful depth-resolved tool that can provide insights for optimizing the fabrication of reliable SiC devices for power electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“low-energy muon spin rotation (LE-μSR) investigation”“high-field μSR was used”“Monte-Carlo simulations”等实验与模拟结合的手段，但主体为实验表征。；研究对象：n型4H-SiC（碳化硅）材料，具体包括外延生长和离子注入的氮、磷掺杂样品，研究其近表面及注入区域的muonium（Mu）电荷交换动力学、载流子浓度分布及缺陷形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LE-μSR能够以纳米级深度分辨能力表征4H-SiC近表面和注入区的载流子浓度变化，并通过温度依赖的顺磁分数和相位直接观测到Mu0到Mu-的转变，提取的激活能与已知施主电离能一致；结合Monte-Carlo模拟可定量提取自由电子浓度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LE-μSR能够以纳米级深度分辨能力表征4H-SiC近表面和注入区的载流子浓度变化，并通过温度依赖的顺磁分数和相位直接观测到Mu0到Mu-的转变，提取的激活能与已知施主电离能一致；结合Monte-Carlo模拟可定量提取自由电子浓度。；创新点：建立了n型4H-SiC中Mu电荷交换动力学的基线数据，并首次展示了LE-μSR结合Monte-Carlo模拟可定量提取自由电子浓度和载流子深度分布，从而将LE-μSR发展为功率电子器件SiC制备优化的深度分辨表征工具。
papers.method_zh: 低能μ子自旋旋转（LE-μSR）用于纳米尺度深度剖析；高场μSR用于分析Mu动力学；Monte-Carlo模拟用于建模Mu0电子俘获过程；通过温度依赖测量提取激活能。

papers.title: Chirality-Selective Phonon Pumping by Ferroelectric Dynamics
papers.abstract: The discovery of chiral phonons has expanded the conventional view of lattice vibrations as passive heat carriers, opening new opportunities for phononic spintronic devices. However, their realization has been largely limited to chiral crystals or to specific regions of momentum space in certain achiral materials. Here, we propose a generic mechanism for generating propagating chiral phonons in an ordinary dielectric through the precession of the electric polarization in an adjacent ferroelectric. The polarization dynamics transfers its intrinsic angular momentum to the lattice via electrostrictive coupling, thereby pumping chirality-selective phonons whose handedness is dictated by that of the polarization precession. For a typical LiNbO$_{3}$$|$Y$_{3}$Al$_{5}$O$_{12}$ bilayer, we find that the pumping efficiency quantified by an interfacial convertance substantially exceeds those of thermally induced chiral-phonon generation in chiral crystals, owing to the strong electrostrictive coupling in ferroelectrics. Our work establishes ferroelectric dynamics as a versatile electrical source of chiral phonons and provides a general route toward electrically programmable chiral-phononic and spintronic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“propose a generic mechanism”（提出普适机制）、“we find”（理论预测），以及“LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂ bilayer”的典型体系计算，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：铁电/介电双层异质结（LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂）中，由铁电极化进动驱动的传播型手性声子产生机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相邻铁电体的电极化进动，经电致伸缩耦合可将内禀角动量传递给普通介电晶格，从而泵浦出具有确定手性的传播声子；其泵浦效率（界面转换系数）显著高于手性晶体中热诱导手性声子的产生效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相邻铁电体的电极化进动，经电致伸缩耦合可将内禀角动量传递给普通介电晶格，从而泵浦出具有确定手性的传播声子；其泵浦效率（界面转换系数）显著高于手性晶体中热诱导手性声子的产生效率。；创新点：提出了一种在非手性普通介电材料中产生传播手性声子的普适电学方案，摆脱了对手性晶体或动量空间特定区域的依赖；铁电动力学作为可编程的手性声子电学源，为手性声子与自旋电子学功能提供了电学调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：基于铁电动力学与电致伸缩耦合的角动量传递机制分析，对典型LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂双层结构进行界面转换效率（interfacial convertance）的定量估算。

papers.title: Phase calibration of quantum oscillations in the magnetostrictive coefficient using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi$_2$
papers.abstract: The Berry phase accumulated along a cyclotron orbit encodes important information about electronic band topology and is commonly inferred from the phase of quantum oscillations. Measurements of the ac magnetostrictive coefficient have recently emerged as a sensitive thermodynamic probe of quantum oscillations, but the phase offset has not been experimentally calibrated. Here, using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi$_2$, we calibrate this offset by directly comparing quantum oscillations in magnetization with those in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient. Measurements of both responses on the same single crystal reveal a single fundamental frequency of approximately 160 T in fields up to 14 T, enabling a direct phase comparison free from ambiguities associated with multiple frequencies. We observe an approximately $π/2$ relative phase shift between the two oscillatory responses, consistent with the Maxwell relation linking the magnetostrictive coefficient to the stress derivative of magnetization. Our results establish the appropriate phase needed to extract cyclotron-orbit phase information from quantum oscillations in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Measurements of the ac magnetostrictive coefficient”“directly comparing quantum oscillations in magnetization with those in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient”，以及“Measurements of both responses on the same single crystal”。；研究对象：拓扑反铁磁材料 YbMnBi₂，具体研究其磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数中的量子振荡相位关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 YbMnBi₂ 中，磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡之间存在约 π/2 的相对相位偏移，该偏移与联系两者的 Maxwell 关系一致，从而标定了交流磁致伸缩系数量子振荡的相位零点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 YbMnBi₂ 中，磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡之间存在约 π/2 的相对相位偏移，该偏移与联系两者的 Maxwell 关系一致，从而标定了交流磁致伸缩系数量子振荡的相位零点。；创新点：首次通过实验标定了交流磁致伸缩系数中量子振荡的相位偏移（此前该相位偏移未被实验校准），为从该热力学探针中提取回旋轨道 Berry 相位提供了正确的相位基准。
papers.method_zh: 在同一个单晶样品上，于高达 14 T 的磁场下，分别测量磁化强度和交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡，并对两种响应进行直接相位比较。

papers.title: Nuclearity of Copper Clusters on hBN/SiC Heterostructure Modulates Molecular Adsorption
papers.abstract: Defect engineering can transform inert two-dimensional (2D) materials into chemically active and electronically tunable platforms by creating anchoring sites for metal atoms and clusters. Nevertheless, precise control over the formation, thermodynamic and kinetic stability, electronic structure, and chemical reactivity of metal species confined at these defect sites remains a challenge. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) calculations assisted by machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations to elucidate the stability, electronic structure, and reactivity of Cu clusters anchored at boron vacancies (VB) in hBN/SiC heterostructures. Systematic variation of the Cu-to-vacancy ratio reveals a transition from isolated Cu atoms to multiatom Cu clusters at VB sites, with cluster growth reshaping the stability, electronic structure, and surface reactivity. Our results show that a single VB defect can be passivated by three Cu atoms, which compensate the local charge deficiency and stabilize the defect through Cu-N coordination. Capturing further Cu introduces localized midgap states that could influence the reactivity of the Cu-decorated defect sites. We probe the response of the Cu-decorated surface to chemically relevant gases CO, H2, O2, N2, H2S, and CO2, revealing implications for surface reactivity and stability. The calculations show pronounced cluster-size-dependent reactivity of Cu clusters at VB sites, with CO forming strong Cu-C bonds and O2 undergoing enhanced adsorption and molecular activation. Overall, this work identifies defect-engineered hBN/SiC as a versatile 2D platform for stabilizing Cu clusters and tuning gas-surface reactivity. By correlating Cu nuclearity at VB sites with electronic structure, molecular activation, and environmental robustness, our findings provide design guidelines for nuclearity-dependent metal functionalization of 2D heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations。；研究对象：hBN/SiC异质结中硼空位（VB）缺陷处锚定的铜（Cu）团簇，以及该体系对CO、H2、O2、N2、H2S、CO2等气体分子的吸附行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个VB缺陷可被三个Cu原子钝化（通过Cu-N配位补偿局域电荷缺失），而进一步增加Cu原子会引入局域带隙中间态并显著改变表面反应活性；Cu团簇的核数（nuclearity）对气体吸附具有强依赖效应，其中CO形成强Cu-C键，O2被增强吸附并活化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个VB缺陷可被三个Cu原子钝化（通过Cu-N配位补偿局域电荷缺失），而进一步增加Cu原子会引入局域带隙中间态并显著改变表面反应活性；Cu团簇的核数（nuclearity）对气体吸附具有强依赖效应，其中CO形成强Cu-C键，O2被增强吸附并活化。；创新点：将缺陷工程化的hBN/SiC异质结作为稳定Cu团簇和调控气体-表面反应活性的通用二维平台，并系统建立了VB位点Cu核数与电子结构、分子活化及环境稳定性之间的关联，为二维异质结的核数依赖金属功能化提供了设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，辅以机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟；系统变化Cu与空位的比例以研究从孤立Cu原子到多原子团簇的演化，并计算多种气体分子（CO、H2、O2、N2、H2S、CO2）在Cu修饰表面的吸附行为。

papers.title: Exact chemo--thermal Metropolis Brownian engine: chemical leverage, temperature-neutral stall, power optimization, and multicyclic dissipation
papers.abstract: We develop an exactly solvable chemo--thermal extension of the three-state Metropolis Brownian heat engine. The particle moves through the periodic energy sequence $0\to E\to 2E\to0$, performs mechanical work against a load $f$ on every forward step, interacts with two cold links and one hot link, and consumes one fuel molecule of free-energy drop $\muu$ on the hot transition. Local detailed balance gives an exact cycle affinity \begin{equation*} \mathcal A=E\left(\Tc^{-1}-\Th^{-1}\right)+\muu/\Th-f\left(2/\Tc+1/\Th\right), \end{equation*} and the full stationary probabilities and current are obtained without linear-response, weak-driving, or high-barrier approximations. Several results follow. First, the exact stall force is \begin{equation*} \fs=\frac{E(\Th-\Tc)+\Tc\muu}{2\Th+\Tc}. \end{equation*} Second, there is a temperature-neutral chemical compensation point $\muu_*=3E/2$ at which $\fs=E/2$ for every $\Th>\Tc$ and the hot and cold heats both vanish at reversible stall. Third, in both Metropolis branches the stationary current is a strictly increasing function of $\muu$ at fixed mechanical parameters, but approac
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“exactly solvable”“Local detailed balance”“stationary probabilities and current”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：一种化学-热耦合的三态Metropolis布朗热机模型。粒子在周期性能级序列0→E→2E→0中运动，同时受机械负载、冷/热热库以及燃料分子化学驱动，属于介观热力学与随机热机体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型可精确求解，得到化学-热耦合下的精确失速力表达式fs = [E(Th−Tc)+Tc·μu]/(2Th+Tc)；存在一个温度无关的化学补偿点μu* = 3E/2，在该点失速力对所有Th>Tc恒为E/2，且可逆失速时冷热热库的热流同时为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型可精确求解，得到化学-热耦合下的精确失速力表达式fs = [E(Th−Tc)+Tc·μu]/(2Th+Tc)；存在一个温度无关的化学补偿点μu* = 3E/2，在该点失速力对所有Th>Tc恒为E/2，且可逆失速时冷热热库的热流同时为零。；创新点：实现了化学-热耦合布朗热机的精确可解性，超越了以往线性响应或弱驱动近似；揭示了温度中性化学补偿点这一新现象，并证明在Metropolis分支中固定机械参数下稳态电流是μu的严格递增函数（摘要末尾被截断，完整结论未给出）。
papers.method_zh: 基于局域细致平衡条件，建立三态Metropolis动力学模型，推导出精确的循环亲和势A = E(Tc⁻¹−Th⁻¹)+μu/Th−f(2/Tc+1/Th)，并解析求解稳态概率与稳态电流，无需线性响应、弱驱动或高势垒近似。

papers.title: Closed-form hard-sphere thermodynamics under nanoscale confinement: from equations of state to unmixing forces
papers.abstract: Equations of state accurately describe hard-sphere thermodynamics but are generally considered to fail under nanoscale confinement. We show that this failure is geometric rather than thermodynamic: a closed-form, parameter-free mapping from apparent to effective packing fraction restores the accuracy of the Carnahan-Starling equation of state and, with it, the entire analytical thermodynamic framework, including free energies, wall pressures, chemical potentials, and the large-cavity surface response. Applied to overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets, a geometry inherent to biomolecular force generation, it yields unmixing free energies and full distance-dependent force profiles in quantitative agreement with simulations from the dilute regime to above the bulk freezing transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“closed-form, parameter-free mapping”“analytical thermodynamic framework”，并与“simulations”对比验证。；研究对象：硬球体系在纳米尺度受限下的热力学性质，以及重叠锚定硬球液滴（overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets）这一与生物分子力产生相关的几何构型中的去混合自由能与距离依赖力曲线。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学效应；通过一个从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的无参数闭式映射，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程及其整个解析热力学框架的准确性，并能定量重现从稀溶液到高于体相冻结转变的模拟结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学效应；通过一个从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的无参数闭式映射，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程及其整个解析热力学框架的准确性，并能定量重现从稀溶液到高于体相冻结转变的模拟结果。；创新点：将纳米受限下状态方程的“失效”重新归因于几何效应，并提出无参数闭式映射恢复整个解析热力学框架，首次将该方法应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴体系，获得与模拟定量一致的力曲线。摘要未突出说明与以往几何修正方案的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：构建表观→有效堆积分数的闭式映射，恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程；基于该框架解析计算自由能、壁压、化学势、大空腔表面响应，以及重叠锚定硬球液滴的去混合自由能和距离依赖力曲线，并与模拟结果定量对比。

papers.title: Magnetic-configuration design for reliable Heisenberg exchange parameters
papers.abstract: The determination of magnetic exchange interactions is essential for the quantitative description and predictive modeling of magnetic materials. In this work, we present a neighbor-shell-based screening method for selecting magnetic configurations suitable for extracting Heisenberg exchange parameters beyond nearest-neighbor from density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using only the structure, the proposed approach identifies the linear independence of neighbor-shell contributions before any first-principles calculations instead of relying on trial-and-error generation of magnetic configurations. We apply the proposed approach to two representative classes of magnetic configurations: random spin states and spin spirals, and validate its predictions against direct DFT fitting for Fe and MnF$_2$. We show that only parameters obtained when all relevant neighbor-shell contributions are linearly independent remain transferable to other magnetic configurations. The proposed method provides practical guidance for selecting magnetic configurations for reliable exchange-parameter extraction and may also benefit other neighbor-shell-based models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、fitting、screening method。；研究对象：磁性材料中Heisenberg交换参数的提取，具体以Fe和MnF₂为验证体系，涉及随机自旋态和自旋螺旋两类磁构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有当所有相关近邻壳层贡献线性独立时，提取的交换参数才具有可迁移性（即可靠地用于其他磁构型）；提出了一种仅基于晶体结构即可预先筛选合适磁构型的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有当所有相关近邻壳层贡献线性独立时，提取的交换参数才具有可迁移性（即可靠地用于其他磁构型）；提出了一种仅基于晶体结构即可预先筛选合适磁构型的方法。；创新点：无需试错法生成磁构型，仅从晶体结构出发即可在从头算之前判定近邻壳层贡献的线性独立性，从而为可靠提取Heisenberg交换参数提供实用指导；该方法也可能推广到其他基于近邻壳层的模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于近邻壳层的筛选方法（neighbor-shell-based screening），在DFT计算之前利用结构信息判断近邻壳层贡献的线性独立性；结合DFT直接拟合（direct DFT fitting）对Fe和MnF₂进行验证，覆盖随机自旋态（random spin states）和自旋螺旋（spin spirals）两类磁构型。

papers.title: Nearly Isotropic Quantum-Critical Transport in Single-Crystal CeNiC2
papers.abstract: Pressure-induced superconductivity and $T$-linear resistivity have been reported in polycrystalline CeNiC$_2$, but orientational averaging has left the directional character of the critical scattering unresolved. We report pressure-dependent resistivity of high-quality single crystals for current along each crystallographic axis. These crystals have substantially lower residual resistivity and a slightly higher maximum onset $T_c$ than the polycrystalline sample, placing superconductivity in a cleaner transport regime. Near $P_c \approx 9.5-10$ GPa, the normal-state resistivity becomes nearly $T$-linear along every axis, the fitted residual resistivity is strongly enhanced, and superconductivity forms a narrow dome. For $I \parallel b$, the $T$-linear normal state remains nearly unchanged in magnetic fields up to 9 T applied along $a$ and $c$; the upper critical field is large and only moderately anisotropic. The common evolution along all three axes establishes a nearly isotropic quantum-critical transport regime, inconsistent with a simple low-dimensional spin-fluctuation picture and implicates valence fluctuations as the leading source of critical scattering associated with the superconducting dome.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述压力依赖的电阻率测量、单晶样品制备、磁场下的输运测量等实验内容。；研究对象：单晶CeNiC₂（铈镍碳化物），具体研究其压力诱导超导电性、正常态电阻率随压力的演化，以及量子临界输运的各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界压力Pc≈9.5–10 GPa附近，单晶CeNiC₂沿三个晶轴方向的正常态电阻率均呈现近T线性行为，且残余电阻率显著增强，超导形成窄穹顶，表明存在近各向同性的量子临界输运区域，这与低维自旋涨落图像不符，暗示价态涨落是临界散射的主要来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界压力Pc≈9.5–10 GPa附近，单晶CeNiC₂沿三个晶轴方向的正常态电阻率均呈现近T线性行为，且残余电阻率显著增强，超导形成窄穹顶，表明存在近各向同性的量子临界输运区域，这与低维自旋涨落图像不符，暗示价态涨落是临界散射的主要来源。；创新点：首次在单晶CeNiC₂中解析出沿各晶轴方向的临界散射各向异性，发现其近各向同性特征，排除了简单低维自旋涨落机制，提出价态涨落作为超导穹顶相关临界散射的主导来源。
papers.method_zh: 高压下电阻率测量（沿a、b、c三个晶轴方向分别施加电流），最高9 T磁场下的磁输运测量（磁场沿a和c方向），上临界场的各向异性分析，并与多晶样品结果对比。

papers.title: Substitution effects in RuO$_2$ single crystals
papers.abstract: RuO$_2$ has emerged as one of the leading candidates for investigating altermagnetism. Recent quantum oscillation and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements found the absence of altermagnetism or antiferromagnetism in pure RuO$_2$ crystals. The continuing debate over intrinsic magnetic order in RuO$_2$ may reflect its proximity to an altermagnetic instability. In this work, we grow single crystals of Ru$_{0.9}$V$_{0.1}$O$_2$ and investigate their structural, transport, and magnetic properties. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an average V oxidation state near $+4$. The paramagnetic susceptibility remains nearly unchanged up to room temperature, with no evidence of magnetic ordering. Thus, the 10\% V-substitution in RuO$_2$ does not induce altermagnetism. Electronic structure calculations for the V-substituted systems using two methods suggest that a higher level of V-substitution leads to a significant change in the density of states. These findings underscore the potential of nonmagnetic substitution in RuO$_2$ as an attractive candidate for probing altermagnetic transitions and their experimental signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含电子结构计算辅助）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“we grow single crystals”“X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals”“Electronic structure calculations”。；研究对象：V 替代掺杂的 RuO₂ 单晶（Ru₀.₉V₀.₁O₂），关注其结构、输运与磁性，以及是否诱导交错磁（altermagnetism）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 10% V 替代掺杂的 RuO₂ 单晶在室温以下保持顺磁，未出现磁有序，即该掺杂水平不诱导交错磁；计算表明更高 V 替代水平会显著改变态密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：10% V 替代掺杂的 RuO₂ 单晶在室温以下保持顺磁，未出现磁有序，即该掺杂水平不诱导交错磁；计算表明更高 V 替代水平会显著改变态密度。；创新点：首次实验探索非磁性 V 替代对 RuO₂ 交错磁不稳定性的影响，表明非磁性掺杂可作为调控和探测交错磁转变的潜在途径。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长；X 射线光电子能谱（XPS）测定 V 氧化态；结构、输运和磁化率测量；两种电子结构计算方法（摘要未指明具体方法，如 DFT 或 DFT+U，摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Characterizing Full Nonequilibrium Dynamics of Simple Exclusion Processes
papers.abstract: The simple exclusion process (SEP) is a paradigmatic model for nonequilibrium transport, yet the rich dynamics of its time-dependent joint distribution over an exponentially large configuration space remain notoriously intractable. Here, we leverage variational autoregressive networks to systematically characterize the nonequilibrium dynamics of symmetric (SSEP), asymmetric (ASEP), and totally asymmetric (TASEP) cases from one to three dimensions. We first validate the approach by reproducing the previous finite-time results for the 1D SSEP and long-time tensor-network results for the 2D SSEP, and then provide richer finite-time dynamics of the SSEP, ASEP, and TASEP in 1D and 2D, and a new finite-time analysis in 3D. Specifically, in 1D, we reveal that finite-time dynamical-activity maps directly correspond to the classical three-phase TASEP steady-state organization, and, in the long-time limit, boundary and bulk effects separately govern the dynamical susceptibility during the crossover from diffusive to ballistic transport. In 2D, we establish a mean-field directional-density criterion, supported by our neural-network calculations, and show that long-time boundary and bulk effects mirror their 1D counterparts. In 3D, we uncover new finite-time scaling relations for the active-inactive phase transition of the SSEP, and reveal a broadly consistent scaling exponent of the phase-transition point versus system size, implying that the phase-transition point is asymptotically controlled by the characteristic length scale ($s_c\sim L^{-2}$) regardless of dimension. This work thus establishes a unified framework for characterizing the nonequilibrium dynamics of representative transport systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“variational autoregressive networks”（变分自回归网络）进行数值计算，并对比了“tensor-network results”（张量网络结果），属于计算方法主导的研究。；研究对象：简单排斥过程（SEP）的非平衡动力学，具体包括对称（SSEP）、非对称（ASEP）和全非对称（TASEP）三种情形，覆盖一维到三维体系。研究聚焦于时间依赖的联合概率分布、动力学活性（dynamical activity）、动力学磁化率（dynamical susceptibility）以及活性-非活性相变等非平衡输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了统一框架，系统刻画了SEP在1D、2D和3D中的有限时间非平衡动力学。关键结论包括：1D中有限时间动力学活性图与TASEP经典三相稳态组织直接对应；3D中揭示了SSEP活性-非活性相变的新有限时间标度关系，且相变点随系统尺寸的标度指数在任意维度下均受特征长度尺度控制（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了统一框架，系统刻画了SEP在1D、2D和3D中的有限时间非平衡动力学。关键结论包括：1D中有限时间动力学活性图与TASEP经典三相稳态组织直接对应；3D中揭示了SSEP活性-非活性相变的新有限时间标度关系，且相变点随系统尺寸的标度指数在任意维度下均受特征长度尺度控制（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)）。；创新点：首次将变分自回归网络系统应用于SEP从1D到3D的完整非平衡动力学表征，特别是提供了3D SSEP的有限时间分析（此前未见报道），并揭示了跨维度普适的相变点标度关系（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分自回归网络（variational autoregressive networks）对SEP的完整非平衡动力学进行数值表征。验证手段包括：复现1D SSEP的已知有限时间结果，以及2D SSEP的长时间张量网络结果。此外，在2D中建立了平均场方向密度判据（mean-field directional-density criterion）作为理论支撑。

papers.title: Optical and magneto-optical interactions in Co-doped CeO$_2$ thin films prepared by pulsed laser deposition
papers.abstract: Magnetically doped CeO$_2$ is a dilute magnetic semiconductor, promising for various applications in photonics, but the origin of its ferromagnetic properties is not fully understood. Here, thin films of Ce$_{1-x}$Co$_x$O$_{2-δ}$ prepared by pulsed laser deposition on MgO ($x=0.05$ and $0.10$) and oxidized Si ($x=0.20$) substrates were systematically studied by spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical spectroscopy. Both diagonal and off-diagonal permittivity-tensor elements were obtained. Diagonal spectra revealed two optical transitions between oxygen and cerium states. Off-diagonal spectra revealed two paramagnetic transitions involving cobalt ions, from which an essential influence of cobalt doping on resulting ferromagnetic properties of CeO$_2$ was inferred. The full permittivity-tensor spectra are provided for further use in prospective modelling of magneto-optical device concepts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“thin films ... were systematically studied by spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical spectroscopy”，属于实验测量研究。；研究对象：钴掺杂二氧化铈（Ce₁₋ₓCoₓO₂₋δ）稀磁半导体薄膜，具体为在MgO（x=0.05和0.10）及氧化Si（x=0.20）衬底上通过脉冲激光沉积制备的薄膜，研究其光学与磁光性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光谱椭偏和磁光光谱获得了完整的介电张量（对角和非对角）谱，识别出氧-铈态间的两个光学跃迁，以及涉及钴离子的两个顺磁跃迁，由此推断钴掺杂对CeO₂铁磁性质具有关键影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光谱椭偏和磁光光谱获得了完整的介电张量（对角和非对角）谱，识别出氧-铈态间的两个光学跃迁，以及涉及钴离子的两个顺磁跃迁，由此推断钴掺杂对CeO₂铁磁性质具有关键影响。；创新点：系统提取了Co掺杂CeO₂薄膜的完整介电张量谱（包括对角和非对角元素），并提供了可直接用于磁光器件概念建模的完整光谱数据；同时通过磁光跃迁特征将钴离子的顺磁行为与薄膜宏观铁磁性联系起来。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）制备薄膜；光谱椭偏仪（spectroscopic ellipsometry）测量对角介电张量元素；磁光光谱（magneto-optical spectroscopy）测量非对角介电张量元素。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Synergistic Deep Learning Framework Integrating Composition, Structure, and Ionic Transport for Solid-State Electrolyte Discovery
papers.abstract: Inorganic solid-state electrolytes must combine high room-temperature ionic conductivity, a wide electrochemical window, excellent electronic insulation, and favorable mechanical compliance. Single models struggle to support reliable multi-objective screening across vast chemical spaces because of training-data distribution mismatch, cross-property dataset heterogeneity, and scarce kinetic transport data. To overcome these limitations, we develop a hierarchical synergistic deep-learning framework that sequentially coordinates efficiency, accuracy, and reliability through four complementary modules. The in-house-developed L-G-DCNN and a multi-fidelity implementation built on DenseGNN serve as compositional and structural experts for thermodynamic coarse screening and multi-property evaluation, respectively; MatterSim and system-specific DeePMD models provide transport pre-assessment and kinetic validation. Systematic benchmarks show that each module outperforms mainstream counterparts in its task, while retrospective validation establishes dual closed-loop verification of module-level accuracy and end-to-end workflow reliability. Applied to 30,364,908 Alex/ICSD-derived candidates, the framework identifies 97 high-performance candidates with room-temperature ionic conductivities of 0.109--59.0 mS/cm, including 94 halides, one borohydride, and two oxides. Consistency with independent experimental data confirms that 76 of the 94 halides fall within reported high-conductivity structural regions. Analysis reveals that Li$^{+}$ jump-network connectivity, rather than the number of geometric Li sites, is the core determinant of room-temperature ionic conductivity. Li-defect engineering effectively enhances oxide transport, whereas the inherent rigidity of the O$^{2-}$ framework suggests a potential upper limit on oxide electrolyte performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/机器学习文章。关键词：deep-learning framework、multi-fidelity implementation、DeePMD models、systematic benchmarks、retrospective validation。；研究对象：无机固态电解质材料，具体涵盖卤化物、硼氢化物和氧化物，重点关注其室温离子电导率、电化学窗口、电子绝缘性和力学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过层级协同深度学习框架，从超过3000万候选材料中筛选出97种高性能固态电解质候选物（室温离子电导率0.109–59.0 mS/cm），并揭示Li⁺跳跃网络连通性（而非几何Li位点数量）是决定室温离子电导率的核心因素；O²⁻框架的固有刚性可能对氧化物电解质性能设置上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过层级协同深度学习框架，从超过3000万候选材料中筛选出97种高性能固态电解质候选物（室温离子电导率0.109–59.0 mS/cm），并揭示Li⁺跳跃网络连通性（而非几何Li位点数量）是决定室温离子电导率的核心因素；O²⁻框架的固有刚性可能对氧化物电解质性能设置上限。；创新点：提出将成分、结构与离子输运信息分层协同整合的多模块深度学习框架，解决单一模型在多目标筛选中因训练数据分布失配、跨性质数据集异质性和动力学数据稀缺导致的不可靠问题；并首次在大规模筛选中系统揭示跳跃网络连通性对离子电导率的决定性作用。
papers.method_zh: 构建四模块层级协同深度学习框架：①自研L-G-DCNN用于成分级热力学粗筛；②基于DenseGNN的多保真度模型用于结构级多性质评估；③MatterSim用于输运预评估；④体系特化DeePMD模型用于动力学验证。采用回顾性验证建立模块级精度与端到端流程可靠性的双闭环校验。

papers.title: Exchange splitting as a descriptor for giant anomalous Hall and Nernst effects in ferromagnets
papers.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE), which describe transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses in magnetic materials, respectively, are promising for spintronic and energy-harvesting applications. Here, we employ high-throughput first-principles calculations to investigate 2251 chemically substituted tetragonal $L1_0$ alloys. Among ferromagnets, enhanced responses emerge preferentially in alloys derived from parent compounds with small exchange splitting: no alloy derived from FePt, the archetypal $L1_0$ ferromagnet, reaches the high-response regime, whereas NiPt- and CoIr-derived alloys occupy it in large numbers. Small exchange splitting keeps majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, giving chemical substitution more opportunity to modify near-Fermi-level band crossings and amplify the Berry curvature. We predict a giant anomalous Hall conductivity of $2809\,\mathrm{S\,cm^{-1}}$ in (Co$_{0.8}$Fe$_{0.2}$)(Ir$_{0.7}$Pt$_{0.3}$) and a giant anomalous Nernst conductivity of $7.72\,\mathrm{A\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ in (Ni$_{0.8}$Co$_{0.2}$)(Pt$_{0.7}$Ir$_{0.3}$). Our results identify the exchange splitting of the parent compound as a descriptor for chemical tunability toward giant Berry-curvature-driven transport responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“high-throughput first-principles calculations”（高通量第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：2251种化学取代的四方L1₀合金，具体包括FePt、NiPt、CoIr及其衍生合金体系，研究其反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）等横向输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 母体化合物的交换劈裂大小可作为预测化学取代能否增强Berry曲率驱动输运响应的描述符：小交换劈裂的母体（如NiPt、CoIr）衍生合金更容易进入高响应区，而大交换劈裂的FePt衍生合金则不能。预测了(Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃)中巨大反常霍尔电导率2809 S/cm，以及(Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃)中巨大反常能斯特电导率7.72 A/(m·K)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：母体化合物的交换劈裂大小可作为预测化学取代能否增强Berry曲率驱动输运响应的描述符：小交换劈裂的母体（如NiPt、CoIr）衍生合金更容易进入高响应区，而大交换劈裂的FePt衍生合金则不能。预测了(Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃)中巨大反常霍尔电导率2809 S/cm，以及(Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃)中巨大反常能斯特电导率7.72 A/(m·K)。；创新点：首次提出将母体化合物的交换劈裂大小作为化学调控Berry曲率驱动输运响应的描述符，为在铁磁合金中寻找巨大反常霍尔和能斯特效应提供了新的筛选准则。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 高通量第一性原理计算（high-throughput first-principles calculations），对2251种化学取代的L1₀合金进行系统筛选，计算其Berry曲率相关的输运性质（反常霍尔电导率和反常能斯特电导率）。

papers.title: Defect states in three-dimensional diamond photonic band gap crystals
papers.abstract: We perform a theoretical study of defect states within the photonic band gap of three-dimensional diamond crystals composed of point scatterers and doped with substitutional defects. The defects introduce localized states inside the photonic band gap, whose existence conditions and eigenfrequencies are expressed in terms of the on-site Green's function of the ideal defect-free crystal. Off-site Green's functions are also calculated as function of distance and are shown to vanish within approximately two unit cells. Finite-size effects are analyzed by comparing the results obtained in the infinite-crystal limit with numerical simulations based on the coupled-dipole method. The latter not only reproduce the eigenfrequencies of the defect states within the band gap, but also provide their lifetimes originating from the finite crystal size. The lifetimes of the defect states increase exponentially with crystal size, becoming very long for large crystals. In addition to defect states in the three-dimensional photonic band gap, the defects also give rise to strongly detuned states outside the gap, which decouple from the spectrum of the ideal defect-free crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：theoretical study、coupled-dipole method、numerical simulations。；研究对象：三维金刚石结构光子带隙晶体，由点散射体构成，并掺入替代式缺陷。研究缺陷态在光子带隙内的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 替代式缺陷可在三维金刚石光子晶体的带隙内引入局域缺陷态，其存在条件与本征频率可由理想无缺陷晶体的on-site Green函数表达；缺陷态寿命随晶体尺寸指数增长，大晶体中寿命极长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：替代式缺陷可在三维金刚石光子晶体的带隙内引入局域缺陷态，其存在条件与本征频率可由理想无缺陷晶体的on-site Green函数表达；缺陷态寿命随晶体尺寸指数增长，大晶体中寿命极长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其创新在于：用点散射子模型系统研究三维金刚石光子晶体中替代缺陷的局域态，并定量给出有限尺寸效应对缺陷态寿命的影响，同时发现带隙外存在与理想晶体谱退耦的强失谐缺陷态。
papers.method_zh: 基于Green函数的解析理论（on-site与off-site Green函数计算），并结合耦合偶极子方法（coupled-dipole method）进行有限尺寸数值模拟，与无限晶体极限结果对比。

papers.title: Direct current thermo-mechanical testing: Principles, uncertainty hierarchy, and its role in advanced materials characterisation
papers.abstract: Direct current thermo-mechanical testing (DC-TMT), based on resistive Joule heating, enables rapid heating and cooling, steep thermal gradients and simultaneous mechanical loading, making it a powerful tool for probing deformation, phase transformations, oxidation-assisted damage and creep under conditions inaccessible to conventional furnace-based methods. Despite its growing use, DC-TMT lacks formal standardisation and is often misinterpreted as equivalent to bulk isothermal testing, overlooking intrinsic differences in thermal and mechanical fields. This review addresses that gap by consolidating four decades of research on specimen geometry, temperature measurement, strain characterisation and environmental control, and by classifying uncertainty sources as dominant, secondary and conditional. Evidence from modelling and experiment shows that temperature gradients, heating rate and gauge representativeness govern the reliability of inferred material behaviour. Applications across aluminium, steels, nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, hardmetals, zirconium alloys, shape memory alloys and additively manufactured systems are critically assessed. The review highlights domains where DC-TMT provides reproducible mechanistic insight and conditions where direct equivalence with bulk data is not warranted. Implications include the need for transparent reporting, multi-sensor temperature validation and integration with electro-thermal modelling to enable rigorous, mechanism-focused interpretation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要明确说明“This review addresses that gap”，并系统整合了四十年研究文献。；研究对象：直流电热-力学测试（DC-TMT）技术本身，涉及的材料体系包括铝、钢、镍基高温合金、钛合金、硬质合金、锆合金、形状记忆合金及增材制造体系；物理现象涵盖变形、相变、氧化辅助损伤和蠕变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DC-TMT中温度梯度、加热速率和标距段代表性是决定材料行为推断可靠性的主导因素；该技术在某些条件下能提供可重复的机理洞察，但在与体材料数据直接等效性不成立时需谨慎解读。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DC-TMT中温度梯度、加热速率和标距段代表性是决定材料行为推断可靠性的主导因素；该技术在某些条件下能提供可重复的机理洞察，但在与体材料数据直接等效性不成立时需谨慎解读。；创新点：首次对DC-TMT技术进行了系统性的不确定度层级分类（主导/次要/条件），并明确界定了该技术与传统体材料等温测试之间等效性成立与不成立的边界条件，填补了该领域缺乏标准化规范的认知空白。
papers.method_zh: 该综述整合了建模与实验证据，对试样几何设计、温度测量、应变表征和环境控制进行了系统分类，并将不确定度来源划分为主导性、次要性和条件性三类。具体手段包括电-热耦合建模、多传感器温度验证等。

papers.title: Parity-controlled electron-hole interference in exciton-phonon coupling
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that exciton-phonon coupling in polar semiconductors is governed by a parity-controlled interference selection rule. By performing an exact multipole expansion of the excitonic form factor and validating it against numerical integration of hydrogenic envelope functions, we show that the long-range infrared divergence of the Fröhlich interaction is exactly canceled for elastic scattering between excitonic states of the same parity. The ground-state exciton is thereby protected from long-wavelength polar phonons by destructive electron-hole interference. In contrast, transitions between states of opposite parity exhibit constructive interference, preserving a finite, robust coupling to macroscopic polar fields independent of band-structure details. Mass asymmetry between the electron and hole activates higher-order multipole terms in the elastic channel but leaves the constructive inelastic channel essentially unaffected. The selection rule is dimensionally invariant, applying to bulk and two-dimensional systems alike, and naturally explains the anomalously weak phonon dressing observed in halide perovskites as well as the strong phonon sidebands in transition-metal dichalcogenides. Our framework provides a universal, analytically exact criterion for exciton-phonon coupling strength, offering a design principle for engineering excitonic materials with tailored phonon interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“exact multipole expansion”“numerical integration”“selection rule”“analytically exact criterion”等理论推导与解析分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：极性半导体中激子-声子耦合（exciton-phonon coupling）的物理机制，具体涉及卤化物钙钛矿（halide perovskites）和过渡金属二硫化物（transition-metal dichalcogenides）两类材料体系中的激子-声子相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子-声子耦合受宇称控制的干涉选择定则支配：同宇称激子态之间的弹性散射中，Fröhlich相互作用的长程红外发散被电子-空穴干涉精确抵消，基态激子免受长波极性声子影响；而异宇称态之间的跃迁则呈相长干涉，保持对宏观极化场的有限且稳健的耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子-声子耦合受宇称控制的干涉选择定则支配：同宇称激子态之间的弹性散射中，Fröhlich相互作用的长程红外发散被电子-空穴干涉精确抵消，基态激子免受长波极性声子影响；而异宇称态之间的跃迁则呈相长干涉，保持对宏观极化场的有限且稳健的耦合。；创新点：提出了一个普适的、解析精确的激子-声子耦合强度判据（universal, analytically exact criterion），首次将宇称控制的电子-空穴干涉机制确立为激子-声子耦合的普适选择定则，并统一解释了卤化物钙钛矿中异常弱的声子 dressing 与过渡金属二硫化物中强声子伴线这两个看似矛盾的现象，为按需调控激子-声子相互作用提供了设计原理。
papers.method_zh: 对激子形状因子（excitonic form factor）进行精确多极展开，并与氢原子包络函数的数值积分结果进行交叉验证；基于该展开推导出宇称控制的干涉选择定则，并检验了电子-空穴质量不对称性对高阶多极项的影响；同时验证了该选择定则在三维体材料和二维体系中的维度不变性。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian topological Euler insulators
papers.abstract: Topological Euler insulators emerge in multiband systems with real Bloch Hamiltonians and wavefunctions. Their fragile topologies are characterized by the Euler class of degenerate bands and protected by the $PT$ or $C_2T$ symmetry in two dimensions, which go beyond the tenfold $K$-theory classification of topological matter. In this work, we extend the conception of topological Euler insulators to non-Hermitian systems and propose a theoretical framework to unlock their nontrivial Euler topology. Focusing on two-dimensional, three-band non-Hermitian lattice models with symmetric Hamiltonians, we formulate a comprehensive description of their topological Euler bands, entanglement spectrum and bulk-boundary correspondence. Three typical models of non-Hermitian Euler insulators are constructed and investigated explicitly to illustrate our theory. Unique topological phase transitions and anomalous edge-band overlaps with non-Hermitian origins are further identified. Our study establishes the presence of topological Euler bands in non-Hermitian systems and unveils their intriguing physical characteristics, thereby broadening the existing territory of topological matter in non-Hermitian open systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretical framework”“formulate”“illustrate our theory”等表述，属于理论建模与分类研究。；研究对象：非厄米（non-Hermitian）二维三带晶格模型中的拓扑Euler绝缘体，具体关注具有对称哈密顿量的体系，以及其拓扑Euler能带、纠缠谱和体-边对应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将拓扑Euler绝缘体的概念从厄米系统推广至非厄米系统，证明非厄米系统中同样存在由Euler类表征的非平凡拓扑能带，并揭示了非厄米起源的独特拓扑相变和反常边缘带重叠现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将拓扑Euler绝缘体的概念从厄米系统推广至非厄米系统，证明非厄米系统中同样存在由Euler类表征的非平凡拓扑能带，并揭示了非厄米起源的独特拓扑相变和反常边缘带重叠现象。；创新点：首次将Euler类拓扑绝缘体概念拓展至非厄米体系，突破了原有厄米框架下基于十重K-理论分类的局限；发现了非厄米特有的拓扑相变类型和边缘带反常重叠行为，这些在厄米系统中不存在。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建与模型分析：针对二维三带非厄米晶格模型，采用对称哈密顿量（满足特定对称性条件）进行解析与数值研究；具体分析了三种典型非厄米Euler绝缘体模型，并计算其拓扑Euler能带、纠缠谱及体-边对应关系。

papers.title: Dynamical development of long-range spatial coherence in non-equilibrium bosonic condensation
papers.abstract: Development of spontaneous coherence is one of the hallmarks of bosonic condensation in a variety of physical systems, such as cold atoms, confined photons, and hybrid light-matter quasiparticles like exciton polaritons in semiconductors. While spatial coherence is well understood once a steady-state condensate has been established, its temporal evolution as the condensate forms is largely unexplored. Here, we explore the dynamical formation of a non-equilibrium, driven-dissipative exciton-polariton condensate through both time-resolved experiments and numerical modeling. Our study reveals that the spatial coherence is established through two distinct stages. The early-time stage is interaction-driven and features transient oscillations in spatial coherence. This stage is followed by a steady-state regime characterized by a spatially-uniform high degree of coherence that extends over the entire size of the system and persists over time. These stages of spatial coherence development occur in both free flowing and confined exciton-polariton systems that undergo a quench - rapid growth of the condensate starting from two different initial settings. Our study offers a deep insight into the process by which long-range spatial coherence is established in a non-equilibrium bosonic condensate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“time-resolved experiments and numerical modeling”。；研究对象：非平衡驱动-耗散激子极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate）中长程空间相干的动态建立过程，涵盖自由流动和受限两种体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间相干的建立分为两个截然不同的阶段：早期由相互作用驱动，伴随空间相干的瞬态振荡；随后进入稳态，整个系统内形成空间均匀、随时间持续的高相干度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间相干的建立分为两个截然不同的阶段：早期由相互作用驱动，伴随空间相干的瞬态振荡；随后进入稳态，整个系统内形成空间均匀、随时间持续的高相干度。；创新点：首次系统揭示了非平衡玻色凝聚体在形成过程中空间相干性的时间演化机制，明确了“相互作用驱动的瞬态振荡”与“稳态均匀高相干”两阶段图像，并验证了该图像在自由流动和受限体系中的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨实验（time-resolved experiments）结合数值建模（numerical modeling），对经历淬火（quench，即凝聚体快速生长）的激子极化激元系统进行动力学研究。

papers.title: Interpretable physics-informed retrieval-augmented generation language model for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning
papers.abstract: Synthesis planning for inorganic materials requires predicting both synthesizability and viable routes by linking microscopic thermodynamic stability with macroscopic synthesis methods, precursors, and processing conditions. Here, we develop an interpretable Physics-Informed Retrieval-Augmented Generation Language Model (PIRAG-LM) for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning. We construct a material-centered Structured Synthesis Knowledge Base (SSKB) containing route-level records for 13,820 experimentally synthesized inorganic crystals. PIRAG-LM retrieves historical precedents using chemical, structural, and thermodynamic similarity, then employs a structured LLM reasoning module to propose routes, precursors, and processing conditions and assess thermodynamic feasibility, kinetics, and accessibility. It achieves 91.4% accuracy in synthesis-method prediction, compared with 72.1% for the LLM alone, and generalizes to materials reported after the knowledge cutoff. Because the framework relies on retrieval rather than parametric memorization, its performance can be improved by expanding the SSKB without retraining the language model. Guided by PIRAG-LM, we experimentally synthesize five new compounds: BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95, BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9, Hg[B(CN)4]2, CoCo(CN)6, and SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6, via solid-state and solution routes. These results demonstrate an interpretable machine-learning approach that helps bridge computational materials discovery and experimental realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（机器学习方法开发 + 实验合成验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“develop a ... Language Model”的算法构建，以及“we experimentally synthesize five new compounds”的实验验证。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的合成规划，具体涉及13,820种实验合成的无机晶体，以及五种新化合物：BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95、BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9、Hg[B(CN)4]2、CoCo(CN)6、SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型（PIRAG-LM），在合成方法预测上达到91.4%的准确率（纯LLM为72.1%），并能泛化到知识截止日期之后报道的材料；该模型成功指导了五种新化合物的实验合成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型（PIRAG-LM），在合成方法预测上达到91.4%的准确率（纯LLM为72.1%），并能泛化到知识截止日期之后报道的材料；该模型成功指导了五种新化合物的实验合成。；创新点：框架依赖检索而非参数记忆，因此可通过扩展SSKB提升性能而无需重新训练语言模型；模型具有可解释性，且直接连接了计算材料发现与实验实现。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 构建了以材料为中心的结构化合成知识库（SSKB），包含13,820种无机晶体的路线级记录；PIRAG-LM利用化学、结构和热力学相似性检索历史先例，再通过结构化LLM推理模块提出合成路线、前驱体和加工条件，并评估热力学可行性、动力学和可及性。实验验证采用固相和溶液法合成新化合物。

papers.title: Quantum geometric signatures of Link-Unlink transitions and nonlinear Hall response in Hopf-link semimetals
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry, comprising of quantum metric and Berry curvature, plays a significant role in the electronic transport properties of solids. In this work, we theoretically investigate the quantum geometric properties of a Hopf-link semimetal, a distinct topological class that is charecterized by a nodal link-unlink transition. We compute the interband optical conductivity of the Hopf link, which effectively distinguishes between linked and trivial phases. While recent studies establish quantum metric dipole-mediated scattering-free nonlinear Hall effect, this effect becomes even more fascinating in systems where the Berry-curvature-dipole contribution to nonlinear Hall conductivity vanishes. Owing to the underlying $PT$ symmetry of the Hopf-link semimetal, the Berry curvature and its corresponding contribution to the nonlinear Hall effect are entirely suppressed. Consequently, by introducing an appropriate perturbation, a finite nonlinear Hall conductivity emerges solely due to the quantum metric in the Hopf semimetal. Notably, this purely intrinsic, symmetry-driven nonlinear response remains entirely unmixed with extrinsic components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretically investigate”“We compute”等表述，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：Hopf-link半金属（Hopf-link semimetal），一种具有节点链环-解链环（link-unlink）拓扑相变的新型拓扑半金属，重点研究其量子几何性质及非线性霍尔响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系因具有PT对称性，Berry曲率及其对非线性霍尔效应的贡献被完全抑制；通过引入适当微扰，可产生仅由量子度量（quantum metric）驱动的纯内禀非线性霍尔电导，且该响应与外在贡献完全无混合。此外，Hopf-link的带间光导率可有效区分链环相与平庸相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系因具有PT对称性，Berry曲率及其对非线性霍尔效应的贡献被完全抑制；通过引入适当微扰，可产生仅由量子度量（quantum metric）驱动的纯内禀非线性霍尔电导，且该响应与外在贡献完全无混合。此外，Hopf-link的带间光导率可有效区分链环相与平庸相。；创新点：首次在Hopf-link半金属中展示Berry曲率偶极子贡献为零时，非线性霍尔效应可完全由量子度量偶极子产生，且该响应是纯内禀、对称性驱动的，不混有外在散射贡献。摘要未突出说明与其他拓扑半金属（如Weyl或Dirac半金属）量子几何研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算框架：基于量子几何（量子度量与Berry曲率）的形式理论，计算带间光导率（interband optical conductivity）和非线性霍尔电导率，并利用PT对称性分析Berry曲率贡献的消失条件，通过引入微扰项研究纯量子度量贡献的非线性响应。

papers.title: Realization of Air-Stable Two-Dimensional Superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5 With Quasi-One-Dimensional Pair Density Modulation
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconductors provide a fertile platform for exploring reduced-dimensional superconductivity and emergent quantum phenomena. Incorporating quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) structural motifs into 2D superconductors offers a powerful route to engineer strong electronic anisotropy, enabling unconventional superconducting states and anisotropic superconducting transport functionalities. However, such systems remain rarely realized. Here we report the realization of a 2D superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5, exhibiting an intrinsic quasi-1D pair density modulation. Monolayer and bilayer Nb2Pd3Te5 is synthesized via van-der-Waals epitaxy. Using ultralow-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy, we observe the quasi-1D crystal structure and superconductivity below ~0.6 K with a pronounced quasi-1D pair density modulation. Remarkably, both monolayer and bilayer Nb2Pd3Te5 show strong air stability. Our findings establish atomically 2D Nb2Pd3Te5 as a robust and promising platform for exploring novel low-dimensional quantum phenomena and anisotropy-enabled superconducting devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“合成”“扫描隧道显微镜/谱学”“观测”等实验关键词。；研究对象：二维超导体 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，具体包括单层和双层薄膜，以及其中准一维的库珀对密度调制现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过范德华外延成功制备了单层和双层 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，该材料在约 0.6 K 以下表现出超导电性，并伴随显著的准一维库珀对密度调制；同时该二维超导体具有优异的空气稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过范德华外延成功制备了单层和双层 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，该材料在约 0.6 K 以下表现出超导电性，并伴随显著的准一维库珀对密度调制；同时该二维超导体具有优异的空气稳定性。；创新点：首次在原子级二维超导体中实现并观测到本征的准一维库珀对密度调制，且该材料兼具空气稳定性，为二维各向异性超导研究提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 范德华外延（van-der-Waals epitaxy）生长薄膜；超低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（ultralow-temperature STM/STS）用于表征晶体结构、超导能隙及库珀对密度调制。

papers.title: Multiple pattern formation in quorum sensing of density enhanced motility
papers.abstract: Using Langevin dynamics simulations, I investigate nonequilibrium systems of particles following a density-enhanced motility (DEM) rule: particles are passive below a critical local density and active above it. This mechanism represents an inverse of the conventional quorum-sensing rule. I explore specifically quorums much larger than particle size and at two levels of activity. Above critical values of the density, quorum size, and activity, the system undergoes phase separation into low- and high-energy regions. The passive particles organize into distinct spatial patterns, including holes, stripes, and labyrinthine structures, while the active particles form a gas. I characterize the resulting steady states and identify the qualitative mechanisms governing the selection of different morphological regimes. I further discuss the relevance of these results to biological systems governed by analogous quorum-sensing mechanisms and to biological systems exhibiting related forms of spatial organization. Finally, I present directions for future investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Langevin dynamics simulations”（朗之万动力学模拟）。；研究对象：密度增强迁移（DEM）规则下的非平衡粒子系统，即粒子在低于临界局域密度时表现为被动、高于临界密度时表现为活跃的群体感应体系。具体关注远大于粒子尺寸的群体感应尺度（quorum）以及两个活动性水平下的相分离与空间模式形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当密度、群体感应尺度和活动性超过临界值时，系统发生相分离为低能和高能区域；被动粒子自组织形成孔洞、条纹和迷宫状等不同空间图案，而活跃粒子形成气态。研究刻画了稳态特征，并识别了决定不同形态区域选择的定性机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当密度、群体感应尺度和活动性超过临界值时，系统发生相分离为低能和高能区域；被动粒子自组织形成孔洞、条纹和迷宫状等不同空间图案，而活跃粒子形成气态。研究刻画了稳态特征，并识别了决定不同形态区域选择的定性机制。；创新点：该工作研究了传统群体感应规则的逆过程（密度增强迁移），并系统探讨了在较大群体感应尺度下被动粒子形成的多种空间图案（孔洞、条纹、迷宫结构）及其形态选择机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 朗之万动力学模拟（Langevin dynamics simulations），用于研究非平衡多粒子系统的动力学与稳态结构。

papers.title: Beyond linear stability: Heterogeneity-induced fingering of crack fronts
papers.abstract: We investigate the stability of elastic interfaces beyond the linear regime by considering penny-shaped crack fronts propagating through toughness heterogeneities. Using fracture mechanics simulations, we drive crack fronts through arrays of obstacles with tunable toughness contrast. At low contrast, the crack front stiffness remains finite and stabilizes front perturbations. Above a critical threshold, however, the stiffness vanishes and the front destabilizes into long fingers that evolve into daughter cracks propagating between obstacles while the original crack remains pinned. Near threshold, the crack front response displays the characteristic square-root scaling behavior of classical saddle-node bifurcations. Yet, our analysis reveals a fundamentally different mechanism: the stable energy-minimizing crack-front configuration disappears without colliding with an unstable counterpart. Instead, the instability originates from a global loss of Griffith-compatible equilibria governed by the nonlocal interactions along the crack front. Beyond fracture mechanics, these findings point toward a broader class of collective global bifurcations in nonlocal elastic interfaces and may help rationalize the brittle-to-quasibrittle transition in heterogeneous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“fracture mechanics simulations”（断裂力学模拟），并涉及理论分析（如“saddle-node bifurcations”、“Griffith-compatible equilibria”）。；研究对象：异质固体中裂纹前沿的失稳行为，具体为含韧性异质（障碍物阵列）的硬币形（penny-shaped）裂纹扩展问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当韧性对比超过临界阈值时，裂纹前沿的刚度消失，前沿失稳形成长指状分支并演化为子裂纹，而原裂纹保持钉扎。该失稳并非经典鞍结分岔（稳定与不稳定解碰撞），而是源于非局部相互作用导致的Griffith相容平衡态的全局消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当韧性对比超过临界阈值时，裂纹前沿的刚度消失，前沿失稳形成长指状分支并演化为子裂纹，而原裂纹保持钉扎。该失稳并非经典鞍结分岔（稳定与不稳定解碰撞），而是源于非局部相互作用导致的Griffith相容平衡态的全局消失。；创新点：揭示了一种不同于经典鞍结分岔的失稳机制——稳定能量极小构型在未与不稳定构型碰撞的情况下消失，而是由非局部相互作用引起的全局平衡态消失所致。该机制可能推广至非局部弹性界面的集体全局分岔，并有助于理解脆性-准脆性转变。
papers.method_zh: 断裂力学模拟（fracture mechanics simulations），通过调节障碍物的韧性对比度（toughness contrast）驱动裂纹前沿穿过障碍物阵列，并分析近阈值的标度行为。

papers.title: Splay-induced charging of ferroelectric droplets in highly non-uniform electric fields
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric sessile droplets on a superhydrophobic surface can be put into motion by highly non-uniform electric fields, in a direction that depends on the field sign. This indicates that droplets carry a non-vanishing electrostatic charge, which we interpret as acquired through contact electrification at the interface with the superhydrophobic substrate. This phenomenon is not observed in the presence of a uniform or quasi-uniform electric field, suggesting that droplets charging is favored in highly nonuniform fields able to induce localized distortions of the ferroelectric polarization, in turn producing localized charge accumulation sites. Electrostatic charging is thus understood as a splay-induced contact electrification and interpreted as a strategy to minimize the accumulated charge. Electrophoretic-like motion is observed in about 30% of the experiments, meaning that splay-induced charging requires the proper combination of conditions such as droplets size, distance from the field source, freshness of the substrate coating and other experimental details that are not easily quantified. When charging does not occur, effects related to droplet polarization such as dielectrophoresis, ejection of polarized fluid jets and electrostriction-like deformations are observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观察现象（“droplets can be put into motion”、“observed in about 30% of the experiments”），并涉及实验条件（超疏水表面、电场非均匀性、液滴尺寸等）。；研究对象：铁电液滴（ferroelectric droplets）在超疏水表面上的静电充电行为，以及其在高度非均匀电场中的运动与形变现象。具体涉及液滴与基底界面的接触起电、铁电极化畸变与电荷积累的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 铁电液滴在高度非均匀电场中会通过“splay-induced contact electrification”（展曲诱导接触起电）获得净静电电荷，从而表现出依赖于电场方向的电泳式运动；该充电过程仅在非均匀电场下发生，且仅在约30%的实验条件下实现，否则主要观察到介电泳、极化流体射流喷射和电致伸缩类形变等极化相关效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：铁电液滴在高度非均匀电场中会通过“splay-induced contact electrification”（展曲诱导接触起电）获得净静电电荷，从而表现出依赖于电场方向的电泳式运动；该充电过程仅在非均匀电场下发生，且仅在约30%的实验条件下实现，否则主要观察到介电泳、极化流体射流喷射和电致伸缩类形变等极化相关效应。；创新点：首次将铁电液滴在非均匀电场中的充电行为归因于“splay-induced contact electrification”——即非均匀电场诱导的局部极化畸变（splay）产生局域电荷积累位点，进而通过接触起电为液滴充电，并将其解释为系统最小化积累电荷的一种策略。这一机制将铁电体的挠曲电效应（flexoelectric-like splay）与宏观电泳运动联系起来。摘要未突出说明与其他充电机制（如传统摩擦起电）的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：超疏水表面上的铁电液滴（sessile droplets）实验，施加高度非均匀电场（以及均匀/准均匀电场作为对照），观察液滴运动方向、速度及形变行为。摘要未明确说明具体材料成分、电场产生方式或表征仪器（如高速摄像、电流测量等）。

papers.title: Distinct Surface and Bulk Superconductivity in the Kagome Superconductor SrSn$_3$
papers.abstract: Surface and bulk superconductivity may possess fundamentally different superconducting properties in quantum materials with nontrivial electronic structures, yet their superimposed spectroscopic signatures often prevent direct experimental access to each superconducting channel. Here we reveal, in epitaxial films of the kagome superconductor SrSn$_3$, distinct surface and bulk superconducting channels with markedly different superconducting gaps, upper critical fields, and vortex-core electronic states by tuning the tunneling junction resistance in scanning tunneling spectroscopy. The surface superconductivity is characterized by a thickness-independent superconducting gap and an enhanced upper critical field, whereas the bulk superconducting channel exhibits a larger superconducting gap that decreases with reducing film thickness and a much lower upper critical field. Within magnetic vortex cores, robust non-split zero-bias conductance peaks are observed exclusively in the surface superconducting channel, while pronounced zero-bias suppression is consistently associated with the bulk superconducting channel. These findings demonstrate that the vortex-core electronic structure depends sensitively on the underlying superconducting channel, providing new insight into vortex-bound states in topological quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：epitaxial films（外延薄膜）、scanning tunneling spectroscopy（扫描隧道谱）、tunneling junction resistance（隧穿结电阻）。；研究对象：笼目（kagome）超导体 SrSn₃ 的外延薄膜，具体研究其表面超导与体超导两个通道的电子性质，以及磁通涡旋芯中的电子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 SrSn₃ 外延薄膜中，通过调节隧穿结电阻，可清晰区分出表面与体超导两个通道：表面超导具有与厚度无关的能隙和增强的上临界场，而体超导具有随厚度减小而减小的更大能隙和更低的上临界场；涡旋芯中，表面通道呈现稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰，体通道则表现为明显的零偏压抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 SrSn₃ 外延薄膜中，通过调节隧穿结电阻，可清晰区分出表面与体超导两个通道：表面超导具有与厚度无关的能隙和增强的上临界场，而体超导具有随厚度减小而减小的更大能隙和更低的上临界场；涡旋芯中，表面通道呈现稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰，体通道则表现为明显的零偏压抑制。；创新点：首次在单一材料中通过隧穿结电阻调控，将表面与体超导通道的谱学信号（超导能隙、上临界场、涡旋芯电子态）在实验上直接分离并分别表征，揭示了涡旋芯电子结构对超导通道类型的敏感依赖，为拓扑量子材料中的涡旋束缚态提供了新认识。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道谱（STS），通过调节隧穿结电阻来分离表面与体超导通道的信号；样品为外延薄膜（epitaxial films），并系统改变薄膜厚度进行对比测量。

papers.title: High-throughput Discovery of Magnetic Rare Earth Transition Metal Alloys
papers.abstract: We present an accelerated materials discovery framework that combines diffusion-based crystal structure generation with hierarchical screening to identify new rare-earth--transition-metal magnets simultaneously achieving high magnetization and thermodynamic stability. Using this workflow, we systematically explored over 3000 binary (R-T) and ternary (R-T-T$'$) compositions spanning R~$\in \{\text{Y, Sm}\}$, T~$\in \{\text{Fe, Co, Ni}\}$, and T$' \in \{\text{Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn}\}$, and filtered approximately 240{,}000 generated crystal structures through machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening and spin-polarized density functional theory validation. We identify 300+ low-energy magnetic candidates within 0.1~eV/atom above the convex hull at the DFT level, including 5 thermodynamically stable phases. The highest saturation magnetization reaches ${\sim}1.8$~T in Fe-rich binary and ternary phases (SmFe$_{12}$, YFe$_{12}$, YFe$_{18}$Ti and Sm$_2$Fe$_{16}$Mn). Symmetry analysis reveals that the majority of ternary candidates are subgroup derivatives of known binary prototypes through Wyckoff site splitting that accommodates T$'$ substitution. Site-resolved magnetic moment analysis further shows that Mn aligns ferromagnetically with the Fe sublattice with minimal magnetization loss, whereas Cr couples antiferromagnetically, providing systematic guidance for dopant selection. These findings demonstrate a generalizable strategy for targeted magnetic materials discovery and suggest that extending generative searches to larger unit cells ($>$20 atoms) with higher Fe fractions is a promising route toward stable phases with saturation magnetization exceeding 1.8~T.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“diffusion-based crystal structure generation”“machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening”“spin-polarized density functional theory validation”等计算与生成式方法。；研究对象：稀土-过渡金属（R-T）磁性合金，具体包括二元（R-T）和三元（R-T-T'）体系，其中R ∈ {Y, Sm}，T ∈ {Fe, Co, Ni}，T' ∈ {Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn}。研究目标是同时具备高磁化强度和热力学稳定性的新型永磁材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量生成与筛选，识别出300余个低能磁性候选相（DFT级别凸包以上0.1 eV/atom以内），其中5个为热力学稳定相。Fe-rich二元及三元相（如SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti、Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn）的最高饱和磁化强度可达约1.8 T。此外，Mn与Fe亚晶格呈铁磁耦合且磁化损失极小，而Cr呈反铁磁耦合，为掺杂元素选择提供了系统指导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量生成与筛选，识别出300余个低能磁性候选相（DFT级别凸包以上0.1 eV/atom以内），其中5个为热力学稳定相。Fe-rich二元及三元相（如SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti、Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn）的最高饱和磁化强度可达约1.8 T。此外，Mn与Fe亚晶格呈铁磁耦合且磁化损失极小，而Cr呈反铁磁耦合，为掺杂元素选择提供了系统指导。；创新点：将扩散模型生成式晶体结构预测与分层筛选流程相结合，实现针对稀土-过渡金属磁性合金的高通量发现；并通过对称性分析揭示三元候选相多为已知二元原型经Wyckoff位点分裂的亚群衍生物。摘要还提出向更大晶胞（>20原子）和高Fe比例扩展生成搜索是突破1.8 T饱和磁化强度的可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用加速材料发现框架，结合基于扩散模型的晶体结构生成、机器学习原子间势能预筛选、以及自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）验证。系统探索了超过3000种成分，筛选约24万个生成晶体结构。还进行了对称性分析（Wyckoff位点分裂）和位点分辨磁矩分析。

papers.title: Grain Boundary Engineering Effect on Vortex Matter in Superconducting Films
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline superconducting films act as a double-edged sword: they can pin vortices or degrade superconductivity through Josephson-like weak-link coupling. Here, we demonstrate that sputtering pressure tunes GB coupling in NbTiN films and visualize its consequences for vortex matter. The 5 mTorr film exhibits dispersed grain orientations and a two-step resistive transition under field, signaling intergranular weak-link behavior. In contrast, the 7 mTorr film develops a (111) texture, a single-step transition, higher critical current density, a second magnetization peak, and a δl-type pinning response consistent with improved GB coupling. Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy reveals a spatially heterogeneous, cluster-like vortex configuration in the 5 mTorr film, whereas the 7 mTorr film hosts a more uniform distribution with enhanced local order. These results establish a connection between deposition-controlled GB connectivity, macroscopic weak-link transport, and microscopic vortex organization, providing a practical route to tailor vortex pinning in polycrystalline superconducting films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”“visualize”“Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy reveals”等实验性表述，涉及薄膜制备、输运测量和显微成像。；研究对象：多晶超导薄膜NbTiN中的晶界（Grain Boundaries）及其对涡旋物质（vortex matter）的钉扎与输运行为的影响，具体关注溅射气压调控晶界耦合强度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节溅射气压（5 mTorr vs 7 mTorr）可有效调控NbTiN薄膜的晶界耦合：5 mTorr薄膜呈现弱连接行为（两台阶电阻转变、簇状涡旋分布），而7 mTorr薄膜具有更好的晶界连通性，表现为单台阶转变、更高临界电流密度、第二磁峰效应和δl型钉扎，并对应更均匀有序的涡旋排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节溅射气压（5 mTorr vs 7 mTorr）可有效调控NbTiN薄膜的晶界耦合：5 mTorr薄膜呈现弱连接行为（两台阶电阻转变、簇状涡旋分布），而7 mTorr薄膜具有更好的晶界连通性，表现为单台阶转变、更高临界电流密度、第二磁峰效应和δl型钉扎，并对应更均匀有序的涡旋排列。；创新点：将沉积参数（溅射气压）控制的晶界连通性与宏观弱连接输运行为及微观涡旋组织直接关联起来，为多晶超导薄膜中通过晶界工程定制涡旋钉扎提供了实用路径。摘要未突出说明与以往晶界工程研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 磁控溅射制备不同气压下的NbTiN薄膜；电阻-温度/磁场输运测量（用于判断电阻转变台阶）；临界电流密度测量；磁化测量（用于观测第二磁峰）；低温磁力显微镜（Cryogenic MFM）用于直接成像涡旋空间分布。

papers.title: Electric excitation of spin resonance in altermagnetic and antiferromagnetic conductors
papers.abstract: We predict electric-dipole spin resonance (EDSR) in altermagnetic conductors: in a magnetic field ${\mathbf H}_\perp$, perpendicular to the magnetization axis, an AC electric field will induce a \textit{spin} resonance peak above the lower threshold frequency $ω_- = 2H_\perp$. In sufficiently clean samples, this peak shall be clearly visible on the background of ohmic absorption. EDSR can thus serve as a diagnostic of altermagnetism in conducting materials and as a means to distinguish it from higher-symmetry antiferromagnetic order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We predict”（我们预测）等理论预言性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算细节。；研究对象：交变磁（altermagnetic）导体中的电偶极自旋共振（EDSR）现象，以及其与高对称性反铁磁（antiferromagnetic）导体的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在垂直于磁化轴的磁场 H⊥ 下，交变磁导体中的交流电场可激发自旋共振峰，其频率下限为 ω₋ = 2H⊥；在足够干净的样品中，该峰可在欧姆吸收背景上清晰可见，可作为交变磁性的诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在垂直于磁化轴的磁场 H⊥ 下，交变磁导体中的交流电场可激发自旋共振峰，其频率下限为 ω₋ = 2H⊥；在足够干净的样品中，该峰可在欧姆吸收背景上清晰可见，可作为交变磁性的诊断工具。；创新点：首次提出EDSR可作为交变磁导体中交变磁序的探测手段，并可用于区分交变磁序与更高对称性的反铁磁序。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如模型哈密顿量、微扰论或线性响应理论等），仅给出物理预言和条件（磁场方向、频率阈值、样品纯度要求）。

papers.title: Metastable magnetic domains and the anomalous $B_\parallel=0$ resistance peak in twisted double bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: In graphene moirés, valley polarization gives rise to orbital magnetism, manifested as an anomalous Hall effect and resulting in Barkhausen jumps in longitudinal resistance when changing domain configurations modify quasiparticle scattering. Beyond a simple picture of polarized domains, however, spin and valley textures within and between the domains are less well understood, as is the effect of these textures on transport. In the valley-polarized quarter-metal state of twisted double bilayer graphene, a sharp and metastable peak in longitudinal resistance often appears at zero in-plane magnetic field, whose microscopic origin has yet to be identified. Here, we show that this peak depends on the configuration of domains of orbital magnetism, which is itself set by the gate-voltage trajectory used to enter the ordered state and by the magnetic field --- particularly the in-plane component --- present during that trajectory. The sensitivity of the effect to in-plane magnetic field components points to spin, linked to valley polarization through spin-orbit coupling, as the key degree of freedom in both the domain formation and the resistance peak.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们展示”（we show）等表述，并详细描述了实验观测到的现象（如电阻峰、磁畴构型）及其对门电压轨迹和磁场的依赖关系。；研究对象：扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted double bilayer graphene）中的谷极化四分之一金属态（valley-polarized quarter-metal state）。具体研究该体系中轨道磁性（orbital magnetism）形成的亚稳磁畴（metastable magnetic domains），以及由此产生的纵向电阻在零面内磁场（$B_\parallel=0$）处的反常尖峰。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该零面内磁场电阻尖峰取决于轨道磁性磁畴的构型，而磁畴构型本身由进入有序态时的栅压轨迹和磁场（尤其是面内分量）决定。面内磁场的敏感性表明，自旋（通过自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化关联）是磁畴形成和电阻尖峰的关键自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该零面内磁场电阻尖峰取决于轨道磁性磁畴的构型，而磁畴构型本身由进入有序态时的栅压轨迹和磁场（尤其是面内分量）决定。面内磁场的敏感性表明，自旋（通过自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化关联）是磁畴形成和电阻尖峰的关键自由度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作首次将零面内磁场电阻尖峰的微观起源与轨道磁性磁畴的构型及自旋-谷耦合自由度联系起来，超越了简单的极化磁畴图像，揭示了磁畴内及磁畴间的自旋和谷纹理对输运的影响。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验技术（如输运测量装置、样品制备方法等），但明确涉及对纵向电阻的输运测量，并通过改变栅压轨迹和施加不同方向（特别是面内）的磁场来调控和探测磁畴状态。

papers.title: Signatures of a ferro-Josephson effect in twisted graphene
papers.abstract: When a spin-polarized current is driven across a magnetic domain wall, the resulting spin-transfer torque could, beyond a critical threshold, set the wall's moments into precession. This precession would modulate the Berry curvature experienced by electrons traversing the wall, producing an electromotive force that is topological in nature, proportional to the precession frequency, mapping precisely onto the DC Josephson effect and leading to the name ferro-Josephson effect. We report signatures consistent with this effect in a twisted graphene van der Waals heterostructure, where spin and valley textures are linked by exchange, Hund's coupling, and spin-orbit interactions. Tuned to fillings where the isospin degeneracy is spontaneously broken, the samples develop a sharp peak in the longitudinal resistance within a fraction of a millitesla of $B_\parallel=0$---a peak that disappears as the current is reduced toward zero. In differential resistance the feature resolves into sharp resonances that disperse with $B_\parallel$ on microtesla and picoampere scales. We argue that these arise from the current-driven precession of spin-domain-wall moments, in competition with the in-plane anisotropy set by a minuscule applied field, and that they establish nonlinear transport as a sensitive probe of isospin domain-wall dynamics at energy scales far below $k_BT$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We report signatures consistent with this effect in a twisted graphene van der Waals heterostructure”，并描述了电阻测量、微分电阻等实验观测结果。；研究对象：扭曲石墨烯范德华异质结中的自旋畴壁动力学与非线性输运现象，具体涉及自旋极化电流驱动磁畴壁进动所产生的“铁磁约瑟夫森效应”（ferro-Josephson effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲石墨烯异质结中，当同位旋简并自发破缺时，纵向电阻在极小的平行磁场（B∥=0附近，毫特斯拉量级）内出现尖锐峰，且该峰随电流减小而消失；微分电阻中呈现随微特斯拉磁场和皮安电流尺度色散的尖锐共振。作者认为这些现象源于电流驱动的自旋畴壁矩进动，与极小的面内各向异性场竞争，表明非线性输运可探测远低于k_BT能量尺度的同位旋畴壁动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲石墨烯异质结中，当同位旋简并自发破缺时，纵向电阻在极小的平行磁场（B∥=0附近，毫特斯拉量级）内出现尖锐峰，且该峰随电流减小而消失；微分电阻中呈现随微特斯拉磁场和皮安电流尺度色散的尖锐共振。作者认为这些现象源于电流驱动的自旋畴壁矩进动，与极小的面内各向异性场竞争，表明非线性输运可探测远低于k_BT能量尺度的同位旋畴壁动力学。；创新点：首次在扭曲石墨烯范德华异质结中报道了与铁磁约瑟夫森效应一致的实验迹象，将拓扑性电动势与DC约瑟夫森效应的类比从理论拓展到实际凝聚态体系，并建立了非线性输运作为探测同位旋畴壁动力学灵敏探针的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量了纵向电阻随平行磁场和电流的变化，并采用微分电阻（differential resistance）测量手段，在微特斯拉磁场和皮安电流尺度上观测共振特征。理论解释基于自旋转移力矩驱动的畴壁进动模型，结合交换耦合、Hund耦合和自旋轨道耦合对自旋-谷纹理的关联作用。

papers.title: Dynamical and conformational behavior of a polymer in a crowded solution
papers.abstract: We investigate the structure and dynamics of a polymer in a fluid containing mobile spherical colloidal crowders of radius $R$. We compare and contrast the behavior with Langevin dynamics (LD) and lattice--Boltzmann molecular dynamics (LBMD), the latter incorporating long-range hydrodynamic interactions. Both the colloid size relative to the monomer radius $r$ and the volume fraction $φ$ are varied to determine how crowding modifies polymer behavior. Increasing volume fraction induces polymer compaction, with the mechanism strongly dependent on the size ratio $R/r$. Small colloids primarily modify the short-wavelength polymer conformation, causing self-avoiding-walk-like behavior to persist to shorter length scales, whereas large colloids reduce the effective long-wavelength Flory exponent, indicating degraded solvent quality consistent with a confinement-blob picture. Polymer diffusion exhibits distinct behavior in LD and LBMD. In LD, diffusion decreases rapidly and depends strongly on $R/r$; a phenomenological scaling involving $\ln(1+R/r)$ captures this size dependence, and additional scaling with $R_g$ reduces scatter, indicating polymer-scale correlations induced by crowding. In contrast, LBMD diffusion follows an effective-medium-like exponential dependence on concentration, governed by hydrodynamic coupling. Rouse-mode analysis identifies three regimes: scaling breakdown at low volume fraction, Zimm-like behavior at intermediate density in both LD and LB, and at high density hydrodynamic screening in LB with confinement-dominated dynamics in LD.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用Langevin动力学（LD）和格子玻尔兹曼分子动力学（LBMD）进行模拟研究。；研究对象：聚合物在含移动球形胶体拥挤剂（半径R）的流体中的结构与动力学行为，重点考察拥挤剂尺寸比R/r（r为单体半径）和体积分数φ对聚合物构象、扩散及链段弛豫的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拥挤诱导聚合物压实，但机制取决于R/r：小胶体主要改变短波长构象（自避行走行为延伸至更短尺度），大胶体降低长波长Flory指数（等效于溶剂质量变差，符合限制blob图像）。扩散行为在LD与LBMD中截然不同：LD中扩散随浓度快速下降且强烈依赖R/r，可用含ln(1+R/r)的标度描述；LBMD中扩散呈有效介质型指数依赖，由流体动力学耦合主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拥挤诱导聚合物压实，但机制取决于R/r：小胶体主要改变短波长构象（自避行走行为延伸至更短尺度），大胶体降低长波长Flory指数（等效于溶剂质量变差，符合限制blob图像）。扩散行为在LD与LBMD中截然不同：LD中扩散随浓度快速下降且强烈依赖R/r，可用含ln(1+R/r)的标度描述；LBMD中扩散呈有效介质型指数依赖，由流体动力学耦合主导。；创新点：系统对比了有无流体动力学相互作用时拥挤效应对聚合物行为的影响，揭示了LD与LBMD中扩散规律的本质差异，并识别出Rouse模式分析中的三个不同动力学区域（低浓度标度失效、中等浓度Zimm-like行为、高浓度LB中流体动力学屏蔽与LD中限制主导动力学）。摘要未突出说明与以往拥挤理论（如单纯排除体积效应）相比的定量改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种互补的模拟方法：Langevin动力学（LD，不含流体动力学相互作用）和格子玻尔兹曼分子动力学（LBMD，含长程流体动力学相互作用）。系统改变胶体尺寸比R/r和体积分数φ，通过Rouse模式分析表征链段弛豫动力学。

papers.title: Dynamical splitting and a nodal Bose liquid in 2d chiral XYZ model
papers.abstract: We study a class of Hamiltonians with a structure that we call "dynamical splitting": the Hamiltonian terms can be divided into two sets acting on the same degrees of freedom such that every term in one set commutes with every term in the other, although terms within either set do not all commute. This structure yields an algebraic duality to effective degrees of freedom on which the two parts of the Hamiltonian act disjointly, enabling exact diagonalization on lattices with approximately twice as many spins as usually accessible. We exploit it in the "chiral XYZ model", a geometrically frustrated spin-$1/2$ model on the triangular lattice which was previously introduced as a special limit of a Majorana-Hubbard model. This model also possesses anticommuting noncontractible line symmetries, which enforce an exact, topology-dependent degeneracy between locally indistinguishable states. We first study a $\mathbb{Z}_N$ clock generalization and find, at large $N$, a gapless ground state with three subsystem-symmetry-protected nodal lines. Exploiting dynamical splitting and the subsystem symmetries, we carry out exact diagonalization of the $N=2$ model on lattices up to $9\times9$ spins. The many-body gap and bipartite entanglement provide strong evidence for a gapless state consistent with the large-$N$ nodal structure: the entanglement scales as $L\log L$ and exhibits $1+1$-dimensional CFT-like chord scaling on cylinders. Finally, we study instabilities and proximate phases. In particular, we find evidence that a subsystem-symmetry-preserving deformation drives a finite coupling transition to a gapped phase with $\mathbb Z_2 \times \mathbb Z_2$ topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Hamiltonians、algebraic duality、exact diagonalization。；研究对象：二维手性XYZ模型（chiral XYZ model），即三角晶格上几何阻挫的自旋-1/2模型，源于Majorana-Hubbard模型的特殊极限；同时研究其\(\mathbb{Z}_N\)钟模型推广。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在\(N=2\)时存在无能隙基态，其节点结构（三条子系统对称性保护的节线）与大\(N\)极限一致；且存在保持子系统对称性的形变，可在有限耦合下驱动系统进入具有\(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2\)拓扑序的有能隙相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在\(N=2\)时存在无能隙基态，其节点结构（三条子系统对称性保护的节线）与大\(N\)极限一致；且存在保持子系统对称性的形变，可在有限耦合下驱动系统进入具有\(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2\)拓扑序的有能隙相。；创新点：首次提出“动力学分裂”这一哈密顿量结构并给出其代数对偶框架，使精确对角化规模显著扩展；同时揭示了该模型中非平庸的反对易非收缩线对称性导致的拓扑依赖简并，以及大\(N\)与小\(N\)之间节点结构的统一性。
papers.method_zh: 提出“动力学分裂”（dynamical splitting）哈密顿量结构，利用其代数对偶性将哈密顿量两部分解耦，从而在约两倍于常规尺寸的晶格上实现精确对角化（最大\(9\times9\)自旋）；结合子系统对称性分析、多体能隙计算和二分纠缠熵（含\(L\log L\)标度及圆柱上的1+1维CFT类弦标度）进行数值诊断。

papers.title: Origin of High-Temperature Antiferromagnetic Order in a van der Waals Material
papers.abstract: While Van der Waals (vdW) itinerant antiferromagnets with high Neel temperatures (TN) are highly desirable for spintronics, they remain relatively scarce. Here, we unravel the physical origin of the unusually high TN (= 250 K) in the newly identified vdW compound (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2. The substitution of Co in Fe4GeTe2 induces layer-selective Fe-Co ordering and stabilizes a robust antiferromagnetic (AFM) state primarily driven by Co moments. The AFM order is further strengthened by enhanced electronic correlations of quasi-localized Co 3d-states at the Fermi level, giving rise to an itinerant-localized duality of the 3d electrons. This interplay generates strong magnetic correlations well above TN and stabilizes low-temperature spin canting with a possible nontrivial Berry curvature. Our results establish (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2 as a rare material bridging fundamental magnetic interactions with potential applications in AFM spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“新发现的vdW化合物”、“诱导层选择性Fe-Co有序”等实验合成与表征内容，同时涉及“电子关联增强”、“能带计算”等理论分析关键词。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯（vdW） itinerant 反铁磁材料 (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2，以及其高温反铁磁有序的物理起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料具有异常高的奈尔温度（TN = 250 K），其反铁磁序主要由Co磁矩驱动，并通过费米能级附近准局域Co 3d态的增强电子关联得到进一步稳定，形成巡游-局域二象性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料具有异常高的奈尔温度（TN = 250 K），其反铁磁序主要由Co磁矩驱动，并通过费米能级附近准局域Co 3d态的增强电子关联得到进一步稳定，形成巡游-局域二象性。；创新点：首次揭示了Co取代Fe4GeTe2诱导的层选择性Fe-Co有序如何稳定高温反铁磁序，并指出准局域3d电子在费米能级处的关联增强是高温磁序的关键，同时提出该体系中可能存在非平庸贝里曲率导致的低温自旋倾斜，为反铁磁自旋电子学提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段或计算方法，但可推断涉及材料合成、磁性质测量（如磁化率、中子衍射等）以及电子结构计算（如DFT+U或动力学平均场理论）来揭示电子关联和磁序机制。具体手段摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Finite relaxation protocols with minimal dissipation
papers.abstract: Work extraction from nonequilibrium systems is a major challenge across biological, chemical, physical, and engineering systems. Idealized protocols generally require a quasistatic relaxation stage in which the Hamiltonian is gradually adjusted through a continuum of intermediaries. Here, we consider protocols restricted to a finite number $N$ of intermediary Hamiltonians, consisting of a sequence of quench-relax steps. We determine the sequence of quenches that minimizes the dissipated work, which can be expressed in terms of a recurrence involving the Lambert function. The optimal sequence converges to the Fisher-Rao geodesic, saturating known leading-order dissipation bounds at large $N$. We obtain lower bounds on work extraction from a nonequilibrium distribution as a function of its Fisher-Rao distance to equilibrium. We extend and apply the framework in two simple models: (i) an optical trap experiment, showing that the optimal intermediary distribution can be bimodal even for unimodal initial and final distributions, and (ii) an enzyme-catalyzed reaction, showing that that accounting for relaxation time in addition to dissipation can favor barrier-lowering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：protocols、minimizes dissipated work、recurrence、lower bounds、framework。；研究对象：非平衡系统的功提取与最小耗散问题，具体涉及有限步数N的哈密顿量弛豫协议（quench-relax序列），并应用于两个模型：光镊实验体系和酶催化反应体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限N步弛豫协议中，最优淬火序列可由含Lambert函数的递推关系确定，该序列在大N极限下收敛至Fisher-Rao测地线，并饱和已知的领头阶耗散下界；同时给出了从非平衡分布提取功的下界作为其到平衡态Fisher-Rao距离的函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限N步弛豫协议中，最优淬火序列可由含Lambert函数的递推关系确定，该序列在大N极限下收敛至Fisher-Rao测地线，并饱和已知的领头阶耗散下界；同时给出了从非平衡分布提取功的下界作为其到平衡态Fisher-Rao距离的函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出：首次针对有限N步（而非准静态连续）弛豫协议给出精确最优淬火序列的闭式递推解，并揭示其与Fisher-Rao测地线的联系；此外发现最优中间分布可呈双峰（即使初末分布均为单峰），以及在酶催化模型中同时考虑弛豫时间和耗散时可能倾向于降低能垒。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与优化分析：通过递推关系（涉及Lambert W函数）求解最小耗散淬火序列；利用Fisher-Rao信息几何框架分析协议收敛行为；并将通用框架应用于两个具体模型（光镊实验模型和酶催化反应模型）进行解析或数值演示。

papers.title: Tuning Dirac-Rashba and Double Dirac Cone Surface States of Topological Crystalline Insulator Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se by Transition Metal Adsorbate
papers.abstract: The electronic structure of topological insulator/magnetic metal (TI/MM) interfaces is of great importance for understanding of exotic spin-dependent phenomena and realization of advanced spin-orbitronic devices. Here, we employ a model system of submonolayer transition metal (TM) deposited on the surface of a topological crystalline insulator (TCI) of Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se to systematically map out the modification of the surface electronic structure by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) as a function of coverage. For the polar (111) Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se surface, we observe the coexistence of the Dirac topological surface states (TSS) and Rashba-split surface states (RSS) induced by the combined effects of inversion-symmetry breaking, surface band bending and orbital angular momentum effects. In particular, we demonstrate very large Rashba splittings can be obtained and the Rashba parameter ($α_R$) can be tuned over a remarkably wide range from 0 to 3.5 eV ${\cdot}$ $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, depending on the type and coverage of the TM adatoms. Model-Hamiltonian calculations corroborate the experimental findings and reveal that this coexistence results from the filling of the TSS by the surface doping caused by the TM. In contrast, for the nonpolar (001) surface exhibiting a double Dirac cone topological surface state, the inversion symmetry is preserved and hence no Rashba-split surface states emerge. Instead, surface charge imbalance induces dephasing of the wave functions of the double Dirac cones that diminishes the momentum-space separation between them. These findings shed light on novel phenomena occurring at the topological insulator / transition metal interface, offering a versatile platform for future spintronic and quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合模型哈密顿量计算）。判断依据：摘要明确使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）作为主要研究手段，并辅以模型哈密顿量计算进行佐证。；研究对象：拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 的极性 (111) 与非极性 (001) 表面，以及亚单层过渡金属（TM）吸附物对其表面电子结构的调控。具体物理现象包括 Dirac 拓扑表面态、Rashba 分裂表面态以及双 Dirac 锥表面态的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极性 (111) 表面，过渡金属吸附可实现 Dirac 拓扑表面态与 Rashba 分裂表面态的共存，且 Rashba 参数 α_R 可在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的极宽范围内连续调控；在非极性 (001) 表面，表面电荷失衡导致双 Dirac 锥波函数退相干，减小了其在动量空间的分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极性 (111) 表面，过渡金属吸附可实现 Dirac 拓扑表面态与 Rashba 分裂表面态的共存，且 Rashba 参数 α_R 可在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的极宽范围内连续调控；在非极性 (001) 表面，表面电荷失衡导致双 Dirac 锥波函数退相干，减小了其在动量空间的分离。；创新点：首次系统展示了在拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 表面通过过渡金属吸附实现 Rashba 参数从 0 到 3.5 eV·Å 的超宽范围连续调控，并揭示了极性/非极性表面上截然不同的电子结构调控机制（Rashba 分裂 vs. 双 Dirac 锥退相干）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）系统测量不同过渡金属种类及覆盖度下的表面电子结构变化；理论上采用模型哈密顿量计算对实验结果进行验证和解释。
