papers.title: Thermalization packets and optimal ice cubes
papers.abstract: Relaxation toward equilibrium is usually accelerated by modifying the environment or by cooling a system further from equilibrium. Here we introduce a distinct strategy: thermalization packets, auxiliary systems prepared in advance and later coupled to a target system to accelerate its relaxation toward a prescribed thermal state. Thus, thermalization packets trade preparation effort for reduced waiting time. When the objective is cooling, we colloquially refer to such packets as ice cubes. Unlike ordinary coolants, thermalization packets are characterized not only by their temperature or heat capacity, but also by their microscopic preparation. We define perfect and optimal packets by their ability to suppress the slowest relaxation mode of the coupled dynamics: perfect packets eliminate it entirely, while optimal packets minimize its amplitude. We show that, under generic conditions, perfect packets exist among thermal preparations near equilibrium. Surprisingly, for asymptotic relaxation, the optimum among thermal preparations is generally not the coldest packet: cooling the packet beyond the slow-mode-cancelling optimum restores a nonzero slow mode and can therefore slow relaxation, yielding a packet analog of the Mpemba effect. We demonstrate the concept in exactly solvable Metropolis dynamics, a minimal two-qubit model, and a boundary-coupled interacting Ising-spin system. We also extend the framework to packets optimized for finite readout times. Finally, we show that the perfect-packet contour can connect the trivial bath-equilibrium point to a nontrivial strong Mpemba or strong inverse-Mpemba point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“exactly solvable Metropolis dynamics”“minimal two-qubit model”“boundary-coupled interacting Ising-spin system”等理论模型与解析求解。；研究对象：开放量子/经典系统的弛豫动力学，具体研究一种名为“thermalization packets”（热化包）的辅助系统，用于加速目标系统向预定热态的弛豫；在冷却场景中称为“ice cubes”（冰块）。涉及体系包括Metropolis动力学、两量子比特模型以及边界耦合的相互作用Ising自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过预先制备辅助系统（热化包）并耦合到目标系统，可以抑制弛豫中最慢的模式，从而加速弛豫；且对于渐近弛豫，最优热化包并非最冷的包——过度冷却会重新引入慢模式并减缓弛豫，产生类似Mpemba效应的“包模拟效应”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过预先制备辅助系统（热化包）并耦合到目标系统，可以抑制弛豫中最慢的模式，从而加速弛豫；且对于渐近弛豫，最优热化包并非最冷的包——过度冷却会重新引入慢模式并减缓弛豫，产生类似Mpemba效应的“包模拟效应”。；创新点：提出“热化包”这一全新策略，将弛豫加速问题转化为辅助系统的制备优化，而非传统上修改环境或进一步冷却目标系统；揭示了热化包的最优制备与温度之间的非单调关系（Mpemba效应的包模拟），并证明完美包轮廓可连接平凡浴平衡点与非平凡强Mpemba/强逆Mpemba点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析求解：利用Metropolis动力学的精确可解性、最小两量子比特模型的解析处理，以及边界耦合相互作用Ising自旋系统的数值/解析研究；定义了“完美包”（完全消除最慢弛豫模式）和“最优包”（最小化最慢模式振幅）的概念，并推广到有限读出时间优化情形。

papers.title: The Effects of Inter-Valley Coupling of Dirac Fermions near Four Dimensions
papers.abstract: We analyze the criticality of an Ising Gross-Neveu-Yukawa (GNY) theory of $N_ψ$ Dirac fermion valleys with intra- and inter-valley interactions, using a renormalization-group analysis in $4-ε$ space-time dimensions to one-loop order. The conventional GNY fixed point of decoupled valleys is unstable against inter-valley fluctuations which are naturally present if the symmetry breaking is driven by short-ranged interactions. At the new fixed point, the critical exponents differ from the conventional GNY universality. Most importantly, Lorentz invariance is broken due to interference effects resulting from the relative rotation between valley coordinate frames. In the limit of large $N_ψ$ the critical fixed point with finite inter-valley coupling remains stable but Lorentz invariance is asymptotically restored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group analysis、one-loop order、fixed point、critical exponents。；研究对象：四维时空附近的狄拉克费米子体系，具体为具有谷内与谷间相互作用的 Ising Gross-Neveu-Yukawa（GNY）理论，涉及多谷（N_ψ 个谷）狄拉克费米子及其量子临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 4-ε 展开下，传统解耦谷的 GNY 固定点对谷间涨落不稳定，新的临界固定点具有不同于传统 GNY 普适类的临界指数，且由于谷坐标系相对旋转导致的干涉效应，洛伦兹不变性被破坏；在大 N_ψ 极限下，有限谷间耦合的临界固定点仍稳定，但洛伦兹不变性渐近恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 4-ε 展开下，传统解耦谷的 GNY 固定点对谷间涨落不稳定，新的临界固定点具有不同于传统 GNY 普适类的临界指数，且由于谷坐标系相对旋转导致的干涉效应，洛伦兹不变性被破坏；在大 N_ψ 极限下，有限谷间耦合的临界固定点仍稳定，但洛伦兹不变性渐近恢复。；创新点：揭示了谷间耦合对 GNY 量子临界性的关键影响，特别是发现谷间干涉效应导致洛伦兹不变性破缺这一非传统现象，以及大 N_ψ 极限下洛伦兹不变性的渐近恢复行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用 4-ε 空间-时间维度下的重整化群分析，计算至单圈阶，研究谷内与谷间相互作用对临界性的影响。

papers.title: Micromechanical statistical model links induced nematic order to mechanical response in fiber networks
papers.abstract: Contractile cells and external loads reorganize the fibrous extracellular matrix, aligning and compacting fibers over distances far exceeding a cell's size, strongly affecting bioprocesses such as wound healing, angiogenesis and tumor invasion. We develop a continuum micromechanical theory that links, at every material point, the load-induced orientational order to the mechanical response that the reoriented network then exhibits. The network is described statistically, by the probability density of fiber orientations, and deforms affinely, so that a single-fiber stress-strain law is carried into the network stress, with the deformation set self-consistently by mechanical equilibrium. Critical to realistic biological relevant conditions, this theory allows both geometrical and material nonlinearities. Applied to a two-dimensional network under uniaxial stretch, the theory collapses onto a single anisotropy parameter that governs the orientation distribution, the nematic order, the Poisson ratio, and the densification of fibers. Our theory reveals that induced order and densification are highly positively correlated, and in the case of uniaxial stretch they collapse onto a nearly universal curve, independent of the single-fiber stiffness behavior. For a contracting cell, we find that buckling controls how far nematic orientational order and densification propagate. We find an algebraic decay of deformations with distance and solve for the dependence of the power-law exponent on the buckled-reduced stiffness of a single fiber. We validate our theory by comparison with non-affine discrete fiber-network simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含与离散纤维网络模拟的对比验证）。判断依据：关键词为“continuum micromechanical theory”“statistically”“affinely deform”“self-consistently by mechanical equilibrium”，以及“validate by comparison with non-affine discrete fiber-network simulations”。；研究对象：纤维网络（细胞外基质）在收缩细胞或外部载荷作用下诱导的向列序（nematic order）及其力学响应，具体涉及纤维取向分布、泊松比、纤维致密化（densification）以及屈曲（buckling）控制的变形传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论揭示：在单轴拉伸下，诱导的向列序与纤维致密化高度正相关，且二者在归一化后几乎落在同一条普适曲线上，与单纤维刚度行为无关；对于收缩细胞，屈曲控制向列序和致密化的传播距离，变形随距离呈代数衰减，幂律指数由单纤维屈曲后的折减刚度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论揭示：在单轴拉伸下，诱导的向列序与纤维致密化高度正相关，且二者在归一化后几乎落在同一条普适曲线上，与单纤维刚度行为无关；对于收缩细胞，屈曲控制向列序和致密化的传播距离，变形随距离呈代数衰减，幂律指数由单纤维屈曲后的折减刚度决定。；创新点：该理论在连续介质层面将每个材料点的载荷诱导取向序与重取向后的力学响应直接耦合，并允许几何与材料双重非线性；在单轴拉伸情形下将问题约化为单一各向异性参数，统一描述取向分布、向列序、泊松比和致密化，并发现向列序与致密化的近普适关联。摘要未突出说明与已有连续介质纤维网络理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个连续介质微力学统计理论：用纤维取向的概率密度描述网络，假设仿射变形，将单纤维应力-应变关系带入网络应力，并通过力学平衡自洽确定变形场。该理论同时包含几何非线性和材料非线性。验证手段为与非仿射离散纤维网络模拟进行对比。

papers.title: Carrier-Resolved Attosecond Valley Polarimetry of Monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: In recent years, all-optical writing and switching of valley polarization in two-dimensional semiconductors has been demonstrated on femtosecond timescales. Reading this polarization out on the same timescale, carrier by carrier, has so far remained out of reach. Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations of monolayer MoS$_2$, we show that attosecond transient absorption closes this gap by turning the Mo $4p$ semicore edge into a quantitative valley polarimeter. We find that pump-enabled core-to-valence absorption probes the holes while core-to-conduction bleaching probes the electrons, so that a single spectrum identifies each carrier by its photoabsorption energy. The hole channel, Pauli-blocked in equilibrium, emerges background-free. Its circular dichroism reverses sign with the pump helicity, and its normalized magnitude is proportional to the valley polarization. Finally, we show that scanning the probe delay clocks the few-femtosecond write in real time. Thus, attosecond core-level dichroism is a carrier-sensitive, quantitative probe of the creation and evolution of valley polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations”（采用半导体布洛赫方程模拟）。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS₂）中的谷极化（valley polarization）超快动力学，具体关注载流子分辨的谷极化读取。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷偏振计，实现逐载流子（空穴与电子）分辨的谷极化测量；其圆二色性符号随泵浦光手性反转，归一化强度正比于谷极化度，并可实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用阿秒瞬态吸收谱可将Mo 4p半芯能级转变为定量谷偏振计，实现逐载流子（空穴与电子）分辨的谷极化测量；其圆二色性符号随泵浦光手性反转，归一化强度正比于谷极化度，并可实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。；创新点：首次提出在飞秒时间尺度上、逐载流子（空穴与电子分别）读取谷极化的全光学方案，利用芯能级圆二色性实现无背景、定量且载流子敏感的谷极化探测，突破了此前仅能测量整体极化或无法单载流子分辨的限制。
papers.method_zh: 半导体布洛赫方程（Semiconductor Bloch Equations, SBE）数值模拟，模拟单层MoS₂的阿秒瞬态吸收光谱，分析泵浦诱导的芯能级到价带/导带的吸收与漂白信号。

papers.title: Convergence of the conformal Ward identity in the derivative expansion approximation
papers.abstract: Conformal invariance is expected to be an emergent property of many systems in their critical regime. However, approximation schemes generically spoil this property. This is in particular the case of the derivative expansion, a widely used approximation scheme in the framework of the functional renormalization group. In this article, we consider Ward identities associated with conformal invariance in the 3-d Ising universality class with truncations at order 4 (next-to-next-to-leading order) in the derivative expansion, with $Z_2$ invariant composite operators. Our results confirm that the regulating functions which yield a small breaking of conformal invariance also present a small sensitivity of the universal critical exponents with the choice of this regulating function. We also show that, in the vicinity of regulator-parameter values for which the conformal constraints are best satisfied, the breaking of conformal invariance reduces as the order of the derivative expansion is increased, providing a new indication of the convergence of this approximation scheme.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“functional renormalization group”（泛函重整化群）、“derivative expansion”（导数展开）、“Ward identities”（Ward恒等式）等理论方法关键词，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：三维Ising普适类（3-d Ising universality class）中的共形不变性，以及导数展开近似下共形Ward恒等式的收敛行为。具体体系为具有Z₂对称性的复合算符。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在导数展开至第4阶（NNLO）截断下，使共形对称性破缺较小的调节函数，其对普适临界指数随调节函数选择的敏感性也较小；且在共形约束最佳满足的调节参数附近，随着导数展开阶数增加，共形对称性破缺减小，表明该近似方案具有收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在导数展开至第4阶（NNLO）截断下，使共形对称性破缺较小的调节函数，其对普适临界指数随调节函数选择的敏感性也较小；且在共形约束最佳满足的调节参数附近，随着导数展开阶数增加，共形对称性破缺减小，表明该近似方案具有收敛性。；创新点：首次在导数展开NNLO阶次下系统检验共形Ward恒等式的收敛性，并建立了调节函数导致的共形破缺大小与普适临界指数对调节函数敏感性之间的关联，为导数展开近似的收敛性提供了新证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（FRG）框架下的导数展开近似，截断至第4阶（next-to-next-to-leading order, NNLO），并考虑Z₂不变的复合算符，通过分析共形不变性对应的Ward恒等式来检验对称性破缺程度。

papers.title: Probing bulk superconductivity in centrosymmetric Te-doped PtBi$_2$ single crystals
papers.abstract: The Weyl semimetal $γ$-PtBi$_2$ has been shown to be one of the most promising novel materials, recently proposed as a topological i-wave superconductor. A crucial requirement for observing this physics is the absence of inversion symmetry in its trigonal $P31m$ crystal structure. Centrosymmetry has been reported to be readily restored in the $P\overline{3}m1$ structure upon electron doping, partially substituting Bi with as little as 2% Te. In this work, we synthesized Te-doped PtBi$_{2-x}$Te$_{x}$ samples and thoroughly investigated the bulk superconductivity of selected single crystals with nominal composition PtBi$_{1.96}$Te$_{0.04}$, exhibiting the highest superconducting volume fraction of $\sim100$%. Single crystal XRD measurements confirm the centrosymmetric $P\overline{3}m1$ structure in our samples, whereas bulk superconductivity with a critical temperature of $T_\mathrm{c} \approx 2.4\,$K was observed in magnetization and specific heat measurements. The upper critical fields for two different orientations were determined as $H^{\parallel}_{\mathrm{c2}}(0)\approx 6.3\,$kOe for in-plane and $H^{\perp}_{\mathrm{c2}}(0)\approx 4.7\,$kOe for out-of-plane magnetic fields. Robust superconductivity was also found in resistance and point contact measurements, where the latter showed a slight enhancement of the critical temperature up to $T_\mathrm{c} \sim 3\,$K. Finally, ARPES measurements corroborate the centrosymmetric structure of our samples, showing a single surface termination and the absence of Fermi arcs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized”“single crystal XRD measurements”“magnetization and specific heat measurements”“resistance and point contact measurements”“ARPES measurements”等大量实验手段。；研究对象：碲（Te）掺杂的PtBi₂单晶，具体名义成分为PtBi₁.₉₆Te₀.₀₄，研究其中心对称结构下的体超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称P̄3m1结构的Te掺杂PtBi₂单晶中观测到体超导电性，临界温度T_c≈2.4 K，超导体积分数约100%，且未观察到费米弧，与中心对称结构一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称P̄3m1结构的Te掺杂PtBi₂单晶中观测到体超导电性，临界温度T_c≈2.4 K，超导体积分数约100%，且未观察到费米弧，与中心对称结构一致。；创新点：通过少量Te掺杂（2%）将γ-PtBi₂从非中心对称P31m结构转变为中心对称P̄3m1结构，从而系统研究了中心对称体系中该材料的体超导电性，并排除了拓扑i-wave超导所需的非中心对称条件。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射（XRD）确定晶体结构；磁化率和比热测量确认体超导；电阻和点接触谱测量超导特性；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）验证表面终止和电子结构。

papers.title: Intercalation of Alkali Metal into WTe2, the Crystal Structure of A0.5WTe2 and Observation of a Metal-to-Semiconductor Transition
papers.abstract: We explore the cationic intercalation of tungsten ditelluride (WTe2) with potassium (K), rubidium (Rb), and cesium (Cs), yielding intercalation compounds of the form A0.5WTe2 (A = K, Rb, Cs). Structural characterization was performed using powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), while diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform (DRIFT) spectroscopy and temperature-dependent conductivity measurements were employed to investigate the electronic properties. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out to support the experimental findings and to provide insight into the intercalation mechanisms and the resulting material characteristics. All synthesized compounds display semiconducting behavior with narrow band gaps, emphasizing the influence of alkali metal intercalation on the electronic structure and transport properties of WTe2. These results advance the fundamental understanding of property modulation in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) and highlight their potential for electronic device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时涉及实验合成与表征（PXRD、DRIFT光谱、电导率测量）以及密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：碱金属（K、Rb、Cs）插层二碲化钨（WTe2）形成的插层化合物 A0.5WTe2（A = K, Rb, Cs），以及插层引起的金属-半导体转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有合成的 A0.5WTe2 插层化合物均表现出窄带隙半导体行为，表明碱金属插层将原始 WTe2 的金属性转变为半导体性，显著调控了其电子结构和输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有合成的 A0.5WTe2 插层化合物均表现出窄带隙半导体行为，表明碱金属插层将原始 WTe2 的金属性转变为半导体性，显著调控了其电子结构和输运性质。；创新点：系统研究了 K、Rb、Cs 三种碱金属对 WTe2 的插层，并首次报道了 A0.5WTe2 的晶体结构及其金属-半导体转变行为，为过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDCs）中通过插层实现性质调控提供了新范例。（摘要未突出说明更具体的创新细节）
papers.method_zh: - 实验：粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）用于结构表征；漫反射红外傅里叶变换（DRIFT）光谱和变温电导率测量用于电子性质研究。

papers.title: High-pressure phase transitions in the quantum spin liquid candidate Na2Co2TeO6 probed by Raman spectroscopy
papers.abstract: The quasi-2D magnet Na2Co2TeO6 (NCTO) is a candidate for a Kitaev Quantum Spin Liquid (KQSL) state. Pressure-tuning in such materials is of interest as a potential method to tune the Kitaev exchange interactions, which are strongly dependent on bond geometry. Here we report a Raman spectroscopic study of NCTO inside a diamond anvil cell (DAC) with pressure applied up to 16.3 GPa. Based on the changes in the Raman modes, this pressure range is divided into three regions. The appearance and disappearance of several modes and changes in the polarization dependence of the representative modes, most prominently above 13.8 GPa, point to pressure-induced phase transitions in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Raman spectroscopic study”（拉曼光谱研究）以及“diamond anvil cell”（金刚石压砧）等实验手段。；研究对象：准二维磁性材料 Na₂Co₂TeO₆（NCTO），该材料被认为是 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（KQSL）的候选材料。研究聚焦于其在高压下的结构相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 0–16.3 GPa 压力范围内，NCTO 的拉曼光谱表现出三个不同的压力区域；多个拉曼模式的出现与消失，以及代表性模式偏振依赖性的变化（尤其在 13.8 GPa 以上最为显著），表明该材料在高压下发生了压力诱导的结构相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 0–16.3 GPa 压力范围内，NCTO 的拉曼光谱表现出三个不同的压力区域；多个拉曼模式的出现与消失，以及代表性模式偏振依赖性的变化（尤其在 13.8 GPa 以上最为显著），表明该材料在高压下发生了压力诱导的结构相变。；创新点：首次利用拉曼光谱系统研究了 NCTO 在高压下的结构稳定性与相变行为，为通过压力调控 Kitaev 交换相互作用（其强烈依赖键几何）提供了实验依据。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 高压拉曼光谱学（Raman spectroscopy），结合金刚石压砧（DAC）装置施加最高 16.3 GPa 的准静水压，并测量拉曼模式的偏振依赖性。

papers.title: Delta-Function Kicks are Optimal for Rapidly Driven Inertial Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: Optimal control helps guide our understanding of stochastic thermodynamics, leading to universal properties and geometric formulations. Among the initially surprising properties of optimal control, not only discrete jumps but delta function kicks have been shown to be necessary to minimize dissipation in specific example systems. Using a short-time approximation, I show that delta-function kicks are universally optimal for minimizing dissipation in inertial stochastic systems, including active and quantum dynamics under general constraints. Fundamentally stemming from basic kinematics, delta-function kicks are required to achieve linear scaling of work with short protocol durations compared to the quadratic scaling without the kicks. This implies a diverging (infinite) ratio of saved work in the short-time limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“short-time approximation”“show that”“universally optimal”等理论推导与分析关键词。；研究对象：惯性随机系统（inertial stochastic systems），包括有源（active）和量子动力学系统，在快速驱动（rapidly driven）条件下的最优控制与耗散最小化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短时近似下，δ函数脉冲（delta-function kicks）是惯性随机系统中最小化耗散的普适最优控制形式；与无脉冲时的二次标度相比，δ函数脉冲可使功随协议时长呈线性标度，从而在短时极限下节省功的比值发散（趋于无穷）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短时近似下，δ函数脉冲（delta-function kicks）是惯性随机系统中最小化耗散的普适最优控制形式；与无脉冲时的二次标度相比，δ函数脉冲可使功随协议时长呈线性标度，从而在短时极限下节省功的比值发散（趋于无穷）。；创新点：将δ函数脉冲的最优性从特定示例系统推广到惯性随机系统的普适情形，并涵盖有源与量子动力学；揭示了该最优性源于基本运动学（basic kinematics），而非具体系统细节。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用短时近似（short-time approximation）解析推导，结合最优控制理论（optimal control）与随机热力学（stochastic thermodynamics）框架，分析惯性随机系统在一般约束下的耗散最小化问题。

papers.title: Persistence length of short homopolymeric single-stranded DNA sequences in polyvalent cations
papers.abstract: We used simulations of short single stranded DNA (ssDNA) homopolymers, based on the sequence dependent Three Interaction Site (TIS) model, to calculate the persistence length ($l_p$) in polyvalent cations. The TIS model accounts for stacking interactions and electrostatic interactions are treated using the Coulomb potential. We find that $l_p$ for $\mathrm{dT_{30}}$ (T is thymine) and $\mathrm{dA_{30}}$ (A is adenine) is quantitatively fit using $l_p = l_p^0 + λκ^{-1}$ ($l_p^0$ is the bare persistence length, $λ$ is a dimensionless constant, and $κ$ is the inverse Debye length) in the divalent cations $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ and $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$. The dependence of $l_p$ on $κ$ is surprising because it was derived for long flexible polyelectrolytes in which the charges interact via the Debye-Hückel potential. The $l_p^0$ values are 0.4 nm and 1.1 nm for polyT and polyA, respectively. Strikingly, $l_p$ is almost independent of the tetravalent spermine concentration. There is no clear theoretical explanation although simulations suggest that the number of spermine molecules that bind to the ssDNA saturates at a small value. A qualitative picture, based on the restrictions of access to the phosphate groups due to volume exclusion of the anisotropic structure of $\mathrm{Spm^{4+}}$, rationalizes the simulation results. The predicted dependence of $l_p$ in spermine awaits experimental test.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We used simulations”（使用模拟），基于TIS模型进行计算。；研究对象：短同聚单链DNA（ssDNA）序列，具体为dT₃₀（多聚胸腺嘧啶）和dA₃₀（多聚腺嘌呤），在多价阳离子（二价Mg²⁺、Ca²⁺及四价精胺Spm⁴⁺）环境下的持久长度（persistence length, l_p）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二价阳离子Mg²⁺和Ca²⁺中，dT₃₀和dA₃₀的持久长度满足l_p = l_p⁰ + λκ⁻¹（κ为德拜长度的倒数），其中polyT和polyA的裸持久长度分别为0.4 nm和1.1 nm；但持久长度几乎不依赖于四价精胺的浓度，这一现象缺乏明确理论解释，模拟提示精胺分子与ssDNA的结合数在很小值即饱和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二价阳离子Mg²⁺和Ca²⁺中，dT₃₀和dA₃₀的持久长度满足l_p = l_p⁰ + λκ⁻¹（κ为德拜长度的倒数），其中polyT和polyA的裸持久长度分别为0.4 nm和1.1 nm；但持久长度几乎不依赖于四价精胺的浓度，这一现象缺乏明确理论解释，模拟提示精胺分子与ssDNA的结合数在很小值即饱和。；创新点：发现原本为长柔性聚电解质在德拜-休克尔势下推导的l_p对κ的线性依赖关系，竟能定量适用于短ssDNA在二价阳离子中的行为；此外，揭示四价精胺浓度对l_p几乎无影响的非直观现象，并提出基于Spm⁴⁺各向异性结构对磷酸基团体积排阻的定性解释。该预测有待实验验证。
papers.method_zh: 基于序列依赖的三位点（Three Interaction Site, TIS）模型的分子模拟。TIS模型考虑碱基堆积相互作用，静电相互作用采用库仑势处理（隐含德拜-休克尔框架下的屏蔽效应）。

papers.title: Raman magnon spectroscopy of local interactions and ground state selection in $\mathrm{Sr_2IrO_4}$
papers.abstract: Competing and coupled spin and charge interactions in quantum materials lead to a variety of ordered states where local configurations preferentially influence the long-range order. When these interactions are finely balanced in energy, disorder and fluctuations play an outsized role. Raman scattering is particularly well-suited to revealing the underlying physics in such situations because of its sensitivity to local environments and ability to reveal overall symmetries. We perform angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements on single crystals of the correlated, layered magnet, \ce{Sr2IrO4}, where the Mott insulating ground state arises from strong spin-orbit coupling. We characterize the symmetries of both the phonon and magnon modes through comprehensive measurements in both the $ab$-plane and out-of-plane geometries from 10 to 700 cm$^{-1}$, and trace the evolution of these modes in both configurations to 12 GPa in a diamond anvil cell with perforated diamonds. Pressure does not significantly alter the lattice as the phonon modes shift linearly under compression, but at the same time the magnon modes become position dependent and spread over a range of wavenumbers. We attribute this magnetic heterogeneity to pressure-enhanced variations in the weak interlayer interactions, which may locally favor competing magnetic stacking configurations, and compare our experimental results to the predictions of linear spin wave calculations. Our results demonstrate that Raman-active magnons amplify $μ$eV-scale interactions responsible for ground-state selection into easily measurable spectral changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Raman scattering measurements”“angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements”“diamond anvil cell”等实验手段，并涉及与线性自旋波计算的对比。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合导致的Mott绝缘体层状磁体 Sr₂IrO₄（铱酸锶），重点研究其声子与磁振子（magnon）模式在高压下的行为，以及局域相互作用对基态选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压（至12 GPa）下，Sr₂IrO₄的声子模式随压缩线性移动（晶格无明显改变），但磁振子模式变得依赖于位置并展宽为一定波数范围。这种磁性不均匀性源于压力增强的弱层间相互作用涨落，可能局域地偏好竞争的磁堆叠构型。Raman活性磁振子将决定基态选择的μeV尺度相互作用放大为易于测量的光谱变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压（至12 GPa）下，Sr₂IrO₄的声子模式随压缩线性移动（晶格无明显改变），但磁振子模式变得依赖于位置并展宽为一定波数范围。这种磁性不均匀性源于压力增强的弱层间相互作用涨落，可能局域地偏好竞争的磁堆叠构型。Raman活性磁振子将决定基态选择的μeV尺度相互作用放大为易于测量的光谱变化。；创新点：利用Raman散射对局域环境的敏感性，首次将高压下磁振子模式的空间不均匀性与弱层间相互作用的增强联系起来，揭示μeV尺度相互作用对基态选择的影响，并将其放大为可观测的光谱信号。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨Raman偏振测量（ab面及面外几何，10–700 cm⁻¹），结合金刚石对顶砧（带穿孔金刚石）实现高压实验（至12 GPa）；实验结果与线性自旋波（linear spin wave）计算结果对比。

papers.title: Directed walks shape a universal square-root law of entropy production rate in nonreciprocal systems
papers.abstract: The entropy production rate (EPR) quantifies irreversibility of a nonequilibrium steady state, yet standard formulas obscure how a complex interaction network generates it. For multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics on such networks, we express the EPR as a quadratic form in antisymmetric matrices measuring the nonreciprocity of aggregate directed walks at every length, and, equivalently, as two weighted-walk quantities: pairs of directed walks sharing both endpoints, and directed closed walks. For diagonalizable interactions, an exact correspondence translates these walk quantities into eigenvalues and biorthogonal eigenvector overlaps. Across dense, sparse, and deep acyclic random interactions satisfying matched-walk conditions, the mean EPR per node universally follows the square-root law $φ_*(g)=1-\sqrt{1-g^2}$, where $g \in [0,1)$ parametrizes the interaction strength. Deep acyclic interaction matrices are nilpotent, with all eigenvalues fixed at zero for every $g$, yet, as their depth increases, their mean EPR per node approaches $φ_*(g)$. Thus, the square-root law arises from directed walk properties, rather than from a shared spectral density or specific network topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics”“exact correspondence”“eigenvalues and biorthogonal eigenvector overlaps”等理论推导与解析分析关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非互易（nonreciprocal）相互作用网络上的多变量Ornstein-Uhlenbeck动力学系统，重点研究其非平衡稳态的熵产生率（EPR）与有向游走（directed walks）结构之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足匹配游走条件的稠密、稀疏及深层无环随机相互作用下，每个节点的平均熵产生率普遍遵循平方根定律 φ*(g)=1−√(1−g²)，其中 g∈[0,1) 为相互作用强度参数。该定律源于有向游走的拓扑性质，而非谱密度或特定网络拓扑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足匹配游走条件的稠密、稀疏及深层无环随机相互作用下，每个节点的平均熵产生率普遍遵循平方根定律 φ*(g)=1−√(1−g²)，其中 g∈[0,1) 为相互作用强度参数。该定律源于有向游走的拓扑性质，而非谱密度或特定网络拓扑。；创新点：揭示了熵产生率的平方根定律可由有向游走性质直接导出，而非依赖于谱密度或具体网络拓扑；特别地，深层无环（幂零）矩阵所有特征值恒为零，但其平均EPR仍趋近于同一平方根定律，这凸显了游走视角相对于传统谱方法的独特解释力。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将EPR表示为反对称矩阵的二次型，该矩阵度量各长度聚合有向游走的非互易性；等价地，将EPR表达为两类加权游走量（共享两端点的有向游走对、有向闭合游走）。对于可对角化相互作用，利用特征值与双正交特征向量重叠建立精确对应关系。分析对象包括稠密、稀疏和深层无环随机相互作用矩阵（后者为幂零矩阵）。

papers.title: Photonic spin-Hall effect as a probe for time-reversal-symmetry broken band topological phases
papers.abstract: When a plane polarized Gaussian beam of light is incident on a surface, upon reflection it splits into right and left circularly polarized beams that are spatially separated in the direction perpendicular to the plane of incidence. This is known as the photonic spin-Hall effect (PSHE). In this work, we show that the centroid shift, which is the intensity weighted average of the shifts of the right and the left circularly polarized beams directly probes the optical Hall conductivity, which carries the essential information about the topological properties of the system. We show that the centroid shift as a function of the frequency of light has a unique sign structure depending on whether the system is in a time-reversal symmetry broken band topological phase or a trivial phase. Thus, the PSHE may serve as an unambiguous and a non-invasive probe to detect time-reversal symmetry broken band topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show that”（我们证明），且讨论的是物理机制与理论预言，未提及实验样品或测量设备。；研究对象：光子自旋霍尔效应（PSHE）——即偏振高斯光束在表面反射时分裂为左右圆偏振分量的现象，以及该效应与时间反演对称性破缺的能带拓扑相之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PSHE的质心位移（左右圆偏振光位移的强度加权平均）直接探测光学霍尔电导率，而该电导率携带体系拓扑性质的关键信息。质心位移随光频变化的符号结构可明确区分体系处于时间反演对称性破缺的拓扑相还是平庸相，因此PSHE可作为无接触、无破坏性的拓扑相探测手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PSHE的质心位移（左右圆偏振光位移的强度加权平均）直接探测光学霍尔电导率，而该电导率携带体系拓扑性质的关键信息。质心位移随光频变化的符号结构可明确区分体系处于时间反演对称性破缺的拓扑相还是平庸相，因此PSHE可作为无接触、无破坏性的拓扑相探测手段。；创新点：提出利用PSHE的质心位移作为时间反演对称性破缺拓扑相的非侵入式光学探针，建立了宏观光学效应（光束空间分离）与微观拓扑性质（光学霍尔电导率）之间的直接联系。摘要未突出说明与已有光学探测手段（如克尔/法拉第旋转）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于平面偏振高斯光束在表面反射的物理图像，推导质心位移与光学霍尔电导率之间的定量关系，并分析其随频率变化的符号结构，用以区分拓扑相与平庸相。

papers.title: Microscopic Modeling of the Charge-Density-Waves in the Rare-Earth Tritellurides
papers.abstract: Despite being arguably the simplest and best characterized quasi-2D charge-density-wave (CDW) systems, the rare-earth tritellurides ($R$Te$_3$) continue to yield surprising experimental results, including recent evidence suggestive of mirror-symmetry breaking associated with the onset of CDW order. Motivated by this, we consider a 2D electron-phonon model for a single Te square-net plane, which we analyze using mean-field theory. For an appropriate region of parameter space, we find a finite-temperature continuous transition from the normal state to a unidirectional CDW state with an ordering vector matching that observed experimentally. At lower temperatures, we find a second translation-symmetry-breaking transition, similar to what occurs in $R$Te$_3$ compounds with heavier rare-earth elements. In certain parameter regimes, we also find an intervening mirror-symmetry-breaking transition occurring between the two transitions described above. These results reveal an intrinsic susceptibility to mirror-symmetry breaking in the unidirectional CDW phase, which is relevant to understanding recent experiments on the $R$Te$_3$ compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“we consider a 2D electron-phonon model”“we analyze using mean-field theory”，属于理论建模与数值分析。；研究对象：稀土三碲化物（\(R\)Te\(_3\)）中的准二维电荷密度波（CDW）相，特别是单个Te正方形网格平面内的CDW序及其对称性破缺行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在合适的参数区间内，模型给出从正常态到单向CDW态的有限温度连续相变，其序矢与实验一致；在更低温度下出现第二次平移对称性破缺转变，且在特定参数区间内两者之间还存在一个镜面对称破缺转变，表明单向CDW相具有内在的镜面对称破缺敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在合适的参数区间内，模型给出从正常态到单向CDW态的有限温度连续相变，其序矢与实验一致；在更低温度下出现第二次平移对称性破缺转变，且在特定参数区间内两者之间还存在一个镜面对称破缺转变，表明单向CDW相具有内在的镜面对称破缺敏感性。；创新点：通过微观模型揭示了单向CDW相中镜面对称破缺转变的内在可能性，为理解近期在\(R\)Te\(_3\)实验中观察到的与CDW序相关的镜面对称破缺迹象提供了理论解释。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 构建二维电子-声子耦合模型，采用平均场理论（mean-field theory）进行自洽求解，分析不同温度下的对称性破缺相变序列。

papers.title: Quantum spin Hall crystals at fractional filling of twisted MoTe$_2$
papers.abstract: We predict and classify interaction-driven quantum spin Hall crystals (QSHCs), a class of states emerging at fractional filling through an interplay of topology and spontaneous translation-symmetry breaking. QSHCs form nearly degenerate manifolds whose members can realize distinct topological phases protected by time-reversal or valley $U(1)_v$ symmetry, with time-reversal acting nontrivially within the manifold. As a representative of this broad class of states we provide evidence for 9-fold quasi-degenerate $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ charge ordered QSHCs at $ν= -8/3$ of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ near a $5^\circ$ twist. Here a $\mathbb{Z}_3$ index organizes states related by lattice translation into three time-reversal invariant states with nontrivial $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topology and three time-reversal related doublets whose individual members spontaneously break time-reversal and carry a $U(1)_v$ protected spin-Chern number. Finally, we determine the conditions that favor QSHCs over closely competing intervalley-coherent crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“predict and classify”“provide evidence for”等理论预测与分类表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：扭曲双层MoTe₂（twisted bilayer MoTe₂）在分数填充（ν = -8/3，约5°扭转角）下的量子自旋霍尔晶体（QSHC）态，即拓扑与自发平移对称性破缺相互作用的产物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν = -8/3的扭曲MoTe₂中，预测存在9重准简并的√3×√3电荷有序量子自旋霍尔晶体态，其成员由时间反演或谷U(1)v对称性保护，可呈现不同的拓扑相（包括Z₂拓扑非平庸态和自旋陈数态）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν = -8/3的扭曲MoTe₂中，预测存在9重准简并的√3×√3电荷有序量子自旋霍尔晶体态，其成员由时间反演或谷U(1)v对称性保护，可呈现不同的拓扑相（包括Z₂拓扑非平庸态和自旋陈数态）。；创新点：首次预测并系统分类了分数填充下由拓扑与自发平移对称性破缺共同驱动的量子自旋霍尔晶体态，揭示了时间反演在简并流形内的非平凡作用，并给出了具体材料（扭曲MoTe₂）中实现该类态的证据。摘要未突出说明与已有QSHC研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分类与数值证据相结合：通过对称性分析对QSHC态进行分类（利用Z₃指标、Z₂拓扑指标、自旋陈数等拓扑不变量），并对扭曲MoTe₂体系在分数填充下的具体态提供数值证据（摘要未明确说明具体数值方法，如ED或DMRG等）。

papers.title: High-harmonic fingerprints of sharp spin twists in a chiral soliton lattice
papers.abstract: A magnetic field applied perpendicular to the helical axis of a monoaxial chiral helimagnet compresses the spin helix into a coplanar chiral soliton lattice (CSL). We show that optically driven high-harmonic generation from itinerant electrons coupled to a frozen CSL resolves the lattice-scale structure of the localized twist, rather than the continuum soliton shape. High-order harmonics remain perturbative for the uniform helix. As the winding localizes at fixed magnetic period, they grow by many orders of magnitude and acquire a nonperturbative dependence on the drive amplitude. The growth originates from a spatially nonuniform effective hopping that turns each soliton into a localized dip in the hopping amplitude. When the degree of winding localization is held fixed, high-order intensities fall by many orders of magnitude as the magnetic period increases toward the continuum limit, where the hopping modulation is spatially smoothed. High-order harmonics thus resolve a real-space characteristic of the coplanar CSL, even in the absence of scalar chirality and an emergent magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中提及“We show that optically driven high-harmonic generation from itinerant electrons coupled to a frozen CSL...”，属于理论建模与数值模拟范畴，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：单轴手性螺旋磁体（monoaxial chiral helimagnet）在外加垂直磁场作用下形成的共面手性孤子晶格（CSL），以及其中巡游电子在光驱动下的高次谐波产生（HHG）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高次谐波信号能够分辨CSL中局域自旋扭转的晶格尺度结构（而非连续孤子形状），且当自旋缠绕局域化时，高阶谐波强度呈非微扰性增长；该增长源于空间非均匀的有效跃迁，使每个孤子成为跃迁振幅的局域凹陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高次谐波信号能够分辨CSL中局域自旋扭转的晶格尺度结构（而非连续孤子形状），且当自旋缠绕局域化时，高阶谐波强度呈非微扰性增长；该增长源于空间非均匀的有效跃迁，使每个孤子成为跃迁振幅的局域凹陷。；创新点：首次提出高次谐波可作为探测共面CSL实空间局域结构的灵敏探针，且该机制不依赖标量手性（scalar chirality）或涌现磁场（emergent magnetic field），突破了以往认为此类探测需依赖拓扑手性环境的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：对冻结的CSL自旋构型中的巡游电子施加光驱动，计算高次谐波谱；通过改变磁场周期和缠绕局域化程度，系统研究谐波强度对驱动幅度和空间调制的依赖关系。

papers.title: Nonlocal thermal noise in electrically coupled conductors: A microscopic two-dimensional study
papers.abstract: The Johnson-Nyquist theory is commonly implemented by representing a conductor as a collection of independent local thermal-noise sources whose strength is determined by the local temperature. Whether this local-noise representation remains valid for electrically coupled conductors maintained at different temperatures has received comparatively little attention. We investigate this question by means of microscopic two-dimensional simulations of interacting charge carriers in conducting wires capacitively coupled. The model reproduces Ohm's law, the equilibrium Johnson noise, and vanishing correlations between detached wire segments when both wires are at the same temperature. However, when the wires are held at different temperatures, finite correlations develop between the electromotive forces generated in distant segments, leading to systematic deviations of the Johnson temperature inferred from the local-noise picture. The effect persists although the microscopic particle interactions are short-ranged and the two wires interact only through the capacitive coupling. These results suggest that the independent-local-source representation of thermal noise may not remain valid in electrically coupled nonequilibrium conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。依据：摘要明确提到“microscopic two-dimensional simulations”（微观二维模拟），属于计算研究。；研究对象：电容耦合的导电导线中的相互作用电荷载流子，具体研究非平衡态下（两导线温度不同）热噪声的非局域关联行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两根电容耦合的导线处于不同温度时，在相距较远的导线区段之间会产生有限的热噪声关联（电动势关联），导致基于局域噪声源图像推断的Johnson温度出现系统性偏差。该效应在粒子相互作用为短程且仅通过电容耦合相互作用时依然存在，表明独立局域源表示在电耦合非平衡导体中可能失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两根电容耦合的导线处于不同温度时，在相距较远的导线区段之间会产生有限的热噪声关联（电动势关联），导致基于局域噪声源图像推断的Johnson温度出现系统性偏差。该效应在粒子相互作用为短程且仅通过电容耦合相互作用时依然存在，表明独立局域源表示在电耦合非平衡导体中可能失效。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于：首次通过微观模拟系统检验了Johnson-Nyquist局域噪声表示在电耦合非平衡导体中的有效性，并发现该表示在温差条件下失效。
papers.method_zh: 微观二维数值模拟，模拟对象为电容耦合导线中的相互作用电荷载流子。模型验证了欧姆定律、平衡Johnson噪声以及同温下分离导线区段间关联为零等基准行为。

papers.title: Heat Transfer and Torque in Enclosing Cylindrical Configurations with Nonreciprocal Materials
papers.abstract: Electromagnetic fluctuations can transfer not only energy but also angular momentum, leading to forces, torques, heat currents, and friction in out-of-equilibrium setups. In enclosing configurations, we show that if at least one of two objects is rotationally symmetric, the torque is bounded by heat transfer, since both arise from photon transfers with angular momentum $\hbar n$ and energy $\hbarω$. With only one object assumed to be rotationally symmetric, it may be possible to obtain a nonzero torque with reciprocal media, but nonreciprocal media are required to break the symmetry between $n$ and $-n$ and produce a nonzero torque if both objects are rotationally symmetric. We then specialize to concentric cylinders with a nonreciprocal dielectric response and use Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics to express heat transfer and torque in terms of an angular-momentum-resolved flux density, $Φ_n(ω)$. We also analyze the conditions for stable levitation of the inner cylinder using the proximity force approximation, in the process obtaining a new analytic formula for the normal Casimir force between dilute plates at different temperatures. Finally, to find the extracted work in a contactless engine setup, we compute the fluctuation-induced friction for a slowly rotating inner cylinder, and we find a bound between torque, friction, and heat transfer. Due to this bound, the efficiency of the heat engine remains bounded by the Carnot limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics”理论框架，并进行解析推导（如“proximity force approximation”），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非互易材料构成的同心圆柱构型中的电磁涨落现象，具体包括热传递、力矩、摩擦、卡西米尔力以及无接触热机效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在封闭构型中，若至少一个物体具有旋转对称性，则力矩受热传递的约束；若两个物体均旋转对称，则必须使用非互易介质才能打破角动量模式n与-n的对称性从而产生非零力矩。此外，力矩、摩擦与热传递之间存在一个界限，使得无接触热机效率不超过卡诺极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在封闭构型中，若至少一个物体具有旋转对称性，则力矩受热传递的约束；若两个物体均旋转对称，则必须使用非互易介质才能打破角动量模式n与-n的对称性从而产生非零力矩。此外，力矩、摩擦与热传递之间存在一个界限，使得无接触热机效率不超过卡诺极限。；创新点：首次在封闭圆柱构型中建立了非互易介质下力矩与热传递之间的普适界限，并给出了力矩-摩擦-热传递三者之间的约束关系，从而将无接触热机效率与卡诺极限联系起来。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用Rytov涨落电动力学，将热传递和力矩表示为角动量分辨的通量密度Φ_n(ω)；使用邻近力近似（proximity force approximation）分析内圆柱稳定悬浮条件，并推导出不同温度下稀薄平板间正常卡西米尔力的新解析公式；对缓慢旋转的内圆柱计算涨落诱导摩擦。

papers.title: A Simple Regularization of the Smooth Quantum Hydrodynamic Model
papers.abstract: A simple regularization of the smooth quantum hydrodynamic model equations to prevent an unstable growing mode is proposed. The regularization involves replacing the spatial derivative of the electron density on the right-hand side of the momentum conservation equation by using the classical Boltzmann distribution for electron density. Time-dependent simulations of the resonant tunneling diode to steady state using this regularization are presented, which show realistic negative differential resistance (the experimental signal of quantum resonance) and hysteresis in the current-voltage curve. The simulations are in good agreement with fully quantum mechanical simulations of the resonant tunneling diode.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“提出正则化方案”“时间依赖模拟”“与全量子力学模拟吻合”。；研究对象：光滑量子流体动力学（smooth quantum hydrodynamic）模型，以及谐振隧穿二极管（resonant tunneling diode）中的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种简单的正则化方法，可抑制光滑量子流体动力学模型中不稳定的增长模；利用该正则化进行谐振隧穿二极管的时间依赖模拟，得到了真实的负微分电阻和电流-电压曲线中的滞回现象，且与全量子力学模拟结果高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种简单的正则化方法，可抑制光滑量子流体动力学模型中不稳定的增长模；利用该正则化进行谐振隧穿二极管的时间依赖模拟，得到了真实的负微分电阻和电流-电压曲线中的滞回现象，且与全量子力学模拟结果高度一致。；创新点：提出了一种简单、有效的正则化手段，解决了光滑量子流体动力学模型中存在的非物理不稳定增长模问题，并首次在该框架下成功复现了谐振隧穿二极管的负微分电阻和滞回特性。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟：对动量守恒方程右侧的电子密度空间导数进行替换（利用经典玻尔兹曼分布），实现正则化；随后对谐振隧穿二极管进行时间依赖的稳态模拟，并与全量子力学模拟结果对比。

papers.title: Reply to Comment on: Microscopic signatures of an imaginary charge density wave in a kagome metal
papers.abstract: We address a recent Comment [I. Nikolov {\it et al.}, arXiv:2608.13579 (2026)] proposing crystalline mosaicity as an alternative explanation for the asymmetric nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra reported in our study [S. Suetsugu {\it et al.}, Nat. Phys. {\bf 22}, 1251--1256 (2026)]. We show that this scenario requires substantial temperature- and site-dependent distributions of crystallographic orientations and additional site-dependent distributions of the electric field gradient (EFG) asymmetry parameter, none of which follow from ordinary crystalline mosaicity. We therefore conclude that crystalline mosaicity cannot account for the observed site-selective spectral asymmetry and does not provide an alternative explanation for the central spectroscopic observation underlying our interpretation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/回应性文章。判断依据：论文为对他人评论的回复，通过理论论证排除替代解释，未涉及新实验数据。；研究对象：kagome金属中虚电荷密度波（imaginary charge density wave）的微观特征，具体聚焦于核磁共振（NMR）谱的不对称性及其起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶体 mosaicity（镶嵌性）无法解释实验中观测到的位点选择性谱不对称性，因此不能作为虚电荷密度波解释的替代方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶体 mosaicity（镶嵌性）无法解释实验中观测到的位点选择性谱不对称性，因此不能作为虚电荷密度波解释的替代方案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作主要是对已有实验解释的辩护，通过排除 mosaicity 这一替代机制，强化了原研究中虚电荷密度波解释的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于对晶体 mosaicity 物理后果的定量论证，考察其能否产生所需的温度依赖和位点依赖的晶格取向分布，以及电场梯度（EFG）不对称参数的额外位点依赖分布。

papers.title: Self-assembly and Electronic Properties of Graphyne and Graphdiyne Molecular Wires on Metallic Surfaces
papers.abstract: Molecular self-assembly on solid surfaces has been the subject of extensive research, motivated by both fundamental and technological interests. On the fundamental side, these studies seek to elucidate the mechanisms governing molecular self-assembly and the resulting surface structures. From an applied perspective, they provide a route toward controlling surface reactions and engineering molecular electronic devices. Here, based on first-principles density functional theory calculations, we present a comprehensive study of self-assembled molecular wires (MWs), composed of graphyne (GY(1D)) and graphdiyne (GYD(1D))-like structures, adsorbed on Au(111), Ag(111), and Al(111) surfaces. Our total-energy calculations reveal that non-aligned MW arrays are energetically preferred on all three metal substrates. The GY(1D) and GYD(1D) molecular wires interact with the metal surfaces through van der Waals (vdW) forces, while their molecular orbitals do not contribute to the formation of metallic interface states. Simulated X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra reveal that the C 1s spectral features of the molecular wires are largely preserved upon adsorption, while the absolute binding energies undergo a substantial downshift that is nearly independent of the metal substrate, indicating that metallic screening effects dominate the adsorption-induced core-level shifts. Electronic band-structure calculations further show that the semiconducting character of the molecular wires is retained, resulting in vdW metal-semiconductor heterostructures in which the semiconducting component consists of one-dimensional semiconducting channels. These findings demonstrate that self-assembled graphyne- and graphdiyne-based molecular wires on metal surfaces provide a promising platform for the realization of low-dimensional molecular electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“基于第一性原理密度泛函理论计算”（first-principles density functional theory calculations）。；研究对象：自组装形成的类石墨炔（graphyne, GY(1D)）和类石墨二炔（graphdiyne, GYD(1D)）一维分子线，分别吸附在Au(111)、Ag(111)和Al(111)金属表面上形成的范德华金属-半导体异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非对齐排列的分子线阵列在三种金属表面上均为能量上更优的自组装构型；分子线通过范德华力与金属表面相互作用，且吸附后分子线的半导体特性得以保留，形成一维半导体通道的vdW金属-半导体异质结。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非对齐排列的分子线阵列在三种金属表面上均为能量上更优的自组装构型；分子线通过范德华力与金属表面相互作用，且吸附后分子线的半导体特性得以保留，形成一维半导体通道的vdW金属-半导体异质结。；创新点：系统研究了类石墨炔/石墨二炔一维分子线在多种金属表面的自组装行为及其电子结构，揭示了vdW相互作用主导的界面成键特征和金属屏蔽效应对芯能级位移的主导作用，为低维分子电子器件提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）总能量计算；模拟X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析C 1s芯能级位移；电子能带结构计算。

papers.title: Even/Odd-parity STS spectra induced by quantum well mirror symmetry breaking in iron-based superconductors
papers.abstract: Determining whether superconducting scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) is uniquely dictated by crystal structure constitutes a fundamental challenge in condensed matter physics. Here, we systematically investigate bulk FeSe single crystals, monolayer FeSe, and $\mathrm{KCa_2Fe_4As_4F_2}$. We resolve one-, two-, and three-order checkerboard quantum-well structures that perfectly match the experimentally observed one, two, and three pairs of superconducting coherence peaks. In bulk FeSe, quantum wells promote real-space Cooper pairing and form degenerate antiferromagnetic checkerboard sublattices, yielding bosonic even-parity STS responses. In monolayer FeSe, mirror symmetry breaking suppresses Cooper pairing and induces nondegenerate ferromagnetic sublattice dichotomy, producing fermionic odd-parity STS spectra. We establish a universal gap scaling law $Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ^2$, where $η(T)$ is a temperature-dependent prefactor and $ξ$ denotes quantum-well depth that governs the number and magnitude of superconducting gaps. For $\mathrm{KCa_2Fe_4As_4F_2}$, our predicted gap pairs of $\pm6.2$ meV, $\pm5.6$ meV, and $\pm4.2$ meV are in excellent agreement with experimental results of $\pm6.2$ meV, $\pm5.4$ meV, and $\pm4.4$ meV. This quantum-well mechanism unifies mirror symmetry breaking, checkerboard sublattice ordering, Cooper pairing, fermion-boson duality, and half-Bogoliubov states for STS interpretation, offering new insights toward a unified high-$T_\text{c}$ superconductivity theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提出理论模型（量子阱机制）、推导普适标度律（Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ²），并与实验数据对比，但未提及自身开展实验。；研究对象：铁基超导体中的扫描隧道谱（STS）奇偶宇称行为，具体材料包括：块体FeSe、单层FeSe以及KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂。核心物理现象为量子阱镜面对称破缺、棋盘格子序、库珀配对与STS谱线形状的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子阱镜面对称破缺决定了STS谱的奇偶宇称：块体FeSe中镜面对称保持导致玻色型偶宇称谱，单层FeSe中镜面对称破缺导致费米型奇宇称谱；并建立了普适能隙标度律Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ²，预言KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂的三对能隙与实验高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子阱镜面对称破缺决定了STS谱的奇偶宇称：块体FeSe中镜面对称保持导致玻色型偶宇称谱，单层FeSe中镜面对称破缺导致费米型奇宇称谱；并建立了普适能隙标度律Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ²，预言KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂的三对能隙与实验高度吻合。；创新点：提出量子阱机制统一解释镜面对称破缺、棋盘子格序、库珀配对、费米-玻色二象性及半Bogoliubov态对STS谱的影响，并给出可定量检验的普适能隙标度律，为统一高T_c超导理论提供新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析推导：基于量子阱深度ξ和温度依赖前因子η(T)的标度律分析；结合已有实验STS数据（块体FeSe、单层FeSe、KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂）进行定量对比验证。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如DFT或第一性原理）。

papers.title: Light Polarization Sensitive Transistor Action in the van der Waals ferroelectric 4H-SnS2
papers.abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) ferroelectric semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring the interplay between spontaneous polarization, electronic transport, ion migration, and photocarrier generation at the nanoscale. Here, we establish a room-temperature ferroelectric state in SnS2 and its sensitivity to structural polytype by directly contrasting the centrosymmetric 2H-phase with the polar 4H-phase. Raman spectroscopy distinguishes the 2H and 4H polymorphs of SnS2 through their characteristic phonon fingerprints. Piezoresponse force microscopy confirms room-temperature ferroelectricity in the 4H phase, while the 2H phase exhibits no ferroelectric response. The built-in polarization in a three-terminal transistor device of the 4H-SnS2 is modulated significantly by electrostatic gating and on exposure to linear and circularly polarized light. This device reveals polarization-controlled output characteristics with distinct gate-voltage induced hysteretic response and thermally activated carrier transport, confirming p-type semiconducting behavior strongly coupled to ferroelectric polarization. The photoresponse likewise exhibits polarization-assisted carrier separation, sublinear power-law scaling, a nonmonotonic temperature response correlated with the characteristic Raman modes, ferroelectric hysteresis, and a pronounced dependence on the circular and linear polarization states of the incident laser beam. These results establish 4H-SnS2 as a promising material system for polarization-driven electronic and optoelectronic technologies, including nonvolatile memory and photoferroelectric functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到Raman光谱、压电力显微镜（PFM）、三端晶体管器件测量等实验手段。；研究对象：范德华铁电半导体SnS2，具体对比中心对称的2H相与极性4H相，研究其室温铁电性、电子输运、离子迁移与光生载流子之间的耦合，以及偏振光调控的晶体管行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 4H-SnS2在室温下具有铁电性，其内建极化可被静电栅压和线/圆偏振光显著调制，器件表现出与铁电极化强耦合的p型半导体输运特性及偏振依赖的光电响应，确立了4H-SnS2作为偏振驱动电子与光电器件（如非易失存储、光铁电功能）的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：4H-SnS2在室温下具有铁电性，其内建极化可被静电栅压和线/圆偏振光显著调制，器件表现出与铁电极化强耦合的p型半导体输运特性及偏振依赖的光电响应，确立了4H-SnS2作为偏振驱动电子与光电器件（如非易失存储、光铁电功能）的候选材料。；创新点：首次直接对比2H与4H两种SnS2多型体，明确铁电性对结构多型体的敏感性，并在同一三端器件中实现铁电极化与静电栅控、偏振光响应的协同调制，展示了偏振可控的晶体管行为——摘要未突出说明与以往铁电半导体器件相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: Raman光谱（区分2H与4H多型体）；压电力显微镜（PFM，确认室温铁电性）；三端晶体管器件的电输运测量（栅压调制、滞回曲线、热激活载流子输运分析）；偏振光（线偏振与圆偏振）照射下的光电响应测量（功率依赖、温度依赖、偏振态依赖）。

papers.title: Symmetry-Induced Logarithmic Relaxation in the Quantum Kicked Rotor
papers.abstract: We study the effect of discrete symmetries on coherent multiple scattering in the quantum kicked rotor. When the initial momentum is set to zero -- as in recent Bose-Einstein condensate experiments -- the effective pseudo-disorder becomes even under momentum inversion. The resulting discrete mirror symmetry of the dynamics profoundly alters spectral correlations: it generates quasi-degenerate Floquet doublets localised at opposite momenta, whose exponentially small splittings produce a hierarchy of exponentially large dynamical timescales. The coherent backscattering and forward-scattering peaks then exhibit a striking non-monotonic evolution and strongly asymmetric contrasts, followed by an exceptionally slow logarithmic relaxation toward a common asymptotic value -- a hallmark of glassy dynamics, here emerging in a fully coherent quantum system. That such archetypal glass-like behaviour arises from a single discrete symmetry constraint reveals an unexpected and deep connection between quantum coherence and slow relaxation phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We study the effect of...”、“We analyze...”等理论推导性语言，并涉及“spectral correlations”、“Floquet doublets”等理论概念，未提及任何实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：量子 kicked rotor（量子 kicked rotor）体系，特别关注其初始动量为零时的动力学行为，该设定与近期玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体实验相关。研究聚焦于离散对称性（动量反转下的镜像对称性）对相干多重散射的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当初始动量为零时，量子 kicked rotor 的有效伪无序呈现动量反转下的偶对称性，导致动力学出现准简并的 Floquet 双重态。这些双重态产生指数级小能级劈裂，进而引发一系列指数级大的动力学时间尺度，最终使相干背散射和前向散射峰表现出非单调演化、强不对称对比度，以及极其缓慢的对数弛豫——这是一种在完全相干的量子系统中出现的玻璃态动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当初始动量为零时，量子 kicked rotor 的有效伪无序呈现动量反转下的偶对称性，导致动力学出现准简并的 Floquet 双重态。这些双重态产生指数级小能级劈裂，进而引发一系列指数级大的动力学时间尺度，最终使相干背散射和前向散射峰表现出非单调演化、强不对称对比度，以及极其缓慢的对数弛豫——这是一种在完全相干的量子系统中出现的玻璃态动力学特征。；创新点：首次揭示单一离散对称性约束即可在完全相干的量子系统中诱导出典型的玻璃态慢弛豫行为（对数弛豫），建立了量子相干性与慢弛豫现象之间意想不到的深层联系。这一发现将对称性、量子相干和玻璃动力学三个看似独立的领域联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：利用离散对称性（镜像对称）分析有效伪无序的对称性；通过 Floquet 理论计算准能谱和准简并双重态；分析相干背散射与前向散射峰的动力学演化及其时间尺度层级。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如张量网络、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: Scaling of the Electrical Conductivity Spectra Reveals Distinct Transport Responses in A2SmTaO6 [A = Ba, Sr, Ca]
papers.abstract: Disorder plays an important role in materials science, influencing material behavior across different length scales. Imperfections like vacancies, atomic substitutions, lattice distortions, and microstructural inhomogeneities, disrupt ideal periodicity thereby altering physical properties. Analogous to spin-glass systems, electrical 'glassiness' arises when charge carriers confront disordered energy landscapes, leading to a broad range of relaxation times, especially in polycrystalline materials where dipoles experience competing exchange interactions. Complex impedance, permittivity, and electric modulus distill out separate resistive and capacitive effects, offering insights into how microstructural inhomogeneities affects conduction mechanism. In polycrystalline double perovskites A2SmTaO6 (A = Ba, Ca), with a power law driven ac conductivity, the hopping and relaxation of carriers is affected by both grains and grain boundaries. Scaling of ac conductivity and impedance response reveals correlation between conduction and relaxation timescales. The inhomogeneities in local energy landscape of 'frustrated' dipoles restrict the 'universality' of conduction mechanism across the bulk length scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要提及“Complex impedance, permittivity, and electric modulus”等实验测量手段，以及“Scaling of ac conductivity and impedance response”等数据分析方法。；研究对象：多晶双钙钛矿氧化物 A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba, Sr, Ca），具体研究其交流电导率、介电响应与载流子输运机制，重点关注晶粒与晶界对导电行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba, Ca）多晶体系中，交流电导率呈幂律行为，载流子的跳跃与弛豫同时受晶粒和晶界影响；电导率与阻抗谱的标度分析揭示了导电与弛豫时间尺度之间的关联，但局域能量景观的不均匀性（“受阻”偶极子）限制了导电机制在体相尺度上的“普适性”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba, Ca）多晶体系中，交流电导率呈幂律行为，载流子的跳跃与弛豫同时受晶粒和晶界影响；电导率与阻抗谱的标度分析揭示了导电与弛豫时间尺度之间的关联，但局域能量景观的不均匀性（“受阻”偶极子）限制了导电机制在体相尺度上的“普适性”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 交流电导率谱测量、复阻抗谱、介电常数与电模量分析，以及对交流电导率和阻抗响应的标度（scaling）分析。

papers.title: Yang-Lee Criticality as a Dissipative Dynamical Phase Transition: Quantum Simulation of non-Hermitian Physics without Post-selection
papers.abstract: We show that the $d+0$-dimensional Yang-Lee theory describing classical Ising spins in an imaginary magnetic field can be realized, without post-selection, within a $(d-1)+1$ open quantum system whose dynamics consist of local unitaries and engineered dissipation. Competition between the coherent unitary and dissipative dynamics drives a transition wherein the time-dependence of a particular class of linear observables changes from damped oscillatory "underdamped" to purely exponential "overdamped" decay. Our construction relies on an extensive number of weak-symmetries of the Lindbladian fixed by the choice of observable but is otherwise exact. Consequently, we show that the dynamics are described by the non-Hermitian generator of the Yang-Lee transfer matrix, leading to an effective Yang-Lee theory defined on the spacetime history of the open system. By locally modifying the dynamics, we directly measure spin correlation functions of the Yang-Lee theory as well as a related "Loschmidt Echo" correlator which we detail. We explicitly show that the required dissipation channels can be obtained through local $2$-qubit gates and discuss potential realization on near-term quantum simulator devices. Finally, we generalize our construction to embed arbitrary non-Hermitian Hamiltonians within an open quantum system under Lindbladian time-evolution without post-selection, drawing connections between unconditional open quantum dynamics, exceptional point physics, and non-unitary statistical mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中大量使用理论推导语言，如“We show that”“Our construction relies on”“we generalize our construction”，且未提及任何实验数据或数值模拟结果。；研究对象：Yang-Lee理论（经典Ising自旋在虚磁场中的临界行为）在开放量子系统中的实现，具体为(d-1)+1维开放量子系统（由局域幺正操作和工程耗散构成）中的耗散动力学相变，以及非厄米物理与无后选择量子模拟的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过局域幺正与耗散动力学的竞争，开放量子系统可经历从“欠阻尼”振荡衰减到“过阻尼”纯指数衰减的动力学相变，该相变由Yang-Lee转移矩阵的非厄米生成元描述，从而在不进行后选择的情况下实现Yang-Lee临界性的量子模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过局域幺正与耗散动力学的竞争，开放量子系统可经历从“欠阻尼”振荡衰减到“过阻尼”纯指数衰减的动力学相变，该相变由Yang-Lee转移矩阵的非厄米生成元描述，从而在不进行后选择的情况下实现Yang-Lee临界性的量子模拟。；创新点：首次提出无需后选择即可在开放量子系统中实现Yang-Lee理论（及任意非厄米哈密顿量）的方案，将无条件开放量子动力学、奇异点物理与非幺正统计力学联系起来；摘要未突出说明与已有后选择方案相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Lindblad主方程描述的开放量子系统动力学；利用Lindbladian的大量弱对称性（由所选择的观测量决定）构造精确映射；通过局域2-qubit门实现所需耗散通道；推广到将任意非厄米哈密顿量嵌入Lindblad时间演化中。

papers.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
papers.abstract: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld self-organize without assigned roles or recipes into evolving technological societies. Agents explore a spatial environment, process resources, test materials, construct persistent artifacts, and write executable controllers evaluated by a deterministic simulator under unseen disturbances after the agents are removed. SwarmWorld splits cognition from consequence: agents propose architectures and controllers within fixed action and material schemas, while the simulated world determines function. Shared societies develop broader, more resilient technological portfolios than a strong best-of-N isolated-search baseline, although isolated search remains competitive for the strongest artifact. Agents differentiate into exploration, construction, maintenance, and coordination behaviors, transitioning as the world matures. Technologies accumulate through collaborative construction, executable inheritance, and persistent agent-artifact networks, with most reuse beginning through physical observation rather than communication. Explicit cultural mechanisms amplify collaboration and organization, but functional benefits depend on outcome and timescale. Physical stigmergy alone supports capable societies, while interaction drives persistent technological ecologies rather than universally superior individual inventions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“LLM agents”、“deterministic simulator”、“simulated world”，属于基于语言模型智能体的多智能体系统仿真研究，而非实验或纯理论推导。；研究对象：本文研究的并非传统凝聚态物理体系，而是由初始同质的语言模型（LLM）智能体组成的“社会”系统。该系统在名为SwarmWorld的虚拟空间环境中自组织演化，研究其技术发明、文化积累和社会分工的涌现过程。摘要未涉及任何具体凝聚态材料或量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无预设角色或配方的条件下，语言模型智能体可通过环境中的物理协作（stigmergy）自发形成技术社会，其集体技术组合比“最佳N次独立搜索”基线更广泛且更具韧性；但最强单项技术仍可由独立搜索获得。智能体还自发分化出探索、建造、维护、协调等不同行为角色。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无预设角色或配方的条件下，语言模型智能体可通过环境中的物理协作（stigmergy）自发形成技术社会，其集体技术组合比“最佳N次独立搜索”基线更广泛且更具韧性；但最强单项技术仍可由独立搜索获得。智能体还自发分化出探索、建造、维护、协调等不同行为角色。；创新点：该工作首次在语言模型智能体社会中系统展示了“无预设角色、无直接对话依赖”的纯物理协作（stigmergy）即可支撑功能性技术社会的涌现，并将“认知”与“后果”分离（智能体提出方案，模拟世界决定功能），为多智能体集体智能研究提供了新范式。摘要未突出说明其与凝聚态物理的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用多智能体仿真框架SwarmWorld：智能体在空间环境中探索、处理资源、测试材料、构建持久化人工制品，并编写可执行控制器。这些控制器由确定性模拟器在智能体被移除后、面对未知扰动时进行评估。研究对比了共享社会与“best-of-N”独立搜索基线，并分析了技术积累路径（物理观察、可执行代码继承、智能体-人工制品网络）及显式文化机制的影响。

papers.title: Lab earthquakes confirm the theory of frictional slip pulses
papers.abstract: Large natural earthquakes are typically mediated by frictional pulse-like rupture, which features a finite slipping zone. Recently, a comprehensive two-dimensional theory of frictional slip pulses has been developed. It predicts that pulses are categorically unstable rupture modes, whose evolution is intrinsically slow. Unsteady pulses satisfy an equation of motion expressed in terms of discrete observables, which is inherently related to their steady-state counterparts. The theory also predicts a transition from decaying to slowly growing pulses. Here, we perform extensive lab earthquake experiments to test the theory. The experiments confirm the theoretical predictions for pulse-like lab earthquakes over a range of prestress levels, rupture nucleation conditions and small-scale fault roughness amplitudes. Specifically, the predicted time-dependent dynamics are tested in a plane defined by the evolving pulse size and peak slip rate, along with measurements of the dimensionless growth rate of pulses, demonstrating their intrinsically slow unsteady nature. The predicted transition between decaying and growing pulses is also experimentally demonstrated. These results constitute major progress in understanding a dominant earthquake rupture mode.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“perform extensive lab earthquake experiments to test the theory”，属于实验验证型工作。；研究对象：摩擦滑动脉冲（frictional slip pulses）——即地震破裂中有限滑动区的脉冲式传播模式，研究对象为实验室尺度的人工断层（lab earthquakes），涉及不同预应力水平、成核条件和粗糙度的小尺度断层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了二维摩擦滑动脉冲理论的预测：脉冲本质上是不稳定的破裂模式，其演化是内在缓慢的；实验还验证了脉冲从衰减到缓慢增长的理论转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了二维摩擦滑动脉冲理论的预测：脉冲本质上是不稳定的破裂模式，其演化是内在缓慢的；实验还验证了脉冲从衰减到缓慢增长的理论转变。；创新点：首次在实验室地震中系统验证了完整的二维摩擦滑动脉冲理论，特别是定量检验了脉冲尺寸-峰值滑移率相平面中的时间依赖动力学，以及衰减/增长转变的预测。摘要未突出说明与以往实验在具体测量技术上的差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验室地震实验（lab earthquake experiments），通过控制预应力水平、破裂成核条件和小尺度断层粗糙度振幅，测量脉冲尺寸与峰值滑移率随时间演化的关系，并提取脉冲的无量纲增长率。

papers.title: Experimental Characterization of Additively Manufactured Metallic Alloys for Electric Propulsion Applications
papers.abstract: This work explores the sputtering of additively manufactured (AM) materials for use in gridded ion source applications. The first part of the paper uses 316L stainless steel as an example to demonstrate that additively manufactured material does not exhibit adverse sputtering behavior, such as higher sputter yield, compared with conventionally manufactured material. To this end, three additively manufactured 316L stainless steel samples were exposed to the beam of a KDC-40 electrostatic gridded ion source at three distinct energy levels of 400, 600, and 800 eV on each side of the sample for a duration of one hour. The samples were masked to create a distinct boundary between treated and untreated regions, identifiable using profilometry, and were biased to -18V for testing. Samples were then examined using a Bruker optical profilometer and further processed using the open-source software Gwyddion to evaluate the sputtering yield. The sputter yield varied in the range 0.2-2 atoms/ion for 400-800 eV ions and increased with ion energy. The measured sputtering yield was fairly consistent with predictions from analytical models developed in prior literature, while exhibiting some variations potentially due to added effects of increased temperature and oxide layers. The second part of the paper demonstrates feasibility of using an additively manufactured tungsten-rhenium grids in existing KDC-40 electrostatic gridded ion source.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述了样品制备、离子束辐照、轮廓仪测量等具体实验过程，属于实验表征研究。；研究对象：增材制造（3D打印）金属合金材料，具体为316L不锈钢（用于溅射行为研究）以及增材制造钨-铼合金（用于栅极可行性验证），应用背景为电推进系统中的栅格离子源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增材制造的316L不锈钢在400–800 eV离子能量下溅射产额约为0.2–2 atoms/ion，随离子能量增加而增大，与传统制造材料相比未表现出不利的溅射行为（如更高的溅射产额）；同时验证了增材制造钨-铼栅极在现有离子源中的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增材制造的316L不锈钢在400–800 eV离子能量下溅射产额约为0.2–2 atoms/ion，随离子能量增加而增大，与传统制造材料相比未表现出不利的溅射行为（如更高的溅射产额）；同时验证了增材制造钨-铼栅极在现有离子源中的可行性。；创新点：首次系统表征增材制造金属材料在电推进栅格离子源应用中的溅射行为，证明增材制造材料不劣于传统制造材料，并展示了增材制造钨-铼栅极的可行性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 使用KDC-40静电栅格离子源对三个增材制造316L不锈钢样品分别以400、600、800 eV离子能量各轰击1小时；样品加掩膜以形成处理/未处理边界，偏压设为−18 V；采用Bruker光学轮廓仪测量表面形貌，并用开源软件Gwyddion处理数据以评估溅射产额；结果与文献中的解析模型预测进行对比。

papers.title: A Scalable OpenLB LAMMPS Framework for Fully Resolved Simulations of Hindered Settling of Arbitrary Non-Spherical Particles
papers.abstract: Hindered settling of non spherical particles remains significantly less understood than spherical particles due to the computational challenges in resolving the complex contact mechanics and hydrodynamic interactions. In this paper, we present a scaleable fluid structure interaction (FSI) framework coupling the open-source LBM software in OpenLB with the Discrete Element Method (DEM) implemented in LAMMPS to simulate arbitrary shaped rigid bodies in a fluid. Particle contacts are captured using a multi-sphere "clump" representation in DEM, while particle geometries are resolved on the fluid grid via voxelization. We validate our model against single and multi-particle benchmarks, and proceed to study the hindered setttling of cubes in systems containing upto 100,000 cubes. Our simulations show distinct differences between the settling of cubes and sphere, as cubes form pronounced coordination shells without face-parallel contact, in contrast to the contact-dominated clustering observed in spheres. Our results find that correlation length in velocity fluctuations scale with system size even for the largest system studied. These findings highlight the role of particle morphology in suspension dynamics and demonstrate a robust framework for simulating large-scale geotechnical and particulate flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“present a scalable fluid structure interaction (FSI) framework”，涉及OpenLB（LBM）与LAMMPS（DEM）的耦合模拟，属于大规模数值计算研究。；研究对象：非球形颗粒（以立方体为代表）在流体中的受阻沉降（hindered settling）现象，重点研究颗粒形态对悬浮液动力学和接触结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 立方体与球体在受阻沉降中表现出显著差异：立方体形成明显的配位壳层结构但缺乏面平行接触，而球体则形成接触主导的团簇；此外，速度波动的关联长度即使在最大模拟体系中仍随体系尺寸增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：立方体与球体在受阻沉降中表现出显著差异：立方体形成明显的配位壳层结构但缺乏面平行接触，而球体则形成接触主导的团簇；此外，速度波动的关联长度即使在最大模拟体系中仍随体系尺寸增长。；创新点：提出了一个可扩展的、能够完全解析任意形状非球形颗粒受阻沉降的OpenLB-LAMMPS耦合框架，并首次在大规模体系中揭示了立方体与球体在沉降动力学和微观接触结构上的本质差异，强调了颗粒形态对悬浮液动力学的重要作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用开源格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）软件OpenLB与离散元方法（DEM）软件LAMMPS耦合的流固耦合（FSI）框架。颗粒接触通过DEM中的多球“clump”表示捕获，颗粒几何形状通过体素化（voxelization）在流体网格上解析。模拟体系包含多达100,000个立方体。

papers.title: Immittance formulas for exact blackbox quantization and divergence-free effective models in circuit QED
papers.abstract: Building on the first-order circuit quantization method [arXiv:2304.12252, arXiv:2401.09120], we provide simple formulas to construct exact Hamiltonians for Josephson-junction-based superconducting qudits capacitively, inductively, or galvanically coupled to passive linear environments. These environments may be multiport, multimode, discrete or continuous, reciprocal or nonreciprocal, and are characterized directly by their impedance or admittance matrices. In the weak-coupling regime, we further derive \emph{divergence-free} dispersive Hamiltonians for mode-resolved environments and transition-resolved weak-coupling master equations for dissipative continua. Mode structure, frequency renormalizations, environment-mediated interactions, decay rates, and directional cross couplings then follow from the same causal immittance response, while spurious Lamb-shift divergences arising from uncontrolled approximations in previous treatments are made explicit and avoided. We apply the theory to a set of illustrative circuits comprising a discrete resonator filter, finite-band metamaterial environments, nonreciprocal waveguide-QED systems, and superconducting giant atoms, for which analytical response matrices can be obtained, although the method is particularly well suited to numerical responses from electromagnetic solvers or experimental characterization. We thereby extend the black-box quantization framework to multiport, dissipative, and nonreciprocal settings, establishing a simple and scalable route toward optimized and automated electromagnetic design of large-scale superconducting quantum hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“我们提供公式”“我们推导”“我们应用理论”等表述，属于理论推导与建模工作，未涉及实验数据或数值模拟结果。；研究对象：基于约瑟夫森结的超导量子比特（qudit），以及其与无源线性环境（多端口、多模、分立或连续、互易或非互易）的电容、电感或电流耦合系统，具体包括离散谐振器滤波器、有限带宽超材料环境、非互易波导QED系统及超导巨原子等电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了基于一阶电路量子化方法的简单公式，可精确构造约瑟夫森结超导量子比特与任意无源线性环境耦合的哈密顿量；在弱耦合区进一步推导出无发散的有效色散哈密顿量和主方程，避免了以往处理中由不受控近似引起的虚假Lamb位移发散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了基于一阶电路量子化方法的简单公式，可精确构造约瑟夫森结超导量子比特与任意无源线性环境耦合的哈密顿量；在弱耦合区进一步推导出无发散的有效色散哈密顿量和主方程，避免了以往处理中由不受控近似引起的虚假Lamb位移发散。；创新点：将黑箱量子化框架推广到多端口、耗散和非互易情形，建立了从同一因果导抗响应中同时提取模式结构、频率重整化、环境介导相互作用、衰减率和方向性交叉耦合的统一方法，并明确指出了以往处理中Lamb位移发散来源且加以避免。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：一阶电路量子化方法（基于arXiv:2304.12252和arXiv:2401.09120），利用阻抗或导纳矩阵直接刻画环境；在弱耦合区推导模式分辨的色散哈密顿量和跃迁分辨的弱耦合主方程。应用对象包括可解析求解的示例电路，但方法本身也适用于电磁求解器或实验表征得到的数值响应。

papers.title: The Gain-Engineered Transmon
papers.abstract: The interaction between a qubit and its environment can be engineered such that one error channel dominates over all others, resulting in noise bias. This property enables error correction codes to focus on the dominant error type, thereby significantly reducing the number of physical systems required for fault-tolerant quantum computation. However, engineering noise bias typically introduces complexity at the physical system level, which decreases its usefulness by limiting scalability. Here, we introduce and experimentally realize a noise-biased qubit in a standard transmon-readout resonator circuit, one of the most common superconducting architectures, by only adding a single microwave tone. We encode the qubit in the transmon $|\mathrm{g}\rangle$- and $|\mathrm{f}\rangle$-states, and engineer a frequency-selective gain channel that counteracts single-photon loss errors between the computational states. We demonstrate an order-of-magnitude enhancement in relaxation time compared to the $|\mathrm{g}\rangle-|\mathrm{e}\rangle$ encoding, conceding only a factor-of-two decrease in the echo-coherence time. Furthermore, we show that this qubit is compatible with fast, high-fidelity operations. Our results open a path towards using this system as a simple building-block for hardware-efficient quantum error detection and correction schemes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally realize”，并描述了实验演示结果（如“We demonstrate…”）。；研究对象：超导量子比特体系中的一种新型噪声偏置量子比特——“增益工程化Transmon”（Gain-Engineered Transmon）。具体是在标准的transmon-读出谐振腔电路中，利用transmon的|g⟩和|f⟩能级编码量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在标准transmon-读出谐振腔电路中仅添加单一微波驱动音调，实现了噪声偏置量子比特，其弛豫时间比|g⟩-|e⟩编码提升一个数量级，而回波相干时间仅降低两倍，且该量子比特支持快速、高保真度操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在标准transmon-读出谐振腔电路中仅添加单一微波驱动音调，实现了噪声偏置量子比特，其弛豫时间比|g⟩-|e⟩编码提升一个数量级，而回波相干时间仅降低两倍，且该量子比特支持快速、高保真度操作。；创新点：在超导量子计算最常用的标准transmon架构中，仅通过添加一个微波音调即可实现噪声偏置，无需引入额外的物理系统复杂度，从而保持了可扩展性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：在标准transmon-读出谐振腔超导电路上，施加单一微波音调，工程化一个频率选择性的增益通道，用以抵消计算态之间的单光子损耗错误。通过测量弛豫时间和回波相干时间来表征性能，并测试了快速高保真度操作。

papers.title: Magic of Kitaev spin liquids
papers.abstract: Quantum spin liquids (QSLs) are long-range entangled phases of matter and a natural setting for exploring how quantum correlations generate quantum complexity. Motivated by the emergence of magic, or nonstabilizerness, as a diagnostic of many-body complexity beyond entanglement, we study magic of QSLs by computing the stabilizer Rényi entropy (SRE) of the Kitaev honeycomb model. We derive a correspondence between Pauli strings and products of itinerant Majorana operators in the model's free-fermion description; this enables the sampling of SRE using an optimized algorithm for Gaussian states in systems with thousands of spins. Our results show that magic is largest in the gapless phase, where subleading volume-law corrections indicate nonlocal contributions, while in the gapped phases, SRE decreases in quantitative agreement with a perturbative expansion that we develop in the anisotropic limit. At the topological phase transition, SRE exhibits universal scaling dictated by critical exponents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：computing、sampling、optimized algorithm、perturbative expansion。；研究对象：Kitaev蜂窝模型中的量子自旋液体（QSLs），具体研究其“魔性”（magic，即非稳定化子纠缠资源）及其与相结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无隙（gapless）相中魔性最大，且存在次领头体积律修正表明非局域贡献；在有隙（gapped）相中，稳定化子Rényi熵（SRE）随各向异性微扰展开定量下降；在拓扑相变点，SRE表现出由临界指数决定的普适标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无隙（gapless）相中魔性最大，且存在次领头体积律修正表明非局域贡献；在有隙（gapped）相中，稳定化子Rényi熵（SRE）随各向异性微扰展开定量下降；在拓扑相变点，SRE表现出由临界指数决定的普适标度行为。；创新点：首次将魔性（非稳定化子纠缠）作为多体复杂度诊断应用于Kitaev量子自旋液体，建立了Pauli字符串与Majorana算符的对应关系，实现了千自旋尺度下SRE的高效计算，并揭示了临界点处SRE的普适标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 利用Kitaev模型可映射为自由费米子的性质，推导Pauli字符串与巡游Majorana算符乘积的对应关系；采用针对高斯态的优化算法对稳定化子Rényi熵（SRE）进行采样，系统规模达数千自旋；并在各向异性极限下发展了微扰展开方法。

papers.title: Structured Non-Locality and Emergent Locality in Cavity-QED Many-Body Dynamics
papers.abstract: Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) modifies many-body systems by combining cavity-mediated collective interactions with microscopic short-range interactions. The resulting dynamics lies between the local and fully collective limits, such that neither locality nor collectivity alone provides a complete organizing principle. In the clean conceptual limit of dominant collective coupling, we show that the effective dynamics within each energetically isolated subspace is generically controlled by whether that subspace admits a local product-state basis, and identify exceptions imposed by angular-momentum selection rules. Product-state subspaces generically retain the spatial structure of the microscopic interaction. Entangled subspaces instead generically dress local processes with global operators, generating non-local but highly structured dynamics. We illustrate this by deriving the corresponding effective Hamiltonians in two representative cavity-QED spin models. The cavity-isolated subspace thus becomes a resource for generating competing short-range interactions or globally conditioned local processes, opening a class of many-body dynamics without local or fully collective counterparts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“effective dynamics”“effective Hamiltonians”“derive”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：腔量子电动力学（Cavity-QED）多体自旋系统，具体研究腔介导的集体相互作用与微观短程相互作用共同作用下的多体动力学，属于量子模拟与量子多体物理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在集体耦合占主导的干净概念极限下，每个能量隔离子空间内的有效动力学由该子空间是否允许局域乘积态基矢决定：乘积态子空间保留微观相互作用的局域空间结构，而纠缠子空间则产生由全局算符修饰的非局域但高度结构化的动力学。角动量选择规则会带来例外情况。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在集体耦合占主导的干净概念极限下，每个能量隔离子空间内的有效动力学由该子空间是否允许局域乘积态基矢决定：乘积态子空间保留微观相互作用的局域空间结构，而纠缠子空间则产生由全局算符修饰的非局域但高度结构化的动力学。角动量选择规则会带来例外情况。；创新点：提出“腔隔离子空间”可作为产生竞争性短程相互作用或全局条件化局域过程的资源，开辟了一类既非局域也非完全集体的新型多体动力学。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：通过识别能量隔离子空间的基矢结构（局域乘积态 vs 纠缠态），推导两个代表性腔-QED自旋模型的有效哈密顿量，从而揭示动力学结构。

papers.title: From rings to resonance: an inverse method links biophotonic structural color to inverse photonic glasses
papers.abstract: Structural color arises from the interaction of light with nanoscale structures and is widespread in nature. As structural complexity increases, the mechanisms governing coloration become progressively less understood. The optical response of periodic photonic crystals with a spatially periodic refractive index is well described by Bloch theory, whereas that of photonic glasses composed of randomly assembled uniform spheres is more subtle yet well studied. In contrast, disordered photonic networks found in many beetles are among the most complex natural photonic architectures, and the fundamental relationships between their structure and color remain unclear. Here, we use an inverse method to identify the structural features encoded in the reflectance spectrum. By comparing the spectrum of an unknown system with a database of simulated spectra from computer-generated photonic networks, we infer its structural properties. Applying this approach to both simulated networks and the biophotonic network responsible for the blue coloration of the weevil Pachyrhynchus congestus mirabilis, we identify rings and pores as the key local scattering motifs. Their characteristic sizes govern the spectral position of the reflectance peak, whereas short-range disorder controls its width. The inverse method reveals clear spectral signatures of short-range order, whereas the influence of hyperuniformity and primitive similarity appears comparatively weak. This suggests that blue structural coloration is governed by local scattering mechanisms rather than photonic band-gap effects. We propose an analogy to an inverse photonic glass, in which pores and rings act as correlated local resonators. This perspective provides new design principles for bio-inspired structural-color materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“使用逆方法（inverse method）”，并“与计算机生成的光子网络的模拟光谱数据库进行比较”，属于基于模拟与理论分析的研究。；研究对象：生物光子结构色，具体为象鼻虫 *Pachyrhynchus congestus mirabilis* 的蓝色结构色所对应的无序光子网络（disordered photonic networks），以及计算机生成的光子网络模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过逆方法识别出环（rings）和孔（pores）是决定反射光谱的关键局部散射单元：其特征尺寸控制反射峰的光谱位置，短程无序控制峰宽；蓝色结构色主要由局部散射机制主导，而非光子带隙效应，可类比为“逆光子玻璃”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过逆方法识别出环（rings）和孔（pores）是决定反射光谱的关键局部散射单元：其特征尺寸控制反射峰的光谱位置，短程无序控制峰宽；蓝色结构色主要由局部散射机制主导，而非光子带隙效应，可类比为“逆光子玻璃”。；创新点：提出“逆光子玻璃”概念，将无序生物光子网络中的孔和环视为关联的局部谐振子，为仿生结构色材料提供新的设计原则；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 逆方法（inverse method）：将未知系统的反射光谱与计算机生成的光子网络模拟光谱数据库进行比对，从而推断结构特征；同时分析短程有序、超均匀性（hyperuniformity）和原始相似性（primitive similarity）对光谱的影响。

papers.title: Room-temperature graphene sub-terahertz detector integrated on a silicon dielectric waveguide
papers.abstract: Terahertz (THz) photonics offers a promising platform for next-generation 6G wireless communications, on-chip spectrometers, and non-invasive biomedical sensors. In the near- and mid-infrared, monolithically integrated photodetectors are a cornerstone of photonic integrated circuits (PICs). In the THz range, however, such integration on low-loss dielectric waveguides remains an open challenge: to date, room-temperature on-waveguide detection has been realized only through hybrid flip-chip assembly of discrete elements, which leads to poor mode coupling, larger footprint, and reduced mechanical stability. Here we address this gap by demonstrating a room-temperature graphene sub-THz detector monolithically integrated on a high-resistivity silicon dielectric waveguide for D-band (110-170 GHz) operation. We couple an hBN-encapsulated graphene channel to the guided mode using a tapered slot-line antenna patterned directly onto the silicon surface. The detector achieves a voltage responsivity of 11.5 V/W and a 3 dB bandwidth of 1.94 GHz, with the latter currently limited by parasitic inductance of the readout interconnects rather than by the intrinsic graphene response. This platform provides a practical pathway to fully integrated room-temperature THz photonic circuits, where electrostatic gating and impedance matching can improve both responsivity and bandwidth by roughly an order of magnitude.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrating、monolithically integrated、achieves、measured（摘要中提及器件制备与性能表征）。；研究对象：集成在高阻硅介质波导上的石墨烯亚太赫兹探测器，工作于D波段（110–170 GHz），核心体系为hBN封装石墨烯通道与硅波导的混合集成结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了室温下石墨烯亚太赫兹探测器在硅介质波导上的单片集成，获得11.5 V/W的电压响应度和1.94 GHz的3 dB带宽，带宽目前受读出互连寄生电感限制而非石墨烯本征响应限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了室温下石墨烯亚太赫兹探测器在硅介质波导上的单片集成，获得11.5 V/W的电压响应度和1.94 GHz的3 dB带宽，带宽目前受读出互连寄生电感限制而非石墨烯本征响应限制。；创新点：首次在低损耗介质波导上实现室温石墨烯亚太赫兹探测器的单片集成，避免了此前混合倒装芯片组装导致的模式耦合差、占用面积大和机械稳定性差的问题，为全集成室温太赫兹光子电路提供了可行平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备与表征：将hBN封装的石墨烯通道通过直接图案化在硅表面的锥形槽线天线耦合到波导导模，实现单片集成；测量了器件的电压响应度和3 dB带宽。

papers.title: Phase-sensitive cascade quantum amplifier with nearly noiseless operation
papers.abstract: Phase-sensitive parametric devices enable quadrature-selective amplification with the potential for sub-quantum-limited noise performance. In this work, we investigate the operation of a SQUID-based Josephson Parametric Amplifier (JPA), comparing its performance in the phase-preserving and phase-sensitive regimes. The device, fabricated using VTT SWAPS technology, is driven in a three-wave mixing configuration and characterized in a reflection-based measurement setup at millikelvin temperatures. To directly probe the noise performance at low JPA gains, we employ a cascaded amplification scheme in which a Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifier (TWPA) provides low-noise pre-amplification of the JPA output. In a phase-preserving operation, the JPA exhibits near-quantum-limited performance with a system noise temperature of $351\pm53$ mK at 6 GHz. In contrast, phase-sensitive operation yields a minimum system noise temperature of $94\pm12$ mK, well below the standard quantum limit of 288 mK. Our results demonstrate that a JPA-TWPA amplifier cascade opens the door to direct, high-fidelity probing of quantum devices without the need for background noise subtraction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了器件制备（VTT SWAPS技术）、测量装置（反射式测量、millikelvin温度）以及噪声温度等实验数据。；研究对象：基于SQUID的约瑟夫森参量放大器（JPA），具体研究其在相位保持（phase-preserving）和相位敏感（phase-sensitive）两种工作模式下的噪声性能，并与行波参量放大器（TWPA）级联使用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相位敏感模式下，JPA-TWPA级联放大器的系统噪声温度低至94±12 mK，显著低于标准量子极限288 mK，实现了近无噪声的放大操作；而在相位保持模式下噪声温度约为351±53 mK，接近量子极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相位敏感模式下，JPA-TWPA级联放大器的系统噪声温度低至94±12 mK，显著低于标准量子极限288 mK，实现了近无噪声的放大操作；而在相位保持模式下噪声温度约为351±53 mK，接近量子极限。；创新点：通过JPA-TWPA级联放大方案，实现了无需背景噪声扣除即可直接、高保真地探测量子器件噪声性能，并在相位敏感模式下将系统噪声温度压低至标准量子极限以下。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用VTT SWAPS技术制备SQUID基JPA，在三波混频构型下驱动，并在millikelvin温度下进行反射式测量。为探测低增益下的噪声性能，使用TWPA作为前置低噪声放大器，构成级联放大方案。

papers.title: $(k,n)$-core percolation on hypergraphs with anchor nodes
papers.abstract: Hypergraphs describe higher-order interactions that involve more than a pair of nodes. A characteristic feature of hypergraphs is that their robustness can be strongly affected by the different roles of the nodes. Indeed, some nodes might be essential for a hyperedge's function, while others might not be. The loss of a single essential node completely destroys the hyperedge it belongs to, while the loss of a non-essential node has a buffering effect, inducing the hyperedge to simply reduce its size. In order to capture this phenomenology, we formulate a comprehensive theoretical framework for $(k,n)$-core percolation models on hypergraphs, where each node of a hyperedge is an anchor with probability $θ$, and a hyperedge fails if an anchor node fails. Hypergraph $(k,n)$-core percolation problems can be classified as first-neighbor and second-neighbor problems, indicating that in the pruning process the connectivity is ensured only by the state of the first neighbors or the second neighbors, respectively. We derive self-consistency equations for first-neighbor and second-neighbor (node- and hyperedge-based) pruning processes, and obtain the size of the giant $(k,n)$-core.
