papers.abstract: The electronic density of states (DOS) is conventionally computed from a relaxed crystal structure, which is unavailable for compounds that have been neither synthesized nor cataloged. Here we introduce DOSSIER ($\textbf{D}$ensity $\textbf{o}$f $\textbf{S}$tates from $\textbf{S}$to$\textbf{i}$chiometry with $\textbf{E}$ncoder $\textbf{R}$epresentations), a chemical language model that maps elemental composition directly to this spectrum. The encoder is pretrained by cross-modal knowledge distillation from a universal machine-learning interatomic potential; the transfer lowers the error by 11% when only 1,000 training examples are available. On the Mat2Spec benchmark, DOSSIER reaches a mean absolute error of 3.76 states eV$^{-1}$ against 3.64 for the best structure-aware model; on an extended Materials Project dataset, the predicted spectra yield band gaps and $\textit{d}$-band descriptors with useful accuracy. Screening 11,977 binary and 13,251 five-component high-entropy alloy compositions for a $\textit{d}$-projected DOS resembling that of NiPt$_{3}$ places known oxygen reduction electrocatalysts near the top of the ranking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“chemical language model”“machine-learning interatomic potential”“benchmark”“screening”等，均为计算与机器学习方法关键词。；研究对象：材料的电子态密度（DOS），特别是从元素化学计量比直接预测DOS，涵盖二元化合物、五元高熵合金以及已知氧还原电催化剂（如NiPt₃相关体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种仅从元素组成即可预测电子态密度的化学语言模型DOSSIER，其预测精度接近甚至达到结构感知模型的水平，并能用于筛选具有目标d带特征的候选电催化剂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种仅从元素组成即可预测电子态密度的化学语言模型DOSSIER，其预测精度接近甚至达到结构感知模型的水平，并能用于筛选具有目标d带特征的候选电催化剂。；创新点：实现了“结构无关”（structure-agnostic）的DOS预测，即无需弛豫晶体结构即可直接从化学计量比获得光谱信息；利用跨模态知识蒸馏提升小样本下的预测精度（1000个训练样本时误差降低11%）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 化学语言模型（encoder架构），通过跨模态知识蒸馏从通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine-learning interatomic potential）进行预训练；在Mat2Spec基准和扩展的Materials Project数据集上评估；用于筛选二元和五元高熵合金成分。

papers.title: Disorder-induced conducting edges on Kagomé lattice
papers.abstract: Within a cluster extension of the coherent potential approximation, disorder averaging generates a non-local self-energy that renormalizes both diagonal and off-diagonal hopping terms of the non-interacting Kagome-lattice Hamiltonian. These renormalizations (of both nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor hopping amplitudes) drive the system between two topologically trivial insulating states through an intermediate gapless phase characterized by conducting edge modes over a broad range of impurity concentrations. Our results demonstrate that multiple-scattering effects alone can generate emergent effective spin-orbit interactions and qualitatively modify the edge spectrum of disordered Kagome systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“cluster extension of the coherent potential approximation”（团簇扩展的相干势近似）、“disorder averaging”（无序平均）等理论计算方法。；研究对象：Kagomé（笼目）晶格上的无序电子系统，具体关注无序诱导的边界导电态及拓扑平庸绝缘体之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序平均产生的非局域自能会同时重整化最近邻和次近邻跳跃项，等效地诱导出自旋-轨道耦合效应，从而驱动系统在两个拓扑平庸绝缘态之间经过一个中间无隙相，该无隙相在很宽的杂质浓度范围内支持导电边界模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序平均产生的非局域自能会同时重整化最近邻和次近邻跳跃项，等效地诱导出自旋-轨道耦合效应，从而驱动系统在两个拓扑平庸绝缘态之间经过一个中间无隙相，该无隙相在很宽的杂质浓度范围内支持导电边界模。；创新点：首次证明仅凭多重散射效应（无需真实自旋-轨道耦合）即可产生有效的自旋-轨道相互作用，并显著改变无序Kagomé体系的边界谱。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用相干势近似的团簇扩展（cluster extension of CPA）方法，通过无序平均生成非局域自能，并分析其对非相互作用Kagomé晶格哈密顿量中跳跃参数的修正。

papers.title: Plastic Relaxation without Dislocations in $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Heteroepitaxy: A Structural Peculiarity of Ga$_2$O$_3$ Polymorphs
papers.abstract: $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ grows as three-dimensional islands on mismatched c-plane sapphire, often on a thin $α$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ wetting layer, and eventually forms a continuous film by island coalescence. Experiments reveal the $β$ film to be relaxed. Surprisingly no dislocations are observed, suggesting an unusual plastic relaxation path. We reveal the key mechanisms underlying this process by combining density functional theory, continuum nucleation theory, and molecular dynamics simulations. Plastic relaxation occurs through rearrangement of the Ga atoms beneath the oxygen plane shared by both the wetting layer and the (-201) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ structures. A local $α$ to $β$-relaxed phase transition is thus realized within a single plane, allowing full relaxation of the $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ island.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+理论+模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combining density functional theory, continuum nucleation theory, and molecular dynamics simulations”，即结合了DFT、连续介质成核理论和分子动力学模拟。；研究对象：β-Ga₂O₃在c面蓝宝石衬底上的异质外延生长，具体关注其塑性弛豫机制，以及α-Ga₂O₃润湿层与β-Ga₂O₃（-201）结构之间的相变关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: β-Ga₂O₃薄膜的塑性弛豫并非通过位错实现，而是通过氧平面下方Ga原子的重排，在单个原子平面内完成局域α→β弛豫相变，从而实现β-Ga₂O₃岛状结构的完全弛豫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：β-Ga₂O₃薄膜的塑性弛豫并非通过位错实现，而是通过氧平面下方Ga原子的重排，在单个原子平面内完成局域α→β弛豫相变，从而实现β-Ga₂O₃岛状结构的完全弛豫。；创新点：揭示了β-Ga₂O₃异质外延中一种无需位错参与的新型塑性弛豫路径，即通过单原子层内的局域相变实现应力释放，这与传统外延薄膜中位错介导的弛豫机制截然不同。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、连续介质成核理论（continuum nucleation theory）、分子动力学（MD）模拟。摘要未提及任何实验测量手段。

papers.title: Anomalous magnetocaloric effects in the quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$
papers.abstract: We investigate the transverse-field thermodynamics of the quasi-one-dimensional Ising-like antiferromagnet BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$, whose tilted screw-chain geometry and anisotropic Landé $g$ tensor generate spatially modulated Zeeman couplings. Angle-resolved magnetocaloric-effect (MCE) measurements reveal a high-field temperature minimum near the transverse-field Ising critical field for $H\parallel[110]$ that persists and shifts only weakly upon field rotation. Tensor-network calculations show that the rotation-induced staggered transverse field rapidly lowers the Ising critical field and that the magnetic Grüneisen ratio changes sign near the high-field temperature minimum, consistent with experiment. Our results establish that a dominant MCE response can persist away from the Ising critical region, suggesting a route to magnetic cooling by tailoring anisotropic Zeeman-coupling configurations in quantum magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：angle-resolved magnetocaloric-effect (MCE) measurements（实验测量）、tensor-network calculations（张量网络计算）。；研究对象：准一维Ising型反铁磁体BaCo₂V₂O₈，其倾斜螺旋链几何和各向异性Landé g张量导致空间调制的Zeeman耦合。具体研究其横向磁场下的热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在H∥[110]方向、接近横向场Ising临界场处出现高温温度极小值，该极小值在磁场旋转时持续存在且仅微弱移动；张量网络计算表明旋转诱导的交错横向场迅速降低Ising临界场，且磁Grüneisen比在高温温度极小值附近改变符号，与实验一致。主要MCE响应可在远离Ising临界区域持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在H∥[110]方向、接近横向场Ising临界场处出现高温温度极小值，该极小值在磁场旋转时持续存在且仅微弱移动；张量网络计算表明旋转诱导的交错横向场迅速降低Ising临界场，且磁Grüneisen比在高温温度极小值附近改变符号，与实验一致。主要MCE响应可在远离Ising临界区域持续存在。；创新点：发现主导的磁热效应响应可以远离Ising临界区域持续存在，提出通过调控量子磁体中各向异性Zeeman耦合构型实现磁制冷的途径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角度分辨磁热效应（MCE）测量；理论上采用张量网络（tensor-network）计算方法。

papers.title: Electronic cooling of a TiW alloy normal-metal island using Nb-based superconducting tunnel junctions
papers.abstract: TiW thin films remain non-superconducting down to millikelvin temperatures and are compatible with large-scale CMOS manufacturing, making them attractive for cryogenic and quantum tunnel-junction devices, such as normal-metal-insulator-superconductor (NIS) thermal sensors and electron refrigerators. We demonstrate significant electronic cooling of a TiW-based normal-metal island and electron thermometry by using TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS tunnel-junction stacks. The NIS thermometer enables local electron temperature measurements from 0.5 to 8.32 K. NIS cooling is observed between 0.6 and 3.5 K, with maximum absolute and relative temperature reductions of 217 mK and 27%, respectively. Calculations using tunnel-junction parameters obtained independently from current-voltage fits reproduce the measured optimum-voltage scale, which lies substantially below the ideal low-temperature prediction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”“measurements”“observed”等实验性词汇，并涉及器件制备与测量。；研究对象：TiW合金正常金属岛与Nb基超导隧道结组成的NIS（正常金属-绝缘体-超导体）隧道结器件，具体研究其电子制冷与电子测温性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TiW基NIS隧道结器件在0.6–3.5 K温区实现了显著的电子制冷效果，最大绝对降温217 mK、相对降温27%；同时该器件可作为电子温度计在0.5–8.32 K范围内工作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TiW基NIS隧道结器件在0.6–3.5 K温区实现了显著的电子制冷效果，最大绝对降温217 mK、相对降温27%；同时该器件可作为电子温度计在0.5–8.32 K范围内工作。；创新点：首次将CMOS兼容的TiW合金（在毫开尔文温度下仍保持非超导）用于NIS电子制冷器件，实现了基于TiW正常金属岛的电子冷却演示；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备TiW-Al-AlOx-Nb NIS隧道结堆栈，通过电流-电压（I-V）特性拟合提取隧道结参数，并利用NIS结作为局部电子温度计进行电子温度测量，结合理论计算对比最优制冷电压标度。

papers.title: A colossal dielectric response of Bi1-xSmxFeO3 nanopowders
papers.abstract: The dielectric permittivity of the pressed powder samples of Bi1-xSmxFeO3, with Sm content "x" varying in the range 0 - 0.2, has been investigated in the temperature range from 20 to 400 C and the frequency range from 100 Hz to 100 kHz. We have shown that the Sm content impacts significantly the real and imaginary parts of effective dielectric permittivity, which have expanded diffuse maxima with a colossal magnitude up to 105 (for the real part) and up to 108 (for the imaginary one) at temperatures 300 - 400 K. Analysis of experimental data carried has shown that both the real and imaginary parts of effective dielectric permittivity may be comprehensively explained by considering a complex interplay of a diffuse ferroelectric-paraelectric phase transition and the Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars effects, which emerge from the formation of spatial charges at interfaces between nanograins and at the ferroelectric nanoparticle-air interface. Processing of experimental data for the real and imaginary parts of the effective dielectric permittivity within effective medium approach allows us to separate and analyze the colossal dielectric response of the nanoparticles itself. The main trends followed from experiments are supported by the theoretically simulated dependences, which reveal correlations between the temperature behavior of dielectric properties and phase state of the Bi1-xSmxFeO3 nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“investigated”“experimental data”“pressed powder samples”等实验关键词，并包含理论模拟对比，但主体为实验研究。；研究对象：Bi₁₋ₓSmₓFeO₃（钐掺杂铁酸铋）纳米粉体，Sm含量x在0–0.2范围内变化。研究其有效介电常数的温度（20–400°C）和频率（100 Hz–100 kHz）依赖行为，特别是巨介电响应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sm掺杂显著影响Bi₁₋ₓSmₓFeO₃纳米粉体的有效介电常数实部和虚部，在300–400 K温度区间出现展宽的弥散极大值，实部高达10⁵、虚部高达10⁸，呈现巨介电响应。该响应源于弥散铁电-顺电相变与纳米晶粒界面及纳米颗粒-空气界面空间电荷引起的Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars效应的复杂耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sm掺杂显著影响Bi₁₋ₓSmₓFeO₃纳米粉体的有效介电常数实部和虚部，在300–400 K温度区间出现展宽的弥散极大值，实部高达10⁵、虚部高达10⁸，呈现巨介电响应。该响应源于弥散铁电-顺电相变与纳米晶粒界面及纳米颗粒-空气界面空间电荷引起的Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars效应的复杂耦合。；创新点：通过有效介质方法将纳米颗粒本征的巨介电响应与界面（晶粒间及颗粒-空气界面）的Maxwell-Wagner-Sillars贡献进行分离，并系统揭示Sm掺杂浓度对弥散相变和空间电荷效应的调控作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用压制粉体样品，测量不同温度（20–400°C）和频率（100 Hz–100 kHz）下的介电谱，获取有效介电常数实部和虚部。数据分析采用有效介质近似（effective medium approach）分离纳米颗粒本征的巨介电响应与界面贡献，并结合理论模拟验证介电性质与纳米颗粒相态之间的关联。

papers.title: Altermagnetic Anomalous Hall Effect and Spin--Edge-Locked Chiral Modes in a Modified Kane--Mele--Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: We establish a correlation-driven route to the altermagnetic anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and its associated \emph{spin--edge-locked} edge states in a modified Kane--Mele--Hubbard model. Using dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), we show that, at half-filling, increasing the Hubbard interaction drives the system from a metallic paramagnetic phase hosting antichiral edge states into an insulating in-plane Néel-type antiferromagnetic phase, in which a residual antiunitary symmetry forbids the AHE. Hole doping induces a spin-flop transition to an out-of-plane Néel-type antiferromagnetic phase, thereby breaking this symmetry and generating a finite anomalous Hall conductivity that persists into the strongly correlated regime. Distinct from a conventional spin-polarized Hall response in ferromagnets, the altermagnetic AHE receives equal and additive contributions from the two symmetry-related spin sectors and is accompanied by spin--edge-locked chiral states. Our results demonstrate that carrier doping and spin-rotationally invariant Hubbard interactions are sufficient to realize the altermagnetic AHE, without invoking an explicitly Ising-like interaction, and provide a realistic microscopic route toward its realization in correlated transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT)、model、show。；研究对象：修正的Kane–Mele–Hubbard模型中的交错磁（altermagnetic）反常霍尔效应（AHE）及其自旋-边缘锁定手性边缘态，并关联到相关过渡金属二硫化物单层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在关联电子体系中，通过空穴掺杂诱导自旋翻转（spin-flop）跃迁至面外Néel型反铁磁相，可打破禁止AHE的残余反幺正对称性，从而产生有限的反常霍尔电导，且该电导在强关联区持续存在；该AHE由两个对称相关的自旋扇区等量相加贡献，并伴随自旋-边缘锁定的手性边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在关联电子体系中，通过空穴掺杂诱导自旋翻转（spin-flop）跃迁至面外Néel型反铁磁相，可打破禁止AHE的残余反幺正对称性，从而产生有限的反常霍尔电导，且该电导在强关联区持续存在；该AHE由两个对称相关的自旋扇区等量相加贡献，并伴随自旋-边缘锁定的手性边缘态。；创新点：证明了仅靠载流子掺杂和自旋旋转不变的Hubbard相互作用即可实现交错磁AHE，无需显式的Ising型各向异性相互作用，为在相关过渡金属二硫化物单层中实现该效应提供了微观路径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 动力学平均场理论（DMFT），在半填充和空穴掺杂条件下研究Hubbard相互作用驱动的相变与输运性质。

papers.title: Emergence of Stigmergic Transport in Granular Environments
papers.abstract: We show that stigmergic path formation emerges in a deformable environment through the interplay between environmental memory and geometrical crowding. Using experiments with robotic random walkers together with a minimal stochastic model, we demonstrate the onset of persistent self-reinforced transport pathways above a critical packing fraction $φ_c$, where environmental memory enhances walker mobility. As the jamming transition $φ_J$ is approached, increasing crowding progressively suppresses this transport enhancement despite the persistence of environmental memory. The resulting non-monotonic behavior reveals an optimal transport regime well below jamming. More generally, our work establishes how active agents can collectively build transport networks through purely mechanical interactions with a deformable substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要提及“experiments with robotic random walkers”以及“a minimal stochastic model”。；研究对象：可变形颗粒环境中的活性粒子输运现象，具体为stigmergic路径形成（即通过环境记忆与几何拥挤相互作用自发形成的自增强输运通道），以及该输运行为与堆积/堵塞转变（jamming transition）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在可变形颗粒环境中，当堆积分数超过临界值φ_c时，会涌现出持续的自增强输运路径，且环境记忆可增强walker的迁移率；但随着体系接近堵塞转变φ_J，拥挤效应会抑制这种输运增强，导致在远低于堵塞点处存在一个最优输运区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在可变形颗粒环境中，当堆积分数超过临界值φ_c时，会涌现出持续的自增强输运路径，且环境记忆可增强walker的迁移率；但随着体系接近堵塞转变φ_J，拥挤效应会抑制这种输运增强，导致在远低于堵塞点处存在一个最优输运区间。；创新点：首次展示了活性粒子可通过纯机械相互作用（而非化学信号或长程通信）在可变形基底上集体构建输运网络，并揭示了环境记忆与几何拥挤之间的竞争导致非单调输运行为。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用机器人随机行走器（robotic random walkers）在可变形颗粒环境中进行输运实验；理论上构建了一个最小随机模型（minimal stochastic model）来复现和解释实验观察到的路径形成与输运增强行为。

papers.title: Exact autoregressive sampling of planar Ising spin glasses via the Kac--Ward theory
papers.abstract: Exact sampling from the Boltzmann distribution of spin glasses remains an outstanding challenge: Markov chain Monte Carlo methods suffer from critical slowing down and metastable trapping, while modern neural autoregressive samplers such as variational autoregressive networks are approximate and, in the absence of exact reference samples, cannot be rigorously benchmarked. Here we present an exact autoregressive sampling algorithm for planar Ising spin glasses based on the Kac--Ward theory. Under the chain-rule factorization, sequentially fixing spins induces boundary-localized external fields, which destroy the zero-field structure required for exact evaluation. By encoding these fields with a planarity-preserving auxiliary spin construction, the conditional partition functions are mapped to an extended zero-field Ising model and exactly evaluated using the Kac--Ward determinant formula. The method generates strictly independent and identically distributed samples with exact normalized likelihoods at a computational cost of $\mathcal{O}(N^{5/2})$ for $N$ spins, thereby providing an exact baseline for benchmarking neural autoregressive samplers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact sampling、Kac--Ward theory、determinant formula、computational cost。；研究对象：平面伊辛自旋玻璃（planar Ising spin glasses）的玻尔兹曼分布精确采样问题，属于统计物理与计算物理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于Kac–Ward理论的精确自回归采样算法，能够以严格独立同分布的方式生成平面伊辛自旋玻璃的样本，并给出精确归一化似然值，计算复杂度为O(N^{5/2})，可作为神经自回归采样器的精确基准。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于Kac–Ward理论的精确自回归采样算法，能够以严格独立同分布的方式生成平面伊辛自旋玻璃的样本，并给出精确归一化似然值，计算复杂度为O(N^{5/2})，可作为神经自回归采样器的精确基准。；创新点：首次将Kac–Ward理论应用于自回归精确采样框架，解决了顺序固定自旋时诱导的边界外场破坏零场结构这一关键困难，实现了对平面伊辛自旋玻璃的严格精确采样，为近似神经自回归采样器提供了可严格基准测试的参考样本。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与算法设计。具体采用：链式法则分解（自回归逐自旋固定）、平面性保持的辅助自旋构造来编码边界局域外场、将条件配分函数映射到扩展的零场伊辛模型，并利用Kac–Ward行列式公式精确计算条件配分函数。

papers.title: Conformation-Mediated Kinetics of Polymer Chain Scission under Tension
papers.abstract: Chain scission is a key molecular process underlying damage and fracture in polymer networks. In this Letter, we develop a statistical-mechanical framework for predicting chain-scission kinetics while accounting for three-dimensional (3D) conformational fluctuations. Within transition-state theory, scission is formulated as a multichannel first-rupture problem, with bond-specific rates governed primarily by self-consistent potentials of mean force. In the freely jointed limit, the additional 3D configurational freedom enhances rupture relative to the collinear 1D reference. Finite bending stiffness introduces orientational correlations that can reverse this enhancement and, at high stiffness, reduce rupture rates by orders of magnitude. These correlations also make rupture bond-position dependent, with higher rates near the chain ends and a common interior rate. For sufficiently long chains, the interior contribution dominates, yielding linear scaling of the chain-scission rate with chain length. These molecularly resolved rates provide physically grounded inputs for future network-scale models of polymer damage and fracture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“statistical-mechanical framework”“transition-state theory”“formulated as a multichannel first-rupture problem”，属于理论建模与统计力学分析。；研究对象：聚合物网络中的链断裂（chain scission）动力学，具体关注三维构象涨落对断裂速率的影响，以及链的弯曲刚度、链长和断裂位置（链端 vs 链内部）对断裂速率的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维构象自由度在自由连接链极限下增强断裂速率，但有限弯曲刚度引入的取向关联可逆转这一增强，并在高刚度下使断裂速率降低数个数量级；断裂速率具有位置依赖性（链端更高、内部趋于一致），长链极限下内部贡献主导，链断裂速率随链长线性标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维构象自由度在自由连接链极限下增强断裂速率，但有限弯曲刚度引入的取向关联可逆转这一增强，并在高刚度下使断裂速率降低数个数量级；断裂速率具有位置依赖性（链端更高、内部趋于一致），长链极限下内部贡献主导，链断裂速率随链长线性标度。；创新点：将三维构象涨落显式纳入链断裂动力学预测，揭示了弯曲刚度导致的取向关联对断裂速率的非单调调控机制，并给出了分子级分辨的断裂速率，为网络尺度损伤模型提供物理输入。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值模拟方法的对比验证。
papers.method_zh: 基于过渡态理论（transition-state theory）的统计力学框架，将断裂建模为多通道首次断裂问题，键特异性速率由自洽的平均力势（potentials of mean force）决定；对比了自由连接链（freely jointed chain）与具有有限弯曲刚度的链模型，并分析了1D共线参考与3D构象涨落的差异。

papers.title: A hidden low-temperature transformation pathway in compositionally complex materials
papers.abstract: Most compositionally complex materials (CCMs, frequently referred to as high entropy alloys) are metastable and their attractive properties often belong to kinetically trapped states. However, pathways towards lower-free-energy phase states governing long-term stability, can remain hidden because diffusion-controlled atomic redistribution is too slow to be revealed at experimentally accessible timescales. This blind spot is acute in CCM design: enormous compositional spaces are screened for performance, yet the low-temperature kinetics and the associated transformation pathways determining whether that performance persists are rarely considered in material selection. Here we use defect-rich nanoscale volumes coupled with atom-probe tomography to access and reconstruct the hidden phase-evolution pathway in a metastable Ag24Au20Pd50Pt6 electrocatalyst, without relying on elevated temperatures to accelerate the transformation. By varying microstructural starting state, annealing temperature and time, we reveal precipitation of a Pt-rich phase within the fcc matrix, its coarsening and re-homogenization. The Pt-rich phase recurs after homogenization with delayed kinetic accessibility, while prolonged annealing extends the pathway to 300°C. Atomistic simulations independently predict the same Pt-rich phase selection. The transformation is accompanied by a 3.7-fold loss of catalytic activity for hydrogen evolution. These results establish hidden phase-evolution pathways as a materials-design variable: resolving them can guide the selection of metastable CCMs not only for their as-synthesized properties, but also for the phase states and associated functionalities they may access over time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含原子级模拟辅助）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“atom-probe tomography”（原子探针层析技术）等实验手段，同时提到“Atomistic simulations independently predict”（原子模拟独立预测），属于实验为主、计算为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：成分复杂材料（CCMs，即高熵合金类），具体为亚稳态 Ag₂₄Au₂₀Pd₅₀Pt₆ 电催化剂，研究其在低温下的隐藏相演化路径（Pt 富集相析出、粗化与再均匀化）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需升温加速的条件下，通过缺陷富集的纳米尺度体积结合原子探针层析技术，揭示了亚稳态 Ag₂₄Au₂₀Pd₅₀Pt₆ 中隐藏的低温相变路径——fcc 基体内析出 Pt 富集相，随后粗化并再均匀化，且该相在均匀化后延迟再现；该相变伴随析氢催化活性下降 3.7 倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需升温加速的条件下，通过缺陷富集的纳米尺度体积结合原子探针层析技术，揭示了亚稳态 Ag₂₄Au₂₀Pd₅₀Pt₆ 中隐藏的低温相变路径——fcc 基体内析出 Pt 富集相，随后粗化并再均匀化，且该相在均匀化后延迟再现；该相变伴随析氢催化活性下降 3.7 倍。；创新点：首次将“隐藏的低温相演化路径”确立为材料设计变量——传统 CCM 筛选只关注合成态性能，而该工作展示了如何在不依赖高温加速的条件下直接解析亚稳态材料随时间可能进入的相态及其功能变化，为亚稳态 CCM 的长期稳定性筛选提供了新维度。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用缺陷富集的纳米尺度体积（defect-rich nanoscale volumes）结合原子探针层析（atom-probe tomography, APT），通过改变微观起始状态、退火温度和退火时间系统追踪相演化；计算上采用原子模拟（atomistic simulations）独立预测 Pt 富集相的选择。

papers.title: Influence of the inter-orbital interaction and kinetic terms on superconductivity: a simple two-orbital Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We investigate a minimal two-orbital Hubbard model with intra- and inter-orbital nearest-neighbor hopping $t$ and $\tilde{t}$, as well as intra- and inter-orbital density-density interactions $U$ and $U'$ by means of variational ansätze based on Jastrow-Slater wave functions within quantum Monte Carlo techniques. To focus on the electronic mechanisms of superconductivity, we restrict the variational ansätze to uniform nonmagnetic states with an explicit pairing amplitude and compute the pairing correlations as a function of filling and model parameters. At $U/t=10$, superconducting correlations are highly enhanced by the presence of inter-orbital terms, $U'$ and $\tilde{t}$. For $\tilde{t}=0$, a finite value of $U'$ effectively screens the intra-orbital repulsion $U$, producing a shift in the superconducting dome. Consequently, inter-orbital repulsion yields a sizable increase in electron pairing compared to the single-orbital baseline. Furthermore, introducing a finite $\tilde{t}$ provides an additional boost to superconducting correlations, an effect driven by the simultaneous presence of flat and broad bands in the electronic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用变分波函数（Jastrow-Slater）与量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）技术进行数值研究。；研究对象：一个包含轨道内与轨道间最近邻跳跃（t 与 t̃）以及轨道内与轨道间密度-密度相互作用（U 与 U′）的最小两轨道 Hubbard 模型，聚焦于电子机制驱动的超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 U/t=10 时，轨道间相互作用 U′ 和轨道间跳跃 t̃ 的存在显著增强超导关联；U′ 有效屏蔽轨道内排斥 U 并移动超导穹顶位置，而有限 t̃ 通过平带与宽带的共存进一步促进电子配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 U/t=10 时，轨道间相互作用 U′ 和轨道间跳跃 t̃ 的存在显著增强超导关联；U′ 有效屏蔽轨道内排斥 U 并移动超导穹顶位置，而有限 t̃ 通过平带与宽带的共存进一步促进电子配对。；创新点：系统揭示了轨道间库仑排斥 U′ 与轨道间跳跃 t̃ 对两轨道 Hubbard 模型中超导配对的独立及协同增强效应，并指出平带-宽带共存是 t̃ 促进配对的关键机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Jastrow-Slater 变分波函数的量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）技术；变分空间限制为均匀非磁态并显式包含配对振幅，计算配对关联函数随填充和模型参数的变化。

papers.title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the $0$--$π$ transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable $π$-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretically investigate”“we show”“we find”等理论推导性表述，且未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维约瑟夫森结，其中包含双极磁性半导体（BMS）作为弱连接区域。研究聚焦于该体系的平衡超流、0–π跃迁、反常约瑟夫森效应及约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BMS中自旋分辨能带的内禀交换劈裂可实现纯电学调控的0–π跃迁（无需外磁场）；在Rashba自旋轨道耦合存在时，体系在零相位差下出现有限平衡超流（反常约瑟夫森效应），但尽管时间反演和空间反演对称性同时破缺，并未观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应，表明反常约瑟夫森输运与超导非互易性并不等价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BMS中自旋分辨能带的内禀交换劈裂可实现纯电学调控的0–π跃迁（无需外磁场）；在Rashba自旋轨道耦合存在时，体系在零相位差下出现有限平衡超流（反常约瑟夫森效应），但尽管时间反演和空间反演对称性同时破缺，并未观察到约瑟夫森二极管效应，表明反常约瑟夫森输运与超导非互易性并不等价。；创新点：首次提出利用双极磁性半导体的内禀交换劈裂实现无需外磁场的电学可控π结；并明确指出反常约瑟夫森效应（零相位差下有限超流）并不必然伴随约瑟夫森二极管效应（临界电流不对称），这一区分对理解超导非互易性具有重要意义。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于一维约瑟夫森结的平衡电流计算，结合BMS的能带结构（自旋分辨交换劈裂）以及Rashba自旋轨道耦合效应，通过门电压调控BMS化学势来研究0–π跃迁。摘要未明确说明具体方法（如散射矩阵、Gor'kov方程或数值模拟等）。

papers.title: Critical bifurcation and deconfined quantum criticality in an interacting cluster Ising chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the cluster Ising chain with an additional nearest-neighbor interaction using tensor-network methods and a weak-coupling field theory. Without the interaction, the Jordan-Wigner transformation decomposes the model into a triplet of identical Majorana chains related by an exact $O(3)$ flavor symmetry. Their common mass vanishes at the $SU(2)_2$ Wess-Zumino-Novikov-Witten critical point with central charge $c = 3/2$ separating the symmetry-protected topological cluster phase from a ferromagnet. The interaction reduces $O(3)$ to its cyclic subgroup $C_3$, splitting the triplet into a singlet and a doublet whose gaps close separately, producing a critical bifurcation into Ising ($c = 1/2$) and Gaussian ($c = 1$) critical lines. A second ferromagnetic phase opens between these critical lines for repulsive interactions and a disordered phase for attractive ones. The Gaussian line then separates two Landau-incompatible ferromagnets, realizing a deconfined quantum critical line with emergent $O(2)$ symmetry, along which our independently extracted exponents vary continuously yet satisfy the parameter-free relation $β= (2ν- 1)/4$ of the eight-vertex weak universality class. At stronger repulsion this line opens into an extended gapless floating phase with incommensurate algebraic correlations, entered through Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions. All of these phases and the transitions between them are captured by the weak-coupling theory. Beyond its regime of validity, our simulations reveal a translation-symmetry-breaking antiferromagnet reached through first-order transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：使用张量网络方法（tensor-network methods）和弱耦合场论（weak-coupling field theory）。；研究对象：具有额外最近邻相互作用的簇伊辛链（cluster Ising chain），一个一维量子自旋链模型。涉及对称性保护拓扑（SPT）簇相、铁磁相、退禁闭量子临界（deconfined quantum criticality）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在相互作用驱动下发生临界分岔（critical bifurcation），产生Ising（c=1/2）和Gaussian（c=1）两条临界线；其中Gaussian临界线连接两个Landau不相容的铁磁相，实现了一条具有涌现O(2)对称性的退禁闭量子临界线，其临界指数满足八顶点弱普适类的无参数关系β=(2ν-1)/4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在相互作用驱动下发生临界分岔（critical bifurcation），产生Ising（c=1/2）和Gaussian（c=1）两条临界线；其中Gaussian临界线连接两个Landau不相容的铁磁相，实现了一条具有涌现O(2)对称性的退禁闭量子临界线，其临界指数满足八顶点弱普适类的无参数关系β=(2ν-1)/4。；创新点：首次在簇伊辛链中引入最近邻相互作用，将O(3)味对称性约化为循环子群C₃，从而揭示临界分岔现象和退禁闭量子临界线的实现；摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法（tensor-network methods）用于数值模拟；弱耦合场论（weak-coupling field theory）用于解析分析。具体数值手段摘要未明确说明（如是否使用DMRG或MPS等），但属于张量网络家族。

papers.title: Off-stoichiometric variable doping for exceptional power factors in L2$_1$ Fe$_2$VAlM$_x$ (M=Ti, W) epitaxial thin films
papers.abstract: We show that the addition of Ti or W to stoichiometric L2$_1$ Fe$_2$VAl thin films by sputter codeposition produces off stoichiometric thin film alloys with superior thermoelectric properties than their stoichiometric counterparts. Ti incorporation induces p-type semiconducting behavior, while W incorporation shifts the material toward n-type, hereby enabling simultaneous tuning of both carrier types within a single parent (Fe$_2$VAl) material system, making it highly desirable for thermoelectric devices. The introduction of both Ti and W partly substitutes V in the stoichiometric compound. The partial substitution of V in the stoichiometric alloy allows fine-tuning the band structure of the system and transport properties. With this approach we obtain exceptional maximum power factor values for p and n-type films of 1300 $μ$W/m$\cdot$K$^2$ and 2100 $μ$W/m$\cdot$K$^2$ ,respectively, yielding maximum figures of merit zT of 0.07 and 0.14, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“sputter codeposition”（溅射共沉积）制备薄膜，并给出实验测量的功率因子和zT值。；研究对象：L2₁有序结构的Fe₂VAl基薄膜，具体为通过Ti或W非化学计量掺杂的Fe₂VAlMₓ（M=Ti, W）外延薄膜，研究其热电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在化学计量Fe₂VAl薄膜中掺入Ti或W可形成非化学计量合金，显著提升热电性能：Ti掺杂实现p型半导体行为，W掺杂使材料转向n型，从而在同一母体材料中同时实现两种载流子类型的调控。p型和n型薄膜分别获得1300 μW/m·K²和2100 μW/m·K²的优异最大功率因子，对应zT值分别为0.07和0.14。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在化学计量Fe₂VAl薄膜中掺入Ti或W可形成非化学计量合金，显著提升热电性能：Ti掺杂实现p型半导体行为，W掺杂使材料转向n型，从而在同一母体材料中同时实现两种载流子类型的调控。p型和n型薄膜分别获得1300 μW/m·K²和2100 μW/m·K²的优异最大功率因子，对应zT值分别为0.07和0.14。；创新点：在单一母体材料Fe₂VAl中通过不同掺杂元素（Ti和W）同时实现p型和n型热电性能的调控，避免了传统热电材料中需要不同母体体系分别实现p/n型掺杂的限制，有利于热电器件集成。摘要未突出说明与已有非化学计量掺杂研究相比的具体机制差异。
papers.method_zh: 溅射共沉积（sputter codeposition）制备外延薄膜；通过Ti和W部分替代V实现非化学计量掺杂；测量电输运性质（功率因子）和热电优值zT。

papers.title: Influence of Interface Energy Anisotropy on the Solid-state Instability in Ni-based Superalloy: A Multiscale Study
papers.abstract: The microstructural stability of nickel-based superalloys critically depends on the morphology and evolution of $γ'$-precipitates, which is governed by elastic and interfacial anisotropies at the atomic scale. Here, we present a novel quantitative multiscale framework that, for the first time, directly incorporates atomistically computed interface energy anisotropy into mesoscale phase-field simulations to elucidate morphological selection and instability in the Ni--Al system. We employ density functional theory (DFT) to accurately predict the orientation-dependent $γ/γ'$ interface energies for key crystallographic planes. A rigorous analytic mapping is then developed to systematically reduce the three-dimensional (3D) interface anisotropy landscape to the two-dimensional (2D) simulation plane. This enables quantitative transfer of DFT-informed anisotropy parameters into a continuum phase-field model that also accounts for elastic inhomogeneity and eigenstrain. Our simulations demonstrate that the explicit inclusion of DFT-based interface energy anisotropy fundamentally alters precipitate morphological evolution, robustly suppressing instability and faceting phenomena otherwise promoted by supersaturation and elastic effects. The framework bridges atomic- to mesoscale modeling, enabling predictive control of precipitate shapes and providing new insights into the interplay of elastic and interfacial contributions in Ni-based superalloys. This approach paves the way for quantitative microstructural design in advanced high-temperature alloys via first-principles-guided multiscale simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“density functional theory (DFT)”“phase-field simulations”“multiscale framework”等计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：镍基高温合金中γ′析出相的微观组织稳定性，具体为Ni–Al体系中γ/γ′界面能各向异性对析出相形貌选择与失稳行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于DFT计算的界面能各向异性显式引入介观相场模拟后，会从根本上改变γ′析出相的形貌演化，显著抑制由过饱和和弹性效应所促进的失稳与刻面化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于DFT计算的界面能各向异性显式引入介观相场模拟后，会从根本上改变γ′析出相的形貌演化，显著抑制由过饱和和弹性效应所促进的失稳与刻面化现象。；创新点：首次将原子尺度计算的界面能各向异性直接定量嵌入介观相场模拟，建立了从原子尺度到介观尺度的定量桥梁，实现了对析出相形貌的预测性控制。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度计算框架：第一性原理DFT计算关键晶面的γ/γ′界面能；建立解析映射将三维界面能各向异性信息降维到二维模拟平面；将DFT参数定量传递到考虑弹性不均匀性和本征应变的连续介质相场模型中。

papers.title: Two Microscopic Mechanisms of Piezomagnetism in CoF$_2$ from First-Principles Calculations
papers.abstract: Rutile-structured CoF$_2$ has long been recognized as a prototypical piezomagnetic material. Recently, it has attracted renewed interest as an altermagnet, exhibiting spin-split electronic bands even in the absence of spin-orbit coupling. Although the piezomagnetic response of CoF$_2$ has been extensively discussed from the viewpoint of magnetic symmetry, its microscopic origin has remained elusive. First-principles calculations reveal two distinct microscopic mechanisms of piezomagnetism in CoF$_2$. Under $xy$ shear strain, the local volumes of the CoF$_6$ octahedra surrounding the two Co sites become different, leading to unequal magnetic moments on the two sublattices and hence a net magnetization. In contrast, under $yz$ shear strain, the piezomagnetic response originates from spin canting induced by the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction through spin-orbit coupling. The presence of two distinct microscopic mechanisms may be a general feature of piezomagnetic antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：标题中的“First-Principles Calculations”以及摘要中的“First-principles calculations reveal...”。；研究对象：金红石结构的CoF₂，一种典型的压磁材料，同时也是近期备受关注的交错磁体（altermagnet）。研究聚焦于其压磁效应的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 第一性原理计算揭示了CoF₂中存在两种截然不同的压磁微观机制：在xy剪切应变下，两个Co位周围的CoF₆八面体局域体积发生不等变化，导致两个子晶格磁矩不等从而产生净磁化；而在yz剪切应变下，压磁响应则源于自旋轨道耦合诱导的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用引起的自旋倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：第一性原理计算揭示了CoF₂中存在两种截然不同的压磁微观机制：在xy剪切应变下，两个Co位周围的CoF₆八面体局域体积发生不等变化，导致两个子晶格磁矩不等从而产生净磁化；而在yz剪切应变下，压磁响应则源于自旋轨道耦合诱导的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用引起的自旋倾斜。；创新点：首次从微观层面阐明了CoF₂压磁效应的两种不同物理起源，并指出“存在两种不同微观机制”可能是压磁反铁磁体的一般特征。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论，具体泛函形式摘要未明确说明），通过施加不同方向的剪切应变（xy和yz）来分析CoF₂的电子结构和磁矩变化。

papers.title: Excitonic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching in multilayer CrSBr
papers.abstract: The coupling between electronic states and magnetism provides a route towards optical readout and control of magnetic information. In the magnetic semiconductor CrSBr, excitons are coupled to magnetic order, making their optical response sensitive to the underlying magnetization. Here, we show that the energy and oscillator strength of bulk and surface excitons provide distinct spectroscopic fingerprints of magnetic configurations and switching pathways. We distinguish domain-wall-mediated magnetization reversal, manifested by continuous spectral evolution as a domain wall traverses the optical spot, from abrupt, large-area magnetization reversal. Using the resulting excitonic fingerprints, we reconstruct successive magnetic configurations in 4- and 5-layer CrSBr during the transition from ferromagnetic to antiferromagnetic order. We further find that the sensitivity to magnetic order is strongly exciton-dependent: low-energy excitons resolve intermediate and surface-related configurations, whereas a higher-energy exciton predominantly exhibits a transfer of oscillator strength between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic resonances. These results establish excitonic spectroscopy as a sensitive probe of layer-dependent magnetic configurations and their switching pathways in layered magnetic semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show”“spectroscopic fingerprints”“optical response”等实验观测表述，且涉及光谱测量与磁构型重构。；研究对象：多层磁性半导体CrSBr（4层和5层），具体研究其激子光学响应与磁构型（铁磁→反铁磁转变）及磁化反转路径之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 体相和表面激子的能量与振子强度可提供磁构型和磁化反转路径的独特光谱指纹，能够区分畴壁介导的连续磁化反转与突变的面积型反转，并据此重构多层CrSBr在铁磁—反铁磁转变过程中的逐层磁构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：体相和表面激子的能量与振子强度可提供磁构型和磁化反转路径的独特光谱指纹，能够区分畴壁介导的连续磁化反转与突变的面积型反转，并据此重构多层CrSBr在铁磁—反铁磁转变过程中的逐层磁构型。；创新点：首次将激子光谱指纹用于区分两种不同的磁化反转机制（畴壁介导连续反转 vs. 大面积突变反转），并实现了对多层CrSBr中逐层磁构型的非侵入式光学重构；同时揭示了不同能量激子对磁序敏感性的显著差异（低能激子分辨中间态和表面构型，高能激子主要体现振子强度在铁磁/反铁磁共振间的转移）。
papers.method_zh: 激子光谱学（光学反射/吸收/光致发光类光谱测量），通过分析不同能量激子的能量位置和振子强度随磁化状态的变化来识别磁构型；结合多层样品（4层、5层）的层分辨激子响应进行磁构型重构。

papers.title: A Minimal Thermodynamically Consistent Chemical Oscillator
papers.abstract: Inspired by the chemical reaction network considered as the smallest system featuring a Hopf bifurcation and its reversible extension, we introduce an even more minimal reaction network that is thermodynamically consistent and exhibits autonomous oscillations under nonequilibrium driving. The model combines three features that are rarely realized simultaneously in compact oscillator networks: a chemically plausible structure restricted to uni- and bimolecular reactions, reversibility of such reactions, and analytical tractability. The system consists of three internal species coupled to two chemostatted species and still undergoes a supercritical Hopf bifurcation when a chemostat concentration is varied. To analyze the dynamics and thermodynamics near the onset of oscillations, we employ the mathematical technique of normal-form reduction, which allows obtaining a controlled irreversible approximation that preserves the leading phase-space structure of the full reversible network while enabling explicit calculations. This framework provides analytical access to the bifurcation structure and the leading contributions governing thermodynamic observables. Within this setting, we use the onset of oscillations to characterize the thermodynamic response of the system. In particular, we offer an analytical description of key thermodynamic quantities such as the semi-grand Gibbs free energy and the non-conservative work rate, which exhibit a kink-like discontinuity at the Hopf bifurcation. We thus provide an analytical description of a phenomenon previously characterized only through numerical simulations of more complex networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytical tractability”“normal-form reduction”“explicit calculations”等关键词，属于解析理论分析，无实验或数值模拟内容。；研究对象：一个由三种内部化学物种和两种化学恒化物种（chemostatted species）组成的极小化学反应网络，该网络在非平衡驱动下呈现自主振荡，并在Hopf分岔附近表现出热力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该最小反应网络在保持热力学一致性的前提下，通过改变恒化物种浓度可发生超临界Hopf分岔，并在分岔点处半巨吉布斯自由能和非保守功率等热力学量呈现扭结型（kink-like）不连续性，首次以解析方式刻画了这一此前仅在更复杂网络中数值观察到的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该最小反应网络在保持热力学一致性的前提下，通过改变恒化物种浓度可发生超临界Hopf分岔，并在分岔点处半巨吉布斯自由能和非保守功率等热力学量呈现扭结型（kink-like）不连续性，首次以解析方式刻画了这一此前仅在更复杂网络中数值观察到的现象。；创新点：该模型同时具备三个在紧凑振荡网络中很少同时实现的特性：仅含单分子和双分子反应的化学合理结构、反应可逆性、解析可处理性。相比此前仅能数值研究的更复杂网络，本文首次对Hopf分岔处的热力学响应给出了解析描述。
papers.method_zh: 采用化学反应网络理论，结合Hopf分岔分析与正规形约化（normal-form reduction）技术，在保持完整可逆网络相空间结构的前提下获得可控的不可逆近似，从而解析计算分岔结构和热力学可观测量（半巨吉布斯自由能、非保守功率）。

papers.title: Depth-Resolved Evolution of Buried Polar Topologies in a PbTiO3/SrTiO3 Superlattice
papers.abstract: Polar topologies in complex oxides gives rise to a rich spectrum of emergent functionalities and are fundamentally governed by three-dimensional (3D) atomic structures. However, direct experimental determination of buried 3D polar configurations remains a longstanding challenge because conventional (scanning) transmission electron microscopy ((S)TEM) provides primarily projected structural information with limited depth sensitivity. Here, we combine depth-sectioning low-angle annular dark-field (LAADF) STEM, high-angle ADF (HAADF) STEM, and multislice electron ptychography (MEP) to directly visualize the depth-dependent atomic structure and polarization topology in a PTO/STO superlattice. Depth-sectioning STEM reveals pronounced focal-depth-dependent contrast variations and apparent splitting of Pb atomic columns, indicating significant structural heterogeneity along the beam direction. MEP reconstruction simultaneously resolves the Pb, Ti, and O sublattices with nanometer-scale depth resolution, enabling quantitative mapping of atomic displacements throughout the reconstructed volume. The resulting 3D atomic model reveals substantial depth-dependent displacements of Pb, Ti, and O atoms and a corresponding evolution of the polarization topology. Vortex-like polarization structures are observed near the specimen surfaces but become strongly suppressed within the interior, where distinct polarization configurations emerge. These findings show that polarization patterns observed in conventional projection images can arise from the superposition of multiple depth-dependent polar states and may obscure the underlying 3D polarization texture. Our findings establish a direct experimental link between local atomic displacements and depth-dependent polarization topology, opening new opportunities for investigating and engineering buried functional states in complex oxide nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“directly visualize”“Depth-sectioning STEM”“MEP reconstruction”等实验观测与重构手段。；研究对象：PbTiO3/SrTiO3（PTO/STO）超晶格中埋藏的三维极化拓扑结构，具体涉及涡旋状极化构型及其随深度的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在PTO/STO超晶格中，极化涡旋结构在样品表面附近存在，但在内部被强烈抑制并转变为不同的极化构型；传统投影图像中观察到的极化图案可能来自多个深度依赖极化态的叠加，而非真实的体三维极化纹理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在PTO/STO超晶格中，极化涡旋结构在样品表面附近存在，但在内部被强烈抑制并转变为不同的极化构型；传统投影图像中观察到的极化图案可能来自多个深度依赖极化态的叠加，而非真实的体三维极化纹理。；创新点：首次通过实验手段直接解析埋藏三维极化拓扑的深度分辨原子结构，建立了局域原子位移与深度依赖极化拓扑之间的直接实验联系，揭示了投影成像可能掩盖真实三维极化纹理的问题。
papers.method_zh: 结合深度切片低角度环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（LAADF-STEM）、高角度环形暗场STEM（HAADF-STEM）以及多层电子叠层衍射成像（multislice electron ptychography, MEP），实现纳米级深度分辨的原子尺度三维结构重构，并定量提取Pb、Ti、O原子位移。

papers.title: Frustration-induced degenerate spin state with up-up-down-down ordering in corner-connected Heisenberg square-plaquettes
papers.abstract: We investigate frustrated magnetism of a corner-connected square plaquette Heisenberg model with exchange interactions along the edges $(J_1)$, along inter-plaquette links $(J_2)$, and along square diagonals $(J_3)$. Using Luttinger--Tisza (LT) minimization of the Fourier interaction matrix $\mathcal J(\mathbf q)$ together with large-scale Monte Carlo (MC) simulations, we obtain a classical low-temperature magnetic phase diagram in the normalized plane $(J_1/|J_2|, J_3/|J_2|)$. The two methods play complementary roles: the LT analysis provides the zero-temperature candidate ordering wave vectors, while the MC simulations elucidate the resulting ordering tendencies under the hard-spin constraint at low but finite temperatures. Three regimes emerge at low temperatures, an antiferromagnetic phase (AF), a ferromagnetic phase (FM) and a degenerate spin state with \textit{up-up-down-down (uudd)} ordering (DS). For the frustrated degenerate spinstate, LT exhibits line-like minima along $q_x=\pm q_y$ in the $hk$-plane, revealing a highly degenerate spin configuration which violates the hard-spin constraint. The MC results uncover a state with quasi-two-dimensional ordering. The DS regime is intrinsically multi-$\mathbf{q}$: the ordered texture assembles itself from symmetry-related modes on the lines, producing a ``\textit{uudd}'' spin arrangement comprising of distinctive strong antiferromagnetic correlations on diagonals, ferromagnetic correlations on corner links, and highly suppressed correlations on the edges. The field-temperature phase diagram for a representative parameter point in the DS regime, determined by MC simulations, yields field induced distinct regions of negatively and positively correlated layers. These two regions are separated by a curve corresponding to negligible inter-layer correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Luttinger--Tisza (LT) minimization”和“large-scale Monte Carlo (MC) simulations”，属于经典自旋模型的理论分析与数值模拟结合。；研究对象：角连接正方形plaquette（四自旋环）构成的Heisenberg模型，包含三种交换相互作用：边上的J₁、plaquette间连接J₂、正方形对角线J₃。研究的是该几何阻挫体系在低温下的磁性有序行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在(J₁/|J₂|, J₃/|J₂|)参数平面内，低温下存在三个区域：反铁磁相（AF）、铁磁相（FM）和一个具有up-up-down-down（uudd）有序的简并自旋态（DS）。DS态本质上是多q态，由对称性相关的模式组合而成，表现为对角线上强反铁磁关联、角连接上铁磁关联、边上关联被强烈抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在(J₁/|J₂|, J₃/|J₂|)参数平面内，低温下存在三个区域：反铁磁相（AF）、铁磁相（FM）和一个具有up-up-down-down（uudd）有序的简并自旋态（DS）。DS态本质上是多q态，由对称性相关的模式组合而成，表现为对角线上强反铁磁关联、角连接上铁磁关联、边上关联被强烈抑制。；创新点：揭示了LT方法中沿q_x=±q_y的线状简并最小值（违反硬自旋约束）与MC模拟中实际出现的准二维uudd有序之间的对应关系，阐明了该阻挫体系中简并自旋态的多q本质及其在磁场下的层间关联行为。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 1）Luttinger–Tisza（LT）方法：对傅里叶相互作用矩阵𝒥(q)进行最小化，得到零温候选有序波矢；2）大尺度蒙特卡洛（MC）模拟：在硬自旋约束下研究低但有限温度下的实际有序倾向。两种方法互补：LT提供零温候选波矢，MC揭示硬自旋约束下的实际有序行为。此外还通过MC模拟确定了DS态代表参数点的场-温度相图。

papers.title: Geometric Thermodynamics of Scallop Motion with Two Control Parameters
papers.abstract: According to Purcell's scallop theorem, reciprocal single-degree-of-freedom shape deformations cannot achieve net propulsion in a viscous fluid. We show that this limitation is bypassed by thermal fluctuations in a two-parameter driven potential landscape. Formulating the stochastic shape dynamics via a Smoluchowski equation with position-dependent mobility $M_\mathrm{eff}(x)$, we utilize a generalized inverse operator to evaluate the slow-driving response. Cyclic modulation of the control parameters induces a non-zero Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman curvature $F_{12}(\bmθ)$, resulting in directed geometric propulsion. Simultaneously, the non-adiabatic excess dissipation is dictated by a Riemannian thermodynamic metric $g_{ij}(\bmθ)$. Our results provide a unified geometric foundation that bridges hydrodynamic friction, stochastic mechanics, and thermodynamic trade-offs in micro-swimmers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Smoluchowski equation”“generalized inverse operator”“Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman curvature”“Riemannian thermodynamic metric”等理论推导与几何框架关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：微游泳者（micro-swimmers）在粘性流体中的随机形状动力学，具体为具有两个控制参数、位置依赖迁移率 \(M_\mathrm{eff}(x)\) 的驱动势能景观中的“扇贝运动”（scallop motion）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热涨落可以绕过Purcell扇贝定理的限制：在双参数驱动势中，循环调制控制参数会产生非零的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率 \(F_{12}(\bm\theta)\)，从而在粘性流体中实现定向几何推进；同时，非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度规 \(g_{ij}(\bm\theta)\) 决定，建立了流体摩擦、随机力学与热力学权衡之间的统一几何基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热涨落可以绕过Purcell扇贝定理的限制：在双参数驱动势中，循环调制控制参数会产生非零的Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率 \(F_{12}(\bm\theta)\)，从而在粘性流体中实现定向几何推进；同时，非绝热过剩耗散由黎曼热力学度规 \(g_{ij}(\bm\theta)\) 决定，建立了流体摩擦、随机力学与热力学权衡之间的统一几何基础。；创新点：将几何热力学（曲率与度规）统一应用于微游泳者的随机驱动问题，明确展示了热涨落下双控制参数循环驱动如何突破扇贝定理限制，并同时刻画定向推进与热力学耗散。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Smoluchowski方程的随机形状动力学描述；利用广义逆算子（generalized inverse operator）评估慢驱动响应；通过几何曲率（Berry-Sinitsyn-Nemenman曲率）和黎曼热力学度规分析推进与耗散。摘要未提及具体数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Classification of Metal - Insulator Transitions: Relating characteristic Properties to Quantum Chemical Bonding Descriptors
papers.abstract: Pressure induced metal insulator transitions (MIT) are classified by the evolution of characteristic optoelectronic and vibrational properties calculated with density functional theory. Three classes emerge: ionic solids metallize continuously at band-gap closure with hardening phonons; covalent solids show discontinuous changes in atomic arrangement and optical phonon frequencies; a third class exhibits complete lattice softening and drastically enhanced electron phonon coupling. A one dimensional hydrogen chain reproduces this behavior and serves as a toy model of the underlying bonding mechanism, termed metavalent. Two quantum-chemical descriptors capture the distinct bonding changes behind the three classes. In metavalent solids, competing electron localization and delocalization yield soft optical modes and Peierls distortions on the insulating side, superconductivity on the metallic side, and low lattice thermal conductivity near the MIT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“calculated with density functional theory”（基于密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：压力诱导的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT），具体涵盖离子固体、共价固体以及第三类具有“metavalent”（亚价键）键合特征的固体；并以一维氢链作为玩具模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力诱导的金属-绝缘体转变可按其光电与振动性质演化分为三类：离子固体在带隙闭合时连续金属化且声子硬化；共价固体发生原子排列与光学声子频率的不连续变化；第三类（metavalent）固体表现出完全晶格软化与显著增强的电子-声子耦合。两个量子化学键合描述符可区分这三类转变背后的键合变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力诱导的金属-绝缘体转变可按其光电与振动性质演化分为三类：离子固体在带隙闭合时连续金属化且声子硬化；共价固体发生原子排列与光学声子频率的不连续变化；第三类（metavalent）固体表现出完全晶格软化与显著增强的电子-声子耦合。两个量子化学键合描述符可区分这三类转变背后的键合变化。；创新点：将金属-绝缘体转变的分类与量子化学键合描述符直接关联，提出“metavalent”键合机制作为统一解释框架，并揭示其在绝缘侧导致软光学模与Peierls畸变、金属侧导致超导、MIT附近导致低晶格热导率的物理图像。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于计算光电性质与振动性质；一维氢链作为玩具模型进行机理模拟；采用两个量子化学描述符（具体形式摘要未明确说明）来表征键合变化。

papers.title: Phase-controlled perfect nonlocal spin and charge diode effects in a four-terminal Josephson junction with $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate charge and spin transport in a four-terminal Josephson junction with a normal-metal barrier. The top and bottom superconducting leads are equal-spin triplet $p_y$-wave superconductors, while the left and right leads are $p$-wave magnets with proximity-induced conventional $s$-wave superconductivity. When the transverse macroscopic phase difference between the top and bottom leads is set to zero, a longitudinal phase bias generates a pure transverse spin current with perfect 100% nonreciprocity. Remarkably, a finite transverse phase difference preserves the perfect spin-diode effect while simultaneously inducing a perfect charge-diode effect, enabling fully nonreciprocal spin and charge transport. Moreover, the spin-diode efficiency exhibits sharp, step-like switching as a function of both the gate voltage applied to the barrier and the crystallographic orientation of the $p$-wave magnet, providing independent and experimentally accessible knobs for controlling the diode polarity. The diode response remains robust against asymmetric interface couplings, nonmagnetic disorder, variations in the relative singlet and triplet pairing strengths, temperature, and junction dimensions, demonstrating that the effect is not a consequence of fine-tuned parameters. These findings establish the proposed four-terminal junction as a highly tunable and structurally robust platform for dissipationless, phase-controlled spin and charge rectification, with potential applications in superconducting spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“theoretically investigate”，且涉及输运计算与效率分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：四端约瑟夫森结，包含正常金属势垒、上下两个等自旋三重态 \(p_y\)-波超导电极，以及左右两个具有邻近诱导 \(s\)-波超导性的 \(p\)-波磁体电极。研究的是该体系中自旋与电荷的非互易输运（二极管效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在横向宏观相位差为零时，纵向相位偏置可产生具有100%非互易性的纯横向自旋电流；当横向相位差有限时，自旋二极管效应保持完美，同时诱导出完美的电荷二极管效应，实现完全非互易的自旋与电荷输运。该二极管响应在多种扰动下保持鲁棒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在横向宏观相位差为零时，纵向相位偏置可产生具有100%非互易性的纯横向自旋电流；当横向相位差有限时，自旋二极管效应保持完美，同时诱导出完美的电荷二极管效应，实现完全非互易的自旋与电荷输运。该二极管响应在多种扰动下保持鲁棒。；创新点：首次提出在四端约瑟夫森结中通过相位控制同时实现完美的自旋和电荷二极管效应，且自旋二极管效率可通过门电压和 \(p\)-波磁体晶向实现阶梯式开关切换，提供独立且实验可调的极性控制手段；同时该效应在多种非理想条件下保持鲁棒，表明其非微调参数所致。
papers.method_zh: 理论输运计算。摘要未明确说明具体方法（如散射矩阵、格林函数或Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程），但涉及相位偏置、门电压、界面耦合、无序、配对强度、温度及结尺寸等参数的系统分析，属于量子输运理论框架。

papers.title: Neutron scattering evidence for two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic lattice in α-Cu2P2O7
papers.abstract: The microscopic magnetic model of the low-dimensional quantum magnet alpha-Cu2P2O7 has remained controversial. We present a comprehensive study of its magnetic ground state and excitation spectrum using temperature-dependent inelastic neutron scattering, neutron diffraction, magnetization measurements, and comprehensive spin-wave modeling. Our results unambiguously establish alpha-Cu2P2O7 as a two-dimensionally coupled spin-dimerized antiferromagnetic (AF) lattice within the bc plane, with a dominant AF exchange J2 = 7.73 meV (hereafter referred to as "intradimer exchange") and weaker exchange couplings J1, J3, and J4 in the two-dimensional lattice (hereafter referred to as "interdimer exchange"), in agreement with LDA-based density functional theory and in contrast to previous GGA+U predictions. The dominant intradimer AF exchange is found between seventh-nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 5.125(3) A] rather than nearest-neighbor Cu-Cu ion pairs [d(Cu-Cu) = 3.014(1) A] of the structural dimers. Weak interlayer coupling (J5 = 0.03 meV) stabilizes long-range antiferromagnetic order below TN = 25 K. We further identify a weak single-ion anisotropy, associated with the distorted CuO5 polyhedra, that opens a gap in the spin-excitation spectrum and drives a field-induced metamagnetic transition. Systematic spin-wave calculations elucidate the distinct roles of interlayer coupling J5 and anisotropy term D in producing two distinct energy gaps at different antiferromagnetic zone centers. Complementary neutron diffraction and magnetization measurements as a function of applied magnetic field uncover a previously overlooked metamagnetic transition near 13 kOe and allow construction of the magnetic phase diagram in the H-T plane.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以理论建模）。判断依据：使用了非弹性中子散射、中子衍射、磁化率测量等实验手段，并结合自旋波计算（spin-wave modeling）和基于LDA的密度泛函理论（DFT）进行理论分析。；研究对象：低维量子磁体α-Cu2P2O7，具体研究其磁性基态、自旋激发谱、磁结构及磁场诱导的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α-Cu2P2O7被明确为bc平面内的二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，其主导的层内二聚体交换作用J2 = 7.73 meV发生在结构二聚体中第七近邻Cu-Cu离子对之间（而非最近邻对），弱层间耦合J5 = 0.03 meV在TN = 25 K以下稳定长程反铁磁序，并存在弱单离子各向异性导致的自旋激发能隙和亚磁相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α-Cu2P2O7被明确为bc平面内的二维耦合自旋二聚化反铁磁晶格，其主导的层内二聚体交换作用J2 = 7.73 meV发生在结构二聚体中第七近邻Cu-Cu离子对之间（而非最近邻对），弱层间耦合J5 = 0.03 meV在TN = 25 K以下稳定长程反铁磁序，并存在弱单离子各向异性导致的自旋激发能隙和亚磁相变。；创新点：推翻了此前基于GGA+U的预测，首次通过实验与LDA-DFT结合，明确识别出主导交换作用发生在第七近邻Cu-Cu对之间而非结构二聚体的最近邻对；同时发现了此前被忽略的约13 kOe处的亚磁相变，并系统阐明了层间耦合J5与各向异性项D在反铁磁区不同区中心产生两个不同能隙的机制。
papers.method_zh: 变温非弹性中子散射（INS）、中子衍射、磁化率测量、自旋波（线性自旋波理论）建模、基于LDA的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、磁场依赖的中子衍射与磁化率测量（用于构建H-T相图）。

papers.title: Bonding Signatures of Incipient Electron Localization in Topological Chiral Semimetals Near the Metal-Insulator Transition
papers.abstract: How do electronic localization and delocalization compete in solids beyond the traditional limiting cases of metals and iono-covalent insulators? Topological chiral semimetals (TCSMs), characterized by their unique crystal symmetry, offer an intriguing platform to explore this question. Here, we systematically compare TCSMs with covalent compounds, ordinary metals, and metavalent solids (incipient metals), and show that TCSMs occupy a distinct region in a multidimensional property fingerprint. Atom probe tomography reveals an unusual bond-rupture signature, consistent with a bonding regime intermediate between electron localization and delocalization. This interpretation is supported by measurements of optical properties showing a transfer of spectral weight from interband to intraband transitions. For highly conductive TCSMs, this transition is accompanied by the disappearance of the Born effective charge, a measure of chemical bond polarizability, while less conductive TCSMs retain a nonzero value. Together, these results identify a property based bonding perspective on TCSMs that distinguishes them from metals, covalent solids, and metavalent compounds. Although metavalent solids and TCSMs both lie near the metal-insulator transition and exhibit distorted crystal structures, ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy reveals fundamentally different lattice-dynamical responses: a phonon-driven Peierls-like instability in metavalent solids versus a robust chiral B20 bonding motif in TCSMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，结合理论分析）。判断依据：摘要提及“Atom probe tomography”“optical properties”“ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy”等实验手段，同时涉及“Born effective charge”等理论概念与多维性质指纹分析。；研究对象：拓扑手性半金属（TCSMs），特别是其接近金属-绝缘体转变时的电子局域化与退局域化竞争行为，以及其与共价化合物、普通金属、金属价固体（incipient metals）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: TCSMs在性质指纹空间中占据与金属、共价固体和金属价化合物均不同的独特区域，其键合行为介于电子局域化与退局域化之间；与金属价固体不同，TCSMs在超快相干声子谱中表现出稳健的B20手性键合构型，而非声子驱动的Peierls类不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：TCSMs在性质指纹空间中占据与金属、共价固体和金属价化合物均不同的独特区域，其键合行为介于电子局域化与退局域化之间；与金属价固体不同，TCSMs在超快相干声子谱中表现出稳健的B20手性键合构型，而非声子驱动的Peierls类不稳定性。；创新点：首次从化学键合角度系统建立TCSMs的多维性质指纹，将其与金属、共价固体和金属价化合物明确区分，并揭示TCSMs与金属价固体虽同处金属-绝缘体转变附近但具有根本不同的晶格动力学响应。
papers.method_zh: 原子探针断层扫描（APT）用于探测键断裂特征；光学性质测量用于分析带间到带内跃迁的光谱权重转移；Born有效电荷计算用于表征化学键极化率；超快相干声子谱用于研究晶格动力学响应。

papers.title: Weaving Hopfions from Emergent Monopoles in a Chiral Magnet
papers.abstract: Recent advances in three-dimensional magnetization imaging techniques have opened new avenues for exploring topological spin textures beyond domain walls and skyrmions. Among them, magnetic hopfions are particularly promising, as their knotted topology is expected to give rise to unconventional dynamics and responses; however, their controlled creation remains challenging. Here we propose a simple mechanism for generating hopfions from magnetic torons, three-dimensional textures hosting an emergent monopole-antimonopole pair. Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations, we show that an electric current drives the annihilation of this pair, converting a toron into a hopfion. The initial toron length determines the number of generated hopfions, while the current direction selects the sign of the Hopf invariant. We further find that the threshold current depends sensitively on material parameters, indicating a close connection to skyrmion dynamics. Our results establish an experimentally accessible route to hopfion creation and reveal a pathway from monopole defects to knotted topological textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Using Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations”（使用LLG模拟），属于微磁学计算。；研究对象：手性磁体（chiral magnet）中的三维拓扑自旋纹理，具体包括磁托龙（magnetic toron，含涌现单极-反单极对）和磁霍普夫子（magnetic hopfion，具有纽结拓扑）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种简单机制：通过施加电流驱动托龙中涌现单极-反单极对的湮灭，从而将托龙转化为霍普夫子。初始托龙长度决定生成的霍普夫子数量，电流方向决定霍普夫子不变量的符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种简单机制：通过施加电流驱动托龙中涌现单极-反单极对的湮灭，从而将托龙转化为霍普夫子。初始托龙长度决定生成的霍普夫子数量，电流方向决定霍普夫子不变量的符号。；创新点：首次提出从涌现单极缺陷（托龙）出发，通过电流驱动单极对湮灭来可控生成霍普夫子的实验可行路径，建立了从单极缺陷到纽结拓扑纹理的转化机制。摘要还指出阈值电流与材料参数敏感相关，暗示与斯格明子动力学的密切联系。
papers.method_zh: Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）微磁学模拟。摘要未提及具体材料参数或实验手段。

papers.title: Composite fermions in the $ν=3$ fractional quantum spin Hall effect
papers.abstract: Well-understood fractional quantum Hall states in GaAs and graphene can be described in terms of weakly interacting composite fermions. It is natural to expect that the same unifying principle applies to the putative fractional quantum spin Hall effect in MoTe$_2$. Since the quantum spin Hall effect involves two spin components, two types of composite fermions must be present. We classify all two-component composite-fermion states at the filling factor $ν=3$. The classification includes the three classes of states, which were introduced from different physical perspectives in Refs. Sodemann Villadiego, Phys. Rev. B 110, 045114 (2024), Jian et al., Phys. Rev. X 15, 021063 (2025), and May-Mann et al., Phys. Rev. B 111, L201111, (2025), as well as two new classes of states. A majority of the composite-fermion states break the time-reversal symmetry. We review quasiparticle charges, statistics, and edge theories for each possible state. We also address a way of identifying the experimentally relevant state or states. This can be accomplished by combining three probes. First, the shot noise technique provides information about fractional charges. Second, thermal conductance helps count edge modes. The third probe is based on a new idea and involves transport between two quantum point contacts along a single edge. We find that the current from one contact to the other depends on the shape of the edge channel, which can be controlled with a side gate. The probe reveals the emergent symmetry group of the low-energy edge theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：classify（分类）、edge theories（边界理论）、提出新探测方案。；研究对象：MoTe₂ 中填充因子 ν=3 的分数量子自旋霍尔效应，具体为两分量复合费米子态的分类及其物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中，两分量复合费米子态可分为五类，其中包含文献中已提出的三类和两个新类别；大多数此类态破坏时间反演对称性。文章还提出了一种结合散粒噪声、热导和双量子点接触输运三种探测手段来鉴别实验相关态的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中，两分量复合费米子态可分为五类，其中包含文献中已提出的三类和两个新类别；大多数此类态破坏时间反演对称性。文章还提出了一种结合散粒噪声、热导和双量子点接触输运三种探测手段来鉴别实验相关态的方法。；创新点：给出了 ν=3 分数量子自旋霍尔效应中两分量复合费米子态的完整分类，发现了两个新态类；提出了一种基于单条边界上两个量子点接触间输运的新探测方法，可揭示低能边界理论的涌现对称群。
papers.method_zh: 理论分类与综合分析方法：对两分量复合费米子态进行系统分类，回顾各态的准粒子电荷、统计和边界理论，并基于边界通道形状对输运的影响提出新的探测方案（双量子点接触间输运，受侧门控制）。

papers.title: Scattering-Induced Magnon Layer-Hall Transport beyond Band Geometry
papers.abstract: The layer Hall effect has been exclusively attributed to layer-locked Berry curvature, posing a fundamental barrier to its realization in conventional magnets. Here we report a fundamentally distinct layer Hall effect for bosonic excitations, i.e., magnons, which originates solely from non-reciprocal dipolar scattering at heterointerfaces, thereby decoupling the phenomenon from geometric-phase mechanisms. Using a microscopic scattering theory, we demonstrate that a longitudinal temperature gradient drives opposite transverse thermal Hall currents in a nanowire atop a magnetic film, with the direction fully reconfigurable by the applied magnetic field. The effect yields a significant Hall angle of $\sim 6^{\circ}$ in conventional magnetic heterostructures, eliminating the need for topological engineering. Our findings establish a scattering-driven paradigm for layer Hall effect, extendable to ferrons and polar phonons, and predict a Hall response that is readily detectable in conventional magnetic heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：microscopic scattering theory（微观散射理论）、theoretical framework。；研究对象：磁性异质结构（纳米线置于磁性薄膜之上）中磁振子（magnon）的层霍尔效应（layer Hall effect），具体为散射诱导的非互易层霍尔输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁振子的层霍尔效应可完全由异质界面处的非互易偶极散射产生，而非依赖层锁定的贝里曲率；纵向温度梯度可在纳米线中驱动方向可由外磁场重配置的横向热霍尔电流，霍尔角约为6°。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁振子的层霍尔效应可完全由异质界面处的非互易偶极散射产生，而非依赖层锁定的贝里曲率；纵向温度梯度可在纳米线中驱动方向可由外磁场重配置的横向热霍尔电流，霍尔角约为6°。；创新点：首次将层霍尔效应从几何相位（贝里曲率）机制中解耦，提出纯散射驱动的层霍尔效应新范式，无需拓扑工程即可在常规磁性异质结构中实现显著霍尔响应，并预言该机制可推广至铁磁子（ferrons）和极性声子（polar phonons）。
papers.method_zh: 微观散射理论（microscopic scattering theory），用于分析异质界面处磁振子的非互易偶极散射及其对横向热输运的贡献。

papers.title: Quantum-geometry stabilization of dilute fractional Chern insulators
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators have attracted broad interest as lattice analogs of fractional quantum Hall states without Landau levels. However, low-filling fractional Chern insulators are fragile because charge-ordered phases can compete strongly with the fractional topological liquid. Here, we propose a center-decorated kagome model, motivated by geometry-tunable artificial lattices, in which the center-site hopping $t_2$ provides a direct knob for the quantum geometry of an isolated $C=1$ flat band. Here quantum geometry refers to the Berry curvature and Fubini--Study metric, which determine the form factors of interactions projected into the Chern band. Exact diagonalization shows that tuning $t_2$ away from the flatness-optimized kagome limit reduces the trace-condition deviation, suppresses competing charge order, and enhances the many-body stability at both $ν=1/3$ and the more fragile $ν=1/5$ filling. At $ν=1/5$, this stability-enhanced window persists under nearby interaction profiles, including variations of the dominant third-neighbor repulsion and weak nearest-neighbor admixtures. Low-energy spectra, spectral flow, quasihole and entanglement counting, static structure factors, and the quantized total many-body Chern number $C_{\mathrm{tot}}=1$ consistently support Laughlin-like fractional Chern insulators. These results identify quantum-geometry engineering as a route to stabilizing dilute fractional Chern insulators beyond band-flatness optimization alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“Exact diagonalization”（精确对角化）、“many-body Chern number”（多体陈数）等数值计算方法，以及“propose a model”（提出模型）的理论建模表述。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（Fractional Chern Insulators, FCIs），具体为基于中心装饰的kagome（center-decorated kagome）晶格模型中的低填充分数拓扑态，关注ν=1/3和ν=1/5填充下的Laughlin-like拓扑序及其与电荷有序态的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节中心位点跳跃参数t₂，可以优化孤立C=1平带的量子几何（Berry曲率与Fubini–Study度规），从而抑制竞争性电荷有序，在ν=1/3和更脆弱的ν=1/5填充下均增强分数陈绝缘体的多体稳定性，并得到Laughlin-like分数陈绝缘体（总陈数C_tot=1）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节中心位点跳跃参数t₂，可以优化孤立C=1平带的量子几何（Berry曲率与Fubini–Study度规），从而抑制竞争性电荷有序，在ν=1/3和更脆弱的ν=1/5填充下均增强分数陈绝缘体的多体稳定性，并得到Laughlin-like分数陈绝缘体（总陈数C_tot=1）。；创新点：提出“量子几何工程”（quantum-geometry engineering）作为超越单纯平带平坦度优化的新策略，即通过直接调控Berry曲率与Fubini–Study度规的偏差（trace-condition deviation）来稳定低填充分数陈绝缘体，而非仅依赖带宽平坦化。摘要未突出说明与其他具体模型或实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法，辅以低能谱、谱流（spectral flow）、准空穴与纠缠谱计数、静态结构因子以及多体陈数计算。模型为几何可调人工晶格启发的中心装饰kagome模型，通过t₂直接调控量子几何。

papers.title: Engineering Dirac interface states
papers.abstract: We develop a low-energy theory of interface states in anisotropic multivalley Dirac systems whose masses and kinetic parameters are allowed to vary across an interface. For sharp interfaces, current-conserving matching conditions yield analytic expressions for the existence, localization and dispersion of the bound states. We show that the interface velocity is determined by the weighted tangential kinetic terms on the two sides of the seam. Their cancellation can suppress the linear velocity and generate an interface band that is flat to leading order near the projected Dirac point. For the special antisymmetric configuration in which both the Dirac mass and the tangential kinetic coefficient reverse sign with unchanged magnitude, the transparent sharp-interface solution is exactly dispersionless for all conserved momenta within the linear Dirac theory, while the surrounding bulk bands remain dispersive. We extend the theory to smooth interfaces, where the modified bound-state envelope changes the linear interface velocity through a spatial average of the tangential kinetic coefficient. We also investigate quadratic corrections in the kinetic \(σ_x\) and \(σ_y\) channels. To first order in their coefficients and through linear order in the interface momentum, these terms shift the interface-state energy but produce no additional correction to the linear velocity. Finally, we combine continuum and lattice models to show how interface modes from distinct valleys hybridize and how the resulting dispersions depend on microscopic interface properties. Our results establish design principles for controlling the dispersion, localization, and hybridization of Dirac interface states. We further examine two graphene-based mass-domain-wall models as experimentally inspired examples of dispersive copropagating and counterpropagating interface states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。摘要中主要涉及低能理论推导、匹配条件、解析表达式，并结合连续模型与晶格模型，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：各向异性多谷狄拉克体系中的界面态，具体包括质量项和动能参数在界面两侧变化时的束缚态行为；并以石墨烯质量域壁模型作为实验启发的实例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面态的线性速度由界面两侧的切向动能项加权决定，当这些项相互抵消时可产生在投影狄拉克点附近平坦的界面能带；在特定的反对称构型下，透明锐界面解在狄拉克理论内对所有守恒动量完全无色散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面态的线性速度由界面两侧的切向动能项加权决定，当这些项相互抵消时可产生在投影狄拉克点附近平坦的界面能带；在特定的反对称构型下，透明锐界面解在狄拉克理论内对所有守恒动量完全无色散。；创新点：建立了控制狄拉克界面态色散、局域化和杂化的设计原则，特别是揭示了切向动能项对界面速度的定量决定作用以及反对称构型下完全无色散界面带的实现条件。
papers.method_zh: 低能有效理论（连续模型）结合界面匹配条件推导束缚态的解析表达式；扩展至光滑界面情形；引入二次动能修正（σ_x和σ_y通道）的微扰分析；并联合连续模型与晶格模型研究能谷间杂化。

papers.title: Arithmetic Tuning of Dynamical Critical Exponents in Quasiperiodic Localization Transitions
papers.abstract: The critical exponents and universality classes of localization transitions in quasiperiodic systems are of fundamental importance for understanding critical phenomena in aperiodic systems. Here we show that the dynamical critical behavior can be tuned without adding new terms or changing the form of the Hamiltonian, but solely by varying the incommensurate frequency of the quasiperiodic onsite potential. We construct a family of incommensurate frequencies from the limiting ratios of generalized Fibonacci sequences controlled by the parameters $(m,n)$, and use them to define the quasiperiodic onsite potential. By combining generalized fidelity susceptibility, localization-length scaling, and finite-size gap analysis, we find that the correlation-length exponent is insensitive to the choice of the incommensurate frequency and remains consistent with the correlation-length critical exponent, $ν\simeq 1$, in the localization transition of the standard Aubry--Andr'e--Harper model. In contrast, the dynamical exponent extracted from the low-energy gap scaling varies systematically with the incommensurate frequency. Our results show that changing the incommensurate frequency provides a simple way to tune dynamical critical scaling in deterministic aperiodic systems. Our results suggest instead that the arithmetic structure of an irrational number can serve as a control parameter for nonequilibrium quantum dynamics, enabling the tuning of dynamical critical behavior without changing the microscopic Hamiltonian or the physical spatial dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“construct a family of incommensurate frequencies”“combining generalized fidelity susceptibility, localization-length scaling, and finite-size gap analysis”，属于理论构造与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：准周期系统中的局域化相变，具体为广义Fibonacci序列控制的准周期在位势模型，以及其临界动力学行为（动力学临界指数）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅改变准周期在位势的非公度频率（由广义Fibonacci序列的极限比值控制），可以在不改变哈密顿量形式或空间维度的前提下，系统地调节局域化相变中的动力学临界指数；而关联长度临界指数则保持为ν≈1，与标准Aubry–André–Harper模型一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅改变准周期在位势的非公度频率（由广义Fibonacci序列的极限比值控制），可以在不改变哈密顿量形式或空间维度的前提下，系统地调节局域化相变中的动力学临界指数；而关联长度临界指数则保持为ν≈1，与标准Aubry–André–Harper模型一致。；创新点：首次证明非公度频率的算术结构（即无理数的算术性质）可以作为调控参数，在不改变微观哈密顿量或物理空间维度的前提下，实现对确定性非周期系统中动力学临界标度的连续调节。这一发现将“算术结构”引入作为非平衡量子动力学的控制自由度。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与数值计算结合：利用参数(m,n)控制的广义Fibonacci序列的极限比值构造一族非公度频率；采用广义保真度磁化率（generalized fidelity susceptibility）、局域化长度标度（localization-length scaling）和有限尺寸能隙分析（finite-size gap analysis）提取临界指数。

papers.title: Tunable Mediated Interactions Near Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking: From Yukawa to Coulomb and Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interactions
papers.abstract: We propose a realization of tunable long-range mediated interactions generated by Nambu-Goldstone (NG) modes near spontaneous symmetry breaking. An effective exchange interaction emerges between two distinguishable impurities proportional to the retarded susceptibility mediated by the bath particles. The interaction is mediated by emergent NG modes associated with symmetry breaking in systems, namely the magnon mode in a repulsive two-component Fermi or Bose gas, or the goldstino mode in a Bose-Fermi mixture. When the NG mode is gapped by explicit symmetry breaking, the interaction has a Yukawa-type short-ranged interaction, whereas the gapless limit gives a Coulomb law. Above the NG mode threshold, the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya-like cross product coupling emerges in a long-range form. Our proposal paves a way towards the realization of a quantum simulator of spin models and polarons with controllable non-local interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“propose a realization”，使用“effective exchange interaction emerges”等理论推导语言，未提及实验手段或数值计算。；研究对象：自发对称破缺附近由Nambu-Goldstone（NG）模式介导的可调长程相互作用，具体体系包括双组分排斥性费米气体或玻色气体中的磁振子模式，以及玻色-费米混合物中的goldstino模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自发对称破缺附近，两个可区分杂质之间可通过NG模式产生可调的长程有效交换相互作用：当NG模式因显式对称破缺而具有能隙时，相互作用为Yukawa型短程势；无能隙极限下退化为Coulomb型长程势；当能量高于NG模式阈值时，出现长程的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya型交叉乘积耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自发对称破缺附近，两个可区分杂质之间可通过NG模式产生可调的长程有效交换相互作用：当NG模式因显式对称破缺而具有能隙时，相互作用为Yukawa型短程势；无能隙极限下退化为Coulomb型长程势；当能量高于NG模式阈值时，出现长程的Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya型交叉乘积耦合。；创新点：提出利用NG模式作为媒介实现从Yukawa到Coulomb再到Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya型相互作用的连续调控，为自旋模型和极化子的量子模拟器提供可控非局域相互作用的实现途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于延迟响应函数（retarded susceptibility）的有效交换相互作用推导，分析NG模式（磁振子或goldstino）在不同对称破缺情形（显式与自发）下的传播子行为，从而得到相互作用势的实空间形式。

papers.title: Bulk Phase Transition and Edge Behavior in Temporally Correlated Random Matrices
papers.abstract: We study long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices built from row-independent stationary Gaussian sequences. For exponentially decaying (AR(1)) correlations, the bulk spectral density deforms from the semicircle law via an explicit combinatorial "hub" mechanism, yet we verify the flatness and decay hypotheses of the matrix-Dyson-equation framework (MDE), with numerical evidence supporting Tracy-Widom edge universality for every fixed $ρ<1$ of the exponential decay correlations; the degenerate limit $ρ\to1^-$ reduces to a symmetrized Volterra operator, connecting to the singular-value cascade identified in a companion BBP analysis. For power-law correlations $dt\sim t^{-γ}$, we identify $γ_c=1/2$ as the critical point for divergence of the bulk fourth-moment, while $γ=1$ marks the breakdown of the flatness condition governing the MDE edge analysis. We prove the fourth-moment transition exactly and find numerically that the self-consistent edge varies smoothly across $γ=1$, with no evidence of a kink or discontinuity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。关键词：long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices、matrix-Dyson-equation framework、numerical evidence、prove the fourth-moment transition exactly。；研究对象：时间相关的随机矩阵系综（temporally correlated random matrices），具体为行独立平稳高斯序列构造的长程相关Wigner型矩阵，研究其体态谱密度与边缘行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体态谱密度通过显式组合“hub”机制从半圆律变形，且数值支持Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；对于幂律相关，体态四阶矩发散临界点为γ_c=1/2，而γ=1是MDE边缘分析平坦性条件失效的临界点，但自洽边缘在γ=1处平滑变化，无扭结或间断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体态谱密度通过显式组合“hub”机制从半圆律变形，且数值支持Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；对于幂律相关，体态四阶矩发散临界点为γ_c=1/2，而γ=1是MDE边缘分析平坦性条件失效的临界点，但自洽边缘在γ=1处平滑变化，无扭结或间断。；创新点：首次系统研究时间相关（长程相关）随机矩阵的体态相变与边缘行为，揭示了指数相关与幂律相关下不同的临界行为（γ_c=1/2与γ=1），并建立了与对称化Volterra算子及奇异值级联的联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟。具体包括：组合“hub”机制推导谱密度变形；验证矩阵Dyson方程（MDE）框架的平坦性与衰减假设；数值检验Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；精确证明四阶矩相变；数值考察自洽边缘随γ的连续性。

papers.title: Collective Order Decouples Boundary Selection from Macroscopic Chirality in Confined Active Matter
papers.abstract: Can a boundary determine the direction of circulation in a collectively moving active fluid? We study chiral self-propelled particles with nematic bulk alignment, confined by walls whose orientational coupling varies continuously from nematic to polar. For an isolated particle at a wall, we derive the exact parameter condition under which a stable orientation is tangent to the wall. With predominantly nematic wall coupling, however, the many-body circulation changes sign at a chirality that is nearly independent of the wall symmetry. This sign change follows a pronounced decrease in nematic order and disappears when bulk alignment is removed. As the polar wall coupling becomes dominant, opposite-handed circulation is suppressed and same-handed polar locking emerges. Thus local orientation at a wall and the direction of macroscopic circulation are selected by distinct physical processes: the wall determines the possible local orientations, whereas collective order determines whether those orientations control the global flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“derive the exact parameter condition”（推导精确参数条件）、“many-body circulation”（多体环流）等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：受限活性物质（confined active matter）中的手性自驱动粒子（chiral self-propelled particles），具有向列型体相排列（nematic bulk alignment），并受墙壁的取向耦合（从向列型到极型连续变化）约束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 墙壁的局部取向与宏观环流方向由不同物理过程决定：墙壁决定可能的局部取向，而集体有序度（collective order）决定这些取向是否控制全局流动。在向列型壁耦合占主导时，环流符号在某一手性值处反转，该手性值几乎与墙壁对称性无关，且伴随向列序的显著下降；当极型壁耦合占主导时，同手性极型锁定出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：墙壁的局部取向与宏观环流方向由不同物理过程决定：墙壁决定可能的局部取向，而集体有序度（collective order）决定这些取向是否控制全局流动。在向列型壁耦合占主导时，环流符号在某一手性值处反转，该手性值几乎与墙壁对称性无关，且伴随向列序的显著下降；当极型壁耦合占主导时，同手性极型锁定出现。；创新点：揭示了边界选择（局部取向）与宏观手性（环流方向）之间的解耦机制，表明集体有序度而非墙壁对称性主导宏观环流符号的转变。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与多体分析：对孤立粒子在墙壁处推导稳定切向取向的精确参数条件；通过改变壁耦合类型（向列型→极型）研究多体环流行为；对比有无体相排列（bulk alignment）的情况以验证其作用。

papers.title: Jamming states in random sequential adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregates
papers.abstract: Motivated by the ubiquity of ramified fractal deposits in nature and engineered systems, we investigate the irreversible adsorption of diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) clusters on a square lattice. We study the role of cluster shape diversity on jamming properties of the system by systematically controlling the number of distinct shapes used across and within realizations, encompassing both monodisperse and polydisperse model variants. Our large-scale simulations over a broad range of cluster sizes $2\leqslant k\leqslant4096$ show that the jamming density decreases with cluster size as a power-law $p_j(k)-p_j^\infty\sim k^{-α}$. Both $α$ and $p_j^\infty$ are found to depend on the degree of shape diversity, with $α$ ranging from $0.374(2)$ to $0.417(1)$. It is observed that increasing shape polydispersity promotes denser packing. Importantly, the fluctuations of the jamming density exhibit distinct scaling behavior: $σ(L)\sim1/L$ for a fixed pool of cluster shape(s), but remain $L$-independent when the pool of shape(s) is refreshed across different realizations. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that the differences between the model variants systematically diminish with increasing $k$ and are expected to vanish as $k\to\infty$ due to the statistical self-similarity of the DLA clusters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：large-scale simulations、随机顺序吸附模型、幂律拟合等关键词。；研究对象：扩散限制聚集（DLA）团簇在正方晶格上的不可逆随机顺序吸附过程，重点研究团簇形状多样性对体系堵塞（jamming）性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 堵塞密度随团簇尺寸增大按幂律 p_j(k)−p_j^∞ ∼ k^{−α} 衰减，指数 α 和极限堵塞密度 p_j^∞ 均依赖于形状多样性程度；增大形状多分散性有利于更致密的堆积。堵塞密度的涨落标度行为取决于形状池是否在多次实现间刷新：固定形状池时 σ(L)∼1/L，刷新形状池时涨落与 L 无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：堵塞密度随团簇尺寸增大按幂律 p_j(k)−p_j^∞ ∼ k^{−α} 衰减，指数 α 和极限堵塞密度 p_j^∞ 均依赖于形状多样性程度；增大形状多分散性有利于更致密的堆积。堵塞密度的涨落标度行为取决于形状池是否在多次实现间刷新：固定形状池时 σ(L)∼1/L，刷新形状池时涨落与 L 无关。；创新点：系统揭示了 DLA 团簇形状多样性（而非仅尺寸）对堵塞密度及其涨落标度行为的定量影响，并发现两种模型变体（固定形状池 vs. 刷新形状池）的差异随 k 增大而消失，归因于 DLA 团簇的统计自相似性。摘要未突出说明与以往 RSA 研究的其他对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模动力学蒙特卡洛模拟，在正方格点上进行 DLA 团簇的随机顺序吸附（RSA）模拟。系统控制团簇形状池的大小（跨实现与实现内），涵盖单分散与多分散两种模型变体，团簇尺寸范围 k=2 至 4096，并对堵塞密度及其涨落进行有限尺寸标度分析。

papers.title: Reentrance and temperature chaos in the $p$-spin Ising spin glass
papers.abstract: Reentrant transitions and temperature chaos are two unusual properties of spin glasses and had long been considered physically unrelated. We recently established a logical relation between these two phenomena [Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)]. In the present paper, we provide an explicit example of this logical relation in the fully connected Ising $p$-spin glass with a ferromagnetic bias. By expanding the free energy around the triple point, we show analytically that the ferromagnetic--spin glass boundary is reentrant in the vicinity of the triple point throughout the examined range of finite $p>2$. It then follows from the above logical relation that there exists at least one pair of distinct temperatures in the spin glass phase for which the overlap of spin configurations vanishes. This is a necessary condition for temperature chaos, but it would be quite unusual for the overlap to vanish only for selected temperature pairs but not for others within a single spin glass phase. These results therefore strongly suggest the existence of temperature chaos in the sense that the overlaps of spin configurations vanish for all temperature pairs throughout the spin glass phase. Independent evidence for this behavior is provided by a two-temperature replica calculation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytically”“replica calculation”“free energy expansion”等关键词，属于解析理论与统计力学计算。；研究对象：全连接Ising p-自旋自旋玻璃模型（带铁磁偏置），具体研究其重入相变（reentrant transition）与温度混沌（temperature chaos）之间的逻辑关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限p>2的整个考察范围内，铁磁—自旋玻璃相边界在三临界点附近是重入的；由此逻辑关系可推出自旋玻璃相内至少存在一对不同温度使自旋构型重叠为零，且进一步强烈暗示所有温度对的重叠在整个自旋玻璃相内均为零，即存在温度混沌。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限p>2的整个考察范围内，铁磁—自旋玻璃相边界在三临界点附近是重入的；由此逻辑关系可推出自旋玻璃相内至少存在一对不同温度使自旋构型重叠为零，且进一步强烈暗示所有温度对的重叠在整个自旋玻璃相内均为零，即存在温度混沌。；创新点：将此前在[Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)]中建立的重入与温度混沌之间的逻辑关系，首次显式应用于全连接Ising p-自旋玻璃模型，给出具体解析例证，并推广到所有有限p>2。
papers.method_zh: 围绕三临界点对自由能进行解析展开（free energy expansion around the triple point），并结合双温度复制计算（two-temperature replica calculation）提供独立证据。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium pulse dynamics and metastable latching in nonlinear kinetic inductance detectors
papers.abstract: Microwave kinetic inductance detectors are typically operated at high readout power to raise the detector signal above system noise. At sufficiently large readout power, the current-dependent kinetic inductance couples the detector response to its readout bias.
